````csharp
153:     private async Task EnsureCollectionEmbeddedStructureAsync(
154:         OpenApiSchema schema,
155:         Type itemType,
156:         OpenApiSchemaTransformerContext context,
157:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
158:     {
159:         schema.Type = "object";
160:         schema.Properties ??= new Dictionary<string, OpenApiSchema>();
161: 
162: 
163:         var halResourceType = typeof(Explore.Application.Hateoas.HalResource<>).MakeGenericType(itemType);
164:         var itemSchema = await context.GetOrCreateSchemaAsync(halResourceType, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
165: 
166: 
167:         if (!schema.Properties.ContainsKey("_embedded"))
168:         {
169:             schema.Properties["_embedded"] = new OpenApiSchema
170:             {
171:                 Type = "object",
172:                 Properties = new Dictionary<string, OpenApiSchema>
173:                 {
174:                     ["items"] = new OpenApiSchema
175:                     {
176:                         Type = "array",
177:                         Items = itemSchema
178:                     }
179:                 }
180:             };
181:         }
182:         else if (schema.Properties["_embedded"].Properties != null)
183:         {
184:             if (schema.Properties["_embedded"].Properties.TryGetValue("items", out var itemsProperty))
185:             {
186:                 itemsProperty.Type = "array";
187:                 itemsProperty.Items = itemSchema;
188:             }
189:         }
190: 
191: 
192:         AddPaginationProperties(schema);
193:     }
194: 
195:     private void AddPaginationProperties(OpenApiSchema schema)
196:     {
197:         schema.Properties ??= new Dictionary<string, OpenApiSchema>();
198: 
199:         if (!schema.Properties.ContainsKey("page"))
200:         {
201:             schema.Properties["page"] = new OpenApiSchema { Type = "integer", Description = "Current page number" };
202:         }
203:         if (!schema.Properties.ContainsKey("pageSize"))
204:         {
205:             schema.Properties["pageSize"] = new OpenApiSchema { Type = "integer", Description = "Number of items per page" };
206:         }
207:         if (!schema.Properties.ContainsKey("totalCount"))
208:         {
209:             schema.Properties["totalCount"] = new OpenApiSchema { Type = "integer", Description = "Total number of items" };
210:         }
211:         if (!schema.Properties.ContainsKey("totalPages"))
212:         {
213:             schema.Properties["totalPages"] = new OpenApiSchema { Type = "integer", Description = "Total number of pages" };
214:         }
215:     }
216: 
217:     private async Task EnsureEmbeddedItemsArrayTypeAsync(
218:         OpenApiSchema schema,
219:         Type itemType,
220:         OpenApiSchemaTransformerContext context,
221:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
222:     {
223:         schema.Type = "object";
224:         schema.Properties ??= new Dictionary<string, OpenApiSchema>();
225: 
226: 
227:         var halResourceType = typeof(Explore.Application.Hateoas.HalResource<>).MakeGenericType(itemType);
228:         var itemSchema = await context.GetOrCreateSchemaAsync(halResourceType, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
229: 
230:         if (schema.Properties.TryGetValue("items", out var itemsProperty))
231:         {
232: 
233:             itemsProperty.Type = "array";
234:             itemsProperty.Items = itemSchema;
235:         }
236:         else
237:         {
238: 
239:             schema.Properties["items"] = new OpenApiSchema
240:             {
241:                 Type = "array",
242:                 Items = itemSchema
243:             };
244:         }
````

````csharp

  5: namespace Explore.Application.Authorization;
  6: 
  7: public interface ICapabilityCeilingService
  8: {
  9: 
 10: 
 11: 
 12: 
 13:     Task<List<string>> ValidatePermissionAssignmentAsync(
 14:         IEnumerable<int> callerRoleIds,
 15:         RoleScopeEnum callerHighestScope,
 16:         IEnumerable<int> permissionIdsToAssign,
 17:         RoleScopeEnum targetRoleScope);

 28:         RoleScopeEnum callerHighestScope,
 29:         RoleScopeEnum targetRoleScope);

 31: 
 32: public class CapabilityCeilingService : ICapabilityCeilingService
 33: {
 34:     private readonly IPermissionRepository _permissionRepository;
 35:     private readonly IRoleRepository _roleRepository;
 36: 
 37:     public CapabilityCeilingService(
 38:         IPermissionRepository permissionRepository,
 39:         IRoleRepository roleRepository)
 40:     {
 41:         _permissionRepository = permissionRepository;
 42:         _roleRepository = roleRepository;
 43:     }
 44: 
 45:     public async Task<List<string>> ValidatePermissionAssignmentAsync(
 46:         IEnumerable<int> callerRoleIds,
 47:         RoleScopeEnum callerHighestScope,
 48:         IEnumerable<int> permissionIdsToAssign,
 49:         RoleScopeEnum targetRoleScope)
 50:     {
 51:         var errors = new List<string>();
 52: 
 53: 
 54:         var scopeCheck = ValidateScopeBoundary(callerHighestScope, targetRoleScope);
 55:         if (!scopeCheck.IsAllowed)
 56:         {
 57:             errors.Add(scopeCheck.Error!);
 58:             return errors;
 59:         }
 60: 
 61: 
 62:         var assignable = await _permissionRepository.GetAssignablePermissionsAsync(
 63:             callerRoleIds, targetRoleScope);
 64:         var assignableIds = assignable.Select(p => p.Id).ToHashSet();
 65: 
 66:         var requestedIds = permissionIdsToAssign.ToList();
 67:         var unauthorized = requestedIds.Where(id => !assignableIds.Contains(id)).ToList();
 68: 
 69:         if (unauthorized.Count > 0)
 70:         {
 71:             errors.Add($"Cannot assign permissions you don't have: [{string.Join(", ", unauthorized)}]");
 72:         }
 73: 
 74: 
 75: 
 76: 
 77:         return errors;
 78:     }
 79: 
 80:     public async Task<(bool IsAllowed, string? Error)> CanModifyRoleAsync(int roleId)
 81:     {
 82:         var role = await _roleRepository.GetByIdAsync(roleId);
 83: 
 84:         if (role == null)
 85:             return (false, "Role not found.");
 86: 
 87: 
 88:         if (role.IsSystem)
 89:             return (false, $"System role '{role.FullName}' cannot be modified or deleted.");
 90: 
 91:         return (true, null);
 92:     }
 93: 
 94:     public (bool IsAllowed, string? Error) ValidateScopeBoundary(
 95:         RoleScopeEnum callerHighestScope,
 96:         RoleScopeEnum targetRoleScope)
 97:     {
 98: 
 99: 
100: 
101: 
102:         if ((int)targetRoleScope < (int)callerHighestScope)
103:         {
104:             return (false, $"Cannot create roles at scope '{targetRoleScope}'. Your highest scope is '{callerHighestScope}'.");
105:         }
106: 
107:         return (true, null);
108:     }
109: }
````

````csharp
  1: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  2: using Explore.Domain;
  3: using Explore.Domain.Enums;
  4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;
  5: 
  6: namespace Explore.Application.Authorization;
  7: 
  8: public interface IPermissionRegistryService
  9: {
 10: 
 11: 
 12: 
 13:     Task<IReadOnlyList<Permission>> GetAllPermissionsAsync();
 14: 
 15: 
 16: 
 17: 
 18:     Task<bool> ValidateMasterCodeAsync(string masterCode);
 19: 
 20: 
 21: 
 22: 
 23:     Task<IReadOnlyList<Permission>> GetPermissionsByGroupAsync(string groupName);
 24: 
 25: 
 26: 
 27: 
 28: 
 29:     Task<IReadOnlyList<Permission>> GetFilteredPermissionsAsync(
 30:         RoleScopeEnum? scope = null,
 31:         bool excludeFiltered = true);
 32: 
 33: 
 34: 
 35: 
 36:     void InvalidateCache();
 37: }
 38: 
 39: public class PermissionRegistryService : IPermissionRegistryService
 40: {
 41:     private readonly IPermissionRepository _permissionRepository;
 42:     private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
 43: 
 44:     private const string AllPermissionsCacheKey = "permission_registry:all";
 45:     private static readonly TimeSpan CacheDuration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10);
 46: 
 47:     public PermissionRegistryService(
 48:         IPermissionRepository permissionRepository,
 49:         IMemoryCache cache)
 50:     {
 51:         _permissionRepository = permissionRepository;
 52:         _cache = cache;
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Permission>> GetAllPermissionsAsync()
 56:     {
 57:         if (_cache.TryGetValue(AllPermissionsCacheKey, out IReadOnlyList<Permission>? cached) && cached != null)
 58:             return cached;
 59: 
 60:         var all = await _permissionRepository.GetAll();
 61:         var active = all.Where(p => p.IsActive).ToList().AsReadOnly();
 62: 
 63:         _cache.Set(AllPermissionsCacheKey, (IReadOnlyList<Permission>)active, CacheDuration);
 64:         return active;
 65:     }
 66: 
 67:     public async Task<bool> ValidateMasterCodeAsync(string masterCode)
 68:     {
 69:         var all = await GetAllPermissionsAsync();
 70:         return all.Any(p => p.MasterCode == masterCode);
 71:     }
 72: 
 73:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Permission>> GetPermissionsByGroupAsync(string groupName)
 74:     {
 75:         var all = await GetAllPermissionsAsync();
 76:         return all.Where(p => p.GroupName == groupName).ToList().AsReadOnly();
 77:     }
 78: 
 79:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Permission>> GetFilteredPermissionsAsync(
 80:         RoleScopeEnum? scope = null,
 81:         bool excludeFiltered = true)
 82:     {
 83:         var all = await GetAllPermissionsAsync();
 84: 
 85:         var filtered = all.AsEnumerable();
 86: 
 87:         if (scope.HasValue)
 88:             filtered = filtered.Where(p => p.Scope == scope.Value);
 89: 
 90:         if (excludeFiltered)
 91:             filtered = filtered.Where(p => !p.IsFiltered);
 92: 
 93:         return filtered.ToList().AsReadOnly();
 94:     }
 95: 
 96:     public void InvalidateCache()
 97:     {
 98:         _cache.Remove(AllPermissionsCacheKey);
 99:     }
100: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Behaviors/PerformanceBehavior.cs
````csharp
 1: using System.Diagnostics;
 2: using MediatR;
 3: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 4: 
 5: namespace Explore.Application.Behaviors;
 6: 
 7: 
 8: 
 9: 
10: 
11: public class PerformanceBehavior<TRequest, TResponse> : IPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>
12:     where TRequest : IRequest<TResponse>
13: {
14:     private readonly ILogger<PerformanceBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>> _logger;
15:     private readonly Stopwatch _timer = new();
16: 
17:     public PerformanceBehavior(ILogger<PerformanceBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>> logger)
18:     {
19:         _logger = logger;
20:     }
21: 
22:     public async Task<TResponse> Handle(TRequest request, RequestHandlerDelegate<TResponse> next, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
23:     {
24:         _timer.Restart();
25:         var response = await next();
26:         _timer.Stop();
27: 
28:         var elapsedMs = _timer.ElapsedMilliseconds;
29: 
30:         if (elapsedMs > 500)
31:         {
32:             var requestName = typeof(TRequest).Name;
33:             _logger.LogWarning(
34:                 "Long Running Request: {Name} ({ElapsedMilliseconds}ms) {@Request}",
35:                 requestName, elapsedMs, request);
36:         }
37: 
38:         return response;
39:     }
40: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/EventAspects/Validators/CreateUpdateIslamicAspectDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.EventAspects.Validators;
 2: 
 3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 4: using Explore.Domain;
 5: using FluentValidation;
 6: 
 7: 
 8: 
 9: 
10: public class CreateUpdateIslamicAspectDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateUpdateIslamicAspectDto>
11: {
12:     private readonly IMadhabRepository _madhabRepository;
13:     private readonly ILanguageRepository _languageRepository;
14: 
15:     public CreateUpdateIslamicAspectDtoValidator(
16:         IMadhabRepository madhabRepository,
17:         ILanguageRepository languageRepository)
18:     {
19:         _madhabRepository = madhabRepository;
20:         _languageRepository = languageRepository;
21: 
22: 
23:         RuleFor(x => x.MadhabId)
24:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
25:             {
26:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
27:                 return await _madhabRepository.Exists(id.Value);
28:             })
29:             .When(x => x.MadhabId.HasValue)
30:             .WithMessage("Madhab not found.");
31: 
32: 
33:         RuleFor(x => x.PrayerTimeOffset)
34:             .InclusiveBetween(-180, 180)
35:             .When(x => x.PrayerTimeOffset.HasValue)
36:             .WithMessage("Prayer time offset must be between -180 and 180 minutes.");
37: 
38: 
39:         RuleFor(x => x.PrayerTimeOffset)
40:             .Null()
41:             .When(x => !x.ReferencePrayer.HasValue)
42:             .WithMessage("Prayer time offset requires a reference prayer to be set.");
43: 
44: 
45:         RuleFor(x => x.GenderMode)
46:             .IsInEnum()
47:             .WithMessage("Invalid gender segregation mode.");
48: 
49: 
50:         RuleFor(x => x.PrimaryLanguageId)
51:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
52:             {
53:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
54:                 return await _languageRepository.Exists(id.Value);
55:             })
56:             .When(x => x.PrimaryLanguageId.HasValue)
57:             .WithMessage("Primary language not found.");
58:     }
59: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/EventAspects/Validators/CreateUpdateTechAspectDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.EventAspects.Validators;
 2: 
 3: using System;
 4: using FluentValidation;
 5: 
 6: 
 7: 
 8: 
 9: public class CreateUpdateTechAspectDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateUpdateTechAspectDto>
10: {
11:     public CreateUpdateTechAspectDtoValidator()
12:     {
13: 
14:         RuleFor(x => x.GithubRepoUrl)
15:             .MaximumLength(500)
16:             .Must(url => string.IsNullOrEmpty(url) || Uri.TryCreate(url, UriKind.Absolute, out var result) &&
17:                         (result.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttp || result.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps))
18:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.GithubRepoUrl))
19:             .WithMessage("GitHub repository URL must be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL.");
20: 
21: 
22:         RuleFor(x => x.HackathonTrack)
23:             .MaximumLength(200)
24:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.HackathonTrack));
25: 
26: 
27:         RuleFor(x => x.SkillLevel)
28:             .IsInEnum()
29:             .WithMessage("Invalid skill level.");
30: 
31: 
32:         RuleFor(x => x.TechStackTags)
33:             .MaximumLength(1000)
34:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.TechStackTags));
35: 
36: 
37:         RuleFor(x => x.MaxTeamSize)
38:             .InclusiveBetween(1, 100)
39:             .When(x => x.MaxTeamSize.HasValue)
40:             .WithMessage("Max team size must be between 1 and 100.");
41: 
42: 
43:         RuleFor(x => x.PrizePool)
44:             .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0)
45:             .When(x => x.PrizePool.HasValue)
46:             .WithMessage("Prize pool cannot be negative.");
47: 
48: 
49:         RuleFor(x => x.PrizeCurrencyCode)
50:             .NotEmpty()
51:             .When(x => x.PrizePool.HasValue && x.PrizePool > 0)
52:             .WithMessage("Currency code is required when prize pool is specified.");
53: 
54: 
55:         RuleFor(x => x.PrizeCurrencyCode)
56:             .Length(3)
57:             .Matches("^[A-Z]{3}$")
58:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.PrizeCurrencyCode))
59:             .WithMessage("Currency code must be a 3-letter ISO code (e.g., USD, EUR).");
60:     }
61: }
````

````csharp
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 6: using Explore.Application.Features.EventAspects.Requests.Commands;
 7: using MediatR;
 8: 
 9: 
10: 
11: 
12: public class DeleteEventIslamicAspectCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<DeleteEventIslamicAspectCommand, bool>
13: {
14:     private readonly IEventIslamicAspectRepository _islamicAspectRepository;
15: 
16:     public DeleteEventIslamicAspectCommandHandler(IEventIslamicAspectRepository islamicAspectRepository)
17:     {
18:         _islamicAspectRepository = islamicAspectRepository;
19:     }
20: 
21:     public async Task<bool> Handle(DeleteEventIslamicAspectCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
22:     {
23:         var aspect = await _islamicAspectRepository.GetById(request.EventId);
24: 
25:         if (aspect == null)
26:         {
27:             return false;
28:         }
29: 
30: 
31:         await _islamicAspectRepository.HardDelete(aspect);
32: 
33:         return true;
34:     }
35: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/GroupMembers/Handlers/Commands/AddGroupMemberCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
  1: using System;
  2: using System.Linq;
  3: using System.Threading;
  4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
  5: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Identity;
  6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
  7: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  8: using Explore.Application.Features.GroupMembers.Requests.Commands;
  9: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 10: using Explore.Domain;
 11: using Explore.Domain.Constants;
 12: using Explore.Domain.Enums;
 13: using MediatR;
 14: 
 15: namespace Explore.Application.Features.GroupMembers.Handlers.Commands;
 16: 
 17: public class AddGroupMemberCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AddGroupMemberCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
 18: {
 19:     private readonly IGroupRepository _groupRepository;
 20:     private readonly IGroupMemberRepository _groupMemberRepository;
 21:     private readonly IUserRepository _userRepository;
 22:     private readonly IUserContext _userContext;
 23:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
 24: 
 25:     public AddGroupMemberCommandHandler(
 26:         IGroupRepository groupRepository,
 27:         IGroupMemberRepository groupMemberRepository,
 28:         IUserRepository userRepository,
 29:         IUserContext userContext,
 30:         ITenantContext tenantContext)
 31:     {
 32:         _groupRepository = groupRepository;
 33:         _groupMemberRepository = groupMemberRepository;
 34:         _userRepository = userRepository;
 35:         _userContext = userContext;
 36:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
 37:     }
 38: 
 39:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(AddGroupMemberCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 40:     {
 41:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
 42:         var dto = request.AddGroupMemberDto;
 43: 
 44:         var group = await _groupRepository.GetById(dto.GroupId);
 45:         if (group == null)
 46:         {
 47:             response.Success = false;
 48:             response.Message = "Group not found";
 49:             return response;
 50:         }
 51: 
 52:         if (!Guid.TryParse(request.RequesterUserId, out Guid requesterGuid))
 53:         {
 54:             response.Success = false;
 55:             response.Message = "Invalid requester User ID.";
 56:             return response;
 57:         }
 58: 
 59:         var hasPermission = await _groupMemberRepository.HasPermissionInGroup(
 60:             dto.GroupId, requesterGuid, PermissionCodes.GroupMemberCreate);
 61: 
 62:         if (!hasPermission)
 63:         {
 64: 
 65:             var requesterMember = await _groupMemberRepository.GetByGroupAndUser(dto.GroupId, requesterGuid);
 66:             if (requesterMember == null ||
 67:                 (requesterMember.RoleId != (int)RoleEnum.GroupCreator &&
 68:                  requesterMember.RoleId != (int)RoleEnum.GroupAdmin))
 69:             {
 70:                 response.Success = false;
 71:                 response.Message = "You do not have permission to add members.";
 72:                 return response;
 73:             }
 74:         }
 75: 
 76:         var userToAdd = await _userRepository.GetUserByEmail(dto.Email);
 77:         if (userToAdd == null)
 78:         {
 79:             response.Success = false;
 80:             response.Message = "User with this email not found.";
 81:             return response;
 82:         }
 83: 
 84:         var alreadyMember = await _groupMemberRepository.Exists(dto.GroupId, userToAdd.Id);
 85:         if (alreadyMember)
 86:         {
 87:             response.Success = false;
 88:             response.Message = "User is already a member of this group.";
 89:             return response;
 90:         }
 91: 
 92:         var groupMember = new GroupMember
 93:         {
 94:             GroupId = dto.GroupId,
 95:             Group = null!,
 96:             UserId = userToAdd.Id,
 97:             User = null!,
 98:             RoleId = (int)dto.Role,
 99:             Role = null!,
100:             TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId,
101:             Tenant = null!
102:         };
103: 
104:         groupMember = await _groupMemberRepository.Create(groupMember);
105: 
106:         response.Success = true;
107:         response.Message = "Member added successfully";
108:         response.Id = groupMember.Id;
109: 
110:         return response;
111:     }
112: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/GroupMembers/Handlers/Commands/DeleteGroupMemberCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Identity;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 7: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 8: using Explore.Application.Features.GroupMembers.Requests.Commands;
 9: using Explore.Application.Responses;
10: using Explore.Domain.Constants;
11: using Explore.Domain.Enums;
12: using MediatR;
13: 
14: namespace Explore.Application.Features.GroupMembers.Handlers.Commands;
15: 
16: public class DeleteGroupMemberCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<DeleteGroupMemberCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
17: {
18:     private readonly IGroupMemberRepository _groupMemberRepository;
19:     private readonly IUserContext _userContext;
20:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
21: 
22:     public DeleteGroupMemberCommandHandler(
23:         IGroupMemberRepository groupMemberRepository,
24:         IUserContext userContext,
25:         ITenantContext tenantContext)
26:     {
27:         _groupMemberRepository = groupMemberRepository;
28:         _userContext = userContext;
29:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
30:     }
31: 
32:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(DeleteGroupMemberCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
33:     {
34:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
35: 
36:         var memberToDelete = await _groupMemberRepository.GetById(request.MemberId);
37:         if (memberToDelete == null)
38:         {
39:             response.Success = false;
40:             response.Message = "Member not found";
41:             return response;
42:         }
43: 
44:         if (!Guid.TryParse(request.RequesterUserId, out Guid requesterGuid))
45:         {
46:             response.Success = false;
47:             response.Message = "Invalid requester User ID.";
48:             return response;
49:         }
50: 
51:         var hasPermission = await _groupMemberRepository.HasPermissionInGroup(
52:             memberToDelete.GroupId, requesterGuid, PermissionCodes.GroupMemberDelete);
53: 
54:         if (!hasPermission)
55:         {
56: 
57:             var requesterMember = await _groupMemberRepository.GetByGroupAndUser(memberToDelete.GroupId, requesterGuid);
58:             if (requesterMember == null ||
59:                 (requesterMember.RoleId != (int)RoleEnum.GroupCreator &&
60:                  requesterMember.RoleId != (int)RoleEnum.GroupAdmin))
61:             {
62:                 response.Success = false;
63:                 response.Message = "You do not have permission to remove members.";
64:                 return response;
65:             }
66:         }
67: 
68: 
69:         var members = await _groupMemberRepository.GetMembersByGroupId(memberToDelete.GroupId);
70:         var adminCount = members.Count(m =>
71:             m.RoleId == (int)RoleEnum.GroupCreator || m.RoleId == (int)RoleEnum.GroupAdmin);
72: 
73:         if ((memberToDelete.RoleId == (int)RoleEnum.GroupCreator || memberToDelete.RoleId == (int)RoleEnum.GroupAdmin) &&
74:             adminCount <= 1)
75:         {
76:             response.Success = false;
77:             response.Message = "Cannot remove the last admin of the group.";
78:             return response;
79:         }
80: 
81:         await _groupMemberRepository.Delete(memberToDelete);
82: 
83:         response.Success = true;
84:         response.Message = "Member removed successfully";
85:         response.Id = memberToDelete.Id;
86: 
87:         return response;
88:     }
89: }
````

````csharp
20:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
21: 
22:     public UpdateGroupMemberRoleCommandHandler(
23:         IGroupMemberRepository groupMemberRepository,
24:         IUserContext userContext,
25:         ITenantContext tenantContext)
26:     {
27:         _groupMemberRepository = groupMemberRepository;
28:         _userContext = userContext;
29:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
30:     }
31: 
32:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateGroupMemberRoleCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
33:     {
34:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
35:         var dto = request.UpdateGroupMemberRoleDto;
36: 
37:         var memberToUpdate = await _groupMemberRepository.GetById(dto.Id);
38:         if (memberToUpdate == null)
39:         {
40:             response.Success = false;
41:             response.Message = "Member not found";
42:             return response;
43:         }
44: 
45:         if (!Guid.TryParse(request.RequesterUserId, out Guid requesterGuid))
46:         {
47:             response.Success = false;
48:             response.Message = "Invalid requester User ID.";
49:             return response;
50:         }
51: 
52:         var hasPermission = await _groupMemberRepository.HasPermissionInGroup(
53:             memberToUpdate.GroupId, requesterGuid, PermissionCodes.GroupMemberUpdate);
54: 
55:         if (!hasPermission)
56:         {
57: 
58:             var requesterMember = await _groupMemberRepository.GetByGroupAndUser(memberToUpdate.GroupId, requesterGuid);
59:             if (requesterMember == null ||
60:                 (requesterMember.RoleId != (int)RoleEnum.GroupCreator &&
61:                  requesterMember.RoleId != (int)RoleEnum.GroupAdmin))
62:             {
63:                 response.Success = false;
64:                 response.Message = "You do not have permission to update roles.";
65:                 return response;
66:             }
67:         }
68: 
69: 
70:         var members = await _groupMemberRepository.GetMembersByGroupId(memberToUpdate.GroupId);
71:         var adminCount = members.Count(m =>
72:             m.RoleId == (int)RoleEnum.GroupCreator || m.RoleId == (int)RoleEnum.GroupAdmin);
73: 
74:         if ((memberToUpdate.RoleId == (int)RoleEnum.GroupCreator || memberToUpdate.RoleId == (int)RoleEnum.GroupAdmin) &&
75:             (int)dto.Role != (int)RoleEnum.GroupCreator &&
76:             (int)dto.Role != (int)RoleEnum.GroupAdmin &&
77:             adminCount <= 1)
78:         {
79:             response.Success = false;
80:             response.Message = "Cannot demote the last admin of the group.";
81:             return response;
82:         }
83: 
84:         memberToUpdate.RoleId = (int)dto.Role;
85:         await _groupMemberRepository.Update(memberToUpdate);
86: 
87:         response.Success = true;
88:         response.Message = "Member role updated successfully";
89:         response.Id = memberToUpdate.Id;
90: 
91:         return response;
92:     }
93: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Groups/Handlers/Commands/CreateGroupCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
  1: using AutoMapper;
  2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Identity;
  3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
  4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  5: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Group.Validators;
  6: using Explore.Application.Features.Groups.Requests.Commands;
  7: using Explore.Application.Responses;
  8: using Explore.Application.Telemetry;
  9: using Explore.Domain;
 10: using Explore.Domain.Enums;
 11: using MediatR;
 12: using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Hybrid;
 13: 
 14: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Groups.Handlers.Commands;
 15: 
 16: public class CreateGroupCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateGroupCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
 17: {
 18:     private readonly IGroupRepository _groupRepository;
 19:     private readonly IGroupMemberRepository _groupMemberRepository;
 20:     private readonly IActorRepository _actorRepository;
 21:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
 22:     private readonly IUserContext _userContext;
 23:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
 24:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
 25:     private readonly HybridCache _cache;
 26:     private readonly BusinessMetrics _metrics;
 27: 
 28:     public CreateGroupCommandHandler(
 29:         IGroupRepository groupRepository,
 30:         IGroupMemberRepository groupMemberRepository,
 31:         IActorRepository actorRepository,
 32:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository,
 33:         IUserContext userContext,
 34:         IMapper mapper,
 35:         ITenantContext tenantContext,
 36:         HybridCache cache,
 37:         BusinessMetrics metrics)
 38:     {
 39:         _groupRepository = groupRepository;
 40:         _groupMemberRepository = groupMemberRepository;
 41:         _actorRepository = actorRepository;
 42:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
 43:         _userContext = userContext;
 44:         _mapper = mapper;
 45:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
 46:         _cache = cache;
 47:         _metrics = metrics;
 48:     }
 49: 
 50:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(CreateGroupCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 51:     {
 52:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
 53: 
 54:         var validator = new CreateGroupDtoValidator();
 55:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.GroupDto, cancellationToken);
 56:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
 57:         {
 58:             response.Success = false;
 59:             response.Message = "Validation failed.";
 60:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
 61:             return response;
 62:         }
 63: 
 64:         var currentUserId = _userContext.GetRequiredUserId();
 65: 
 66:         var group = _mapper.Map<Group>(request.GroupDto);
 67: 
 68:         group.ApprovalStatusId = (int)ApprovalStatusEnum.Pending;
 69:         group.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
 70:         group.CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
 71: 
 72:         group = await _groupRepository.Create(group);
 73: 
 74:         var groupActor = new Actor
 75:         {
 76:             ActorTypeId = (int)ActorTypeEnum.Group,
 77:             ActorType = null!,
 78:             TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId,
 79:             Tenant = null!,
 80:             DisplayName = group.FullName,
 81:             Handle = GenerateHandle(group.FullName),
 82:             Description = null,
 83:             UserId = null,
 84:             OrganizationId = null,
 85:             GroupId = group.Id,
 86:             ProfilePictureId = request.GroupDto.ProfilePictureId
 87:         };
 88: 
 89:         groupActor = await _actorRepository.Create(groupActor);
 90: 
 91:         group.ActorId = groupActor.Id;
 92:         await _groupRepository.Update(group);
 93: 
 94:         if (request.GroupDto.ProfilePictureId.HasValue)
 95:         {
 96:             var storageObject = await _storageObjectRepository.GetById(request.GroupDto.ProfilePictureId.Value);
 97:             if (storageObject != null)
 98:             {
 99:                 storageObject.ActorId = groupActor.Id;
100:                 await _storageObjectRepository.Update(storageObject);
101:             }
102:         }
103: 
104:         var groupMember = new GroupMember
105:         {
106:             GroupId = group.Id,
107:             Group = null!,
108:             UserId = currentUserId,
109:             User = null!,
110:             RoleId = (int)RoleEnum.GroupCreator,
111:             Role = null!,
112:             TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId,
113:             Tenant = null!
114:         };
115: 
116:         await _groupMemberRepository.Create(groupMember);
117: 
118:         response.Success = true;
119:         response.Message = "Group created successfully. You are now the creator and admin of this group.";
120:         response.Id = group.Id;
121: 
122:         _metrics.RecordOrganizationCreated(_tenantContext.TenantId.ToString());
123: 
124:         await _cache.RemoveAsync($"group:detail:{group.Id}", cancellationToken);
125: 
126:         return response;
127:     }
128: 
129:     private string GenerateHandle(string name)
130:     {
131:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
132:             return $"grp-{Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8)}";
133: 
134:         var handle = name.ToLowerInvariant()
135:             .Replace(" ", "-")
136:             .Replace("'", "")
137:             .Replace("\"", "")
138:             .Replace(".", "")
139:             .Replace(",", "");
140: 
141:         handle = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(handle, @"[^a-z0-9\-]", "");
142: 
143:         if (handle.Length > 20)
144:             handle = handle.Substring(0, 20);
145: 
146:         return $"{handle}-{Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 6)}";
147:     }
148: }
````

````csharp
 1: using AutoMapper;
 2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 4: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Group;

 9: 
10: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Groups.Handlers.Queries;
11: 
12: public class GetGroupDetailsRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetGroupDetailsRequest, GroupDto>
13: {
14:     private readonly IGroupRepository _groupRepository;
15:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
16:     private readonly IObjectStorageService _objectStorageService;
17:     private readonly ILogger<GetGroupDetailsRequestHandler> _logger;
18:     private readonly HybridCache _cache;
19: 
20:     public GetGroupDetailsRequestHandler(
21:         IGroupRepository groupRepository,
22:         IMapper mapper,
23:         IObjectStorageService objectStorageService,
24:         ILogger<GetGroupDetailsRequestHandler> logger,
25:         HybridCache cache)
26:     {
27:         _groupRepository = groupRepository;
28:         _mapper = mapper;
29:         _objectStorageService = objectStorageService;
30:         _logger = logger;
31:         _cache = cache;
32:     }
33: 
34:     public async Task<GroupDto> Handle(GetGroupDetailsRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
35:     {
36:         var cacheKey = $"group:detail:{request.Id}";
37:         var dto = await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
38:             cacheKey,
39:             async _ =>
40:             {
41:                 var group = await _groupRepository.GetGroupWithDetails(request.Id);
42:                 return _mapper.Map<GroupDto>(group);
43:             },
44:             new HybridCacheEntryOptions
45:             {
46:                 Expiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
47:                 LocalCacheExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
48:             },
49:             cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
50: 
51:         if (dto != null)
52:         {
53:             dto.ActorProfilePictureUri = await ResolveImageUrl(dto.ActorProfilePictureUri);
54:         }
55: 
56:         return dto;
57:     }
58: 
59:     private async Task<string?> ResolveImageUrl(string? objectKeyOrUri)
60:     {
61:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(objectKeyOrUri))
62:             return null;
63: 
64:         try
65:         {
66:             if (objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
67:                 objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
68:             {
69:                 if (Uri.TryCreate(objectKeyOrUri, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
70:                 {
71:                     var objectKey = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
72:                     return await _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKey, 60);
73:                 }
74:                 return objectKeyOrUri;
75:             }
76: 
77:             return await _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKeyOrUri, 60);
78:         }
79:         catch (Exception ex)
80:         {
81:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to generate presigned URL for object key: {ObjectKey}", objectKeyOrUri);
82:             return null;
83:         }
84:     }
85: }
````

````csharp
35:     public async Task<PaginatedResult<GroupListDto>> Handle(GetMyGroupsRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
36:     {
37:         if (!Guid.TryParse(request.UserId, out Guid userGuid))
38:         {
39:             return PaginatedResult<GroupListDto>.Create(new List<GroupListDto>(), 0, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
40:         }
41: 
42:         var (groups, totalCount) = await _groupRepository.GetMyGroupsPaged(userGuid, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
43: 
44:         var memberships = await _groupMemberRepository.GetMembershipsByUser(userGuid);
45:         var membershipDict = memberships.ToDictionary(m => m.GroupId, m => m.RoleId);
46: 
47:         var dtos = new List<GroupListDto>();
48:         foreach (var group in groups)
49:         {
50:             var dto = _mapper.Map<GroupListDto>(group);
51:             if (membershipDict.TryGetValue(group.Id, out var roleId))
52:             {
53:                 dto.CurrentUserRole = (RoleEnum)roleId;
54:             }
55:             dto.ActorProfilePictureUri = await ResolveImageUrl(dto.ActorProfilePictureUri);
56:             dtos.Add(dto);
57:         }
58: 
59:         return PaginatedResult<GroupListDto>.Create(dtos, totalCount, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
60:     }
61: 
62:     private async Task<string?> ResolveImageUrl(string? objectKeyOrUri)
63:     {
64:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(objectKeyOrUri))
65:             return null;
66: 
67:         try
68:         {
69:             if (objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
70:                 objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
71:             {
72:                 if (Uri.TryCreate(objectKeyOrUri, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
73:                 {
74:                     var objectKey = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
75:                     return await _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKey, 60);
76:                 }
77:                 return objectKeyOrUri;
78:             }
79: 
80:             return await _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKeyOrUri, 60);
81:         }
82:         catch (Exception ex)
83:         {
84:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to generate presigned URL for object key: {ObjectKey}", objectKeyOrUri);
85:             return null;
86:         }
87:     }
88: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/InstanceOnboarding/Common/InstanceStorageSettingHelpers.cs
````csharp
  1: using System.Text.Json;
  2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  3: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Onboarding;
  4: using Explore.Domain;
  5: using Explore.Domain.Constants;
  6: 
  7: namespace Explore.Application.Features.InstanceOnboarding.Common;
  8: 
  9: internal static class InstanceStorageSettingHelpers
 10: {
 11:     internal static async Task<InstanceStorageSettingsDto> ReadSettingsAsync(
 12:         ISystemSettingRepository systemSettingRepository)
 13:     {
 14:         var endpoint = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3Endpoint);
 15:         var publicEndpoint = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3PublicEndpoint);
 16:         var bucketName = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3BucketName);
 17:         var accessKeyId = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3AccessKeyId);
 18:         var secretAccessKey = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3SecretAccessKey);
 19:         var region = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3Region);
 20:         var forcePathStyle = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3ForcePathStyle);
 21:         var uploadExpiration = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3UploadUrlExpirationMinutes);
 22: 
 23:         return new InstanceStorageSettingsDto
 24:         {
 25:             S3Endpoint = InstanceGovernanceSettingHelpers.DeserializeString(endpoint?.Value, string.Empty),
 26:             S3PublicEndpoint = InstanceGovernanceSettingHelpers.DeserializeString(publicEndpoint?.Value, string.Empty),
 27:             S3BucketName = InstanceGovernanceSettingHelpers.DeserializeString(bucketName?.Value, string.Empty),
 28:             S3AccessKeyId = InstanceGovernanceSettingHelpers.DeserializeString(accessKeyId?.Value, string.Empty),
 29:             S3SecretAccessKey = InstanceGovernanceSettingHelpers.DeserializeString(secretAccessKey?.Value, string.Empty),
 30:             S3Region = InstanceGovernanceSettingHelpers.DeserializeString(region?.Value, "fsn1"),
 31:             S3ForcePathStyle = InstanceGovernanceSettingHelpers.DeserializeBoolean(forcePathStyle?.Value, true),
 32:             S3UploadUrlExpirationMinutes = InstanceGovernanceSettingHelpers.DeserializeInt(uploadExpiration?.Value, 60)
 33:         };
 34:     }
 35: 
 36:     internal static async Task ApplySettingsAsync(
 37:         ISystemSettingRepository systemSettingRepository,
 38:         InstanceStorageSettingsDto settings)
 39:     {
 40:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(systemSettingRepository, GovernanceSettingKeys.S3Endpoint,
 41:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.S3Endpoint.Trim()), SettingValueType.String, false,
 42:             "ObjectStorage", 1, "S3-compatible endpoint URL (e.g., https://fsn1.your-objectstorage.com)");
 43: 
 44:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(systemSettingRepository, GovernanceSettingKeys.S3PublicEndpoint,
 45:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.S3PublicEndpoint.Trim()), SettingValueType.String, false,
 46:             "ObjectStorage", 2, "Public endpoint for presigned URLs (if different from internal endpoint)");
 47: 
 48:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(systemSettingRepository, GovernanceSettingKeys.S3BucketName,
 49:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.S3BucketName.Trim()), SettingValueType.String, false,
 50:             "ObjectStorage", 3, "S3 bucket name for object storage");
 51: 
 52:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(systemSettingRepository, GovernanceSettingKeys.S3AccessKeyId,
 53:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.S3AccessKeyId.Trim()), SettingValueType.String, false,
 54:             "ObjectStorage", 4, "S3 access key ID for authentication");
 55: 
 56:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(systemSettingRepository, GovernanceSettingKeys.S3SecretAccessKey,
 57:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.S3SecretAccessKey.Trim()), SettingValueType.String, false,
 58:             "ObjectStorage", 5, "S3 secret access key for authentication");
 59: 
 60:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(systemSettingRepository, GovernanceSettingKeys.S3Region,
 61:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.S3Region.Trim()), SettingValueType.String, false,
 62:             "ObjectStorage", 6, "S3 region identifier (e.g., fsn1 for Hetzner, us-east-1 for AWS)");
 63: 
 64:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(systemSettingRepository, GovernanceSettingKeys.S3ForcePathStyle,
 65:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.S3ForcePathStyle), SettingValueType.Boolean, false,
 66:             "ObjectStorage", 7, "Use path-style URLs (required by most non-AWS S3 providers)");
 67: 
 68:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(systemSettingRepository, GovernanceSettingKeys.S3UploadUrlExpirationMinutes,
 69:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.S3UploadUrlExpirationMinutes > 0 ? settings.S3UploadUrlExpirationMinutes : 60),
 70:             SettingValueType.Integer, false,
 71:             "ObjectStorage", 8, "Presigned upload URL expiration time in minutes");
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     private static async Task UpsertSystemSettingAsync(
 75:         ISystemSettingRepository systemSettingRepository,
 76:         string settingKey,
 77:         string value,
 78:         SettingValueType valueType,
 79:         bool isLocked,
 80:         string category,
 81:         int displayOrder,
 82:         string description)
 83:     {
 84:         var existing = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(settingKey);
 85: 
 86:         if (existing == null)
 87:         {
 88:             await systemSettingRepository.Create(new SystemSetting
 89:             {
 90:                 SettingKey = settingKey,
 91:                 Value = value,
 92:                 ValueType = valueType,
 93:                 IsLocked = isLocked,
 94:                 Description = description,
 95:                 Category = category,
 96:                 DisplayOrder = displayOrder,
 97:                 CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
 98:             });
 99: 
100:             return;
101:         }
102: 
103:         existing.Value = value;
104:         existing.ValueType = valueType;
105:         existing.IsLocked = isLocked;
106:         existing.Description = description;
107:         existing.Category = category;
108:         existing.DisplayOrder = displayOrder;
109:         existing.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
110: 
111:         await systemSettingRepository.Update(existing);
112:     }
113: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/OrganizationMembers/Handlers/Commands/AcceptInvitationCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Threading;
 3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 5: using Explore.Application.Features.OrganizationMembers.Requests.Commands;
 6: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 7: using MediatR;
 8: 
 9: namespace Explore.Application.Features.OrganizationMembers.Handlers.Commands;
10: 
11: public class AcceptInvitationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AcceptInvitationCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
12: {
13:     private readonly IOrganizationMemberRepository _organizationMemberRepository;
14: 
15:     public AcceptInvitationCommandHandler(IOrganizationMemberRepository organizationMemberRepository)
16:     {
17:         _organizationMemberRepository = organizationMemberRepository;
18:     }
19: 
20:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(AcceptInvitationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
21:     {
22:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
23:         var invitation = await _organizationMemberRepository.GetById(request.InvitationId);
24: 
25:         if (invitation == null)
26:         {
27:             response.Success = false;
28:             response.Message = "Invitation not found";
29:             return response;
30:         }
31: 
32:         if (invitation.UserId != Guid.Empty)
33:         {
34:             response.Success = false;
35:             response.Message = "Invitation already accepted";
36:             return response;
37:         }
38: 
39:         invitation.UserId = request.UserId;
40:         await _organizationMemberRepository.Update(invitation);
41: 
42:         response.Success = true;
43:         response.Message = "Invitation accepted";
44:         response.Id = invitation.Id;
45: 
46:         return response;
47:     }
48: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Permissions/Handlers/Queries/GetPermissionListRequestHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using AutoMapper;
 2: using Explore.Application.Authorization;
 3: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Permission;
 4: using Explore.Application.Features.Permissions.Requests.Queries;
 5: using MediatR;
 6: 
 7: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Permissions.Handlers.Queries;
 8: 
 9: public class GetPermissionListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetPermissionListRequest, List<PermissionListDto>>
10: {
11:     private readonly IPermissionRegistryService _permissionRegistry;
12:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
13: 
14:     public GetPermissionListRequestHandler(
15:         IPermissionRegistryService permissionRegistry,
16:         IMapper mapper)
17:     {
18:         _permissionRegistry = permissionRegistry;
19:         _mapper = mapper;
20:     }
21: 
22:     public async Task<List<PermissionListDto>> Handle(GetPermissionListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
23:     {
24:         var permissions = await _permissionRegistry.GetFilteredPermissionsAsync(
25:             request.Scope,
26:             request.ExcludeFiltered);
27: 
28:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.GroupName))
29:         {
30:             permissions = permissions
31:                 .Where(p => p.GroupName == request.GroupName)
32:                 .ToList()
33:                 .AsReadOnly();
34:         }
35: 
36:         return _mapper.Map<List<PermissionListDto>>(permissions);
37:     }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Roles/Handlers/Commands/CreateCustomRoleCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
  1: using Explore.Application.Authorization;
  2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
  3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  4: using Explore.Application.Features.Roles.Requests.Commands;
  5: using Explore.Application.Responses;
  6: using Explore.Domain;
  7: using Explore.Domain.Enums;
  8: using MediatR;
  9: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 10: 
 11: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Roles.Handlers.Commands;
 12: 
 13: public class CreateCustomRoleCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateCustomRoleCommand, BaseCommandResponse<int>>
 14: {
 15:     private readonly IRoleRepository _roleRepository;
 16:     private readonly ICapabilityCeilingService _capabilityCeiling;
 17:     private readonly IPolicySyncService _policySyncService;
 18:     private readonly IPermissionRegistryService _permissionRegistry;
 19:     private readonly ILogger<CreateCustomRoleCommandHandler> _logger;
 20: 
 21:     public CreateCustomRoleCommandHandler(
 22:         IRoleRepository roleRepository,
 23:         ICapabilityCeilingService capabilityCeiling,
 24:         IPolicySyncService policySyncService,
 25:         IPermissionRegistryService permissionRegistry,
 26:         ILogger<CreateCustomRoleCommandHandler> logger)
 27:     {
 28:         _roleRepository = roleRepository;
 29:         _capabilityCeiling = capabilityCeiling;
 30:         _policySyncService = policySyncService;
 31:         _permissionRegistry = permissionRegistry;
 32:         _logger = logger;
 33:     }
 34: 
 35:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<int>> Handle(CreateCustomRoleCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 36:     {
 37:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<int>();
 38: 
 39: 
 40:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.FullName))
 41:         {
 42:             response.Success = false;
 43:             response.Message = "Role name is required.";
 44:             return response;
 45:         }
 46: 
 47: 
 48:         var scopePrefix = request.Scope switch
 49:         {
 50:             RoleScopeEnum.Platform => "platform",
 51:             RoleScopeEnum.Tenant => "tenant",
 52:             RoleScopeEnum.Organization => "org",
 53:             _ => "custom"
 54:         };
 55:         var masterCode = $"{scopePrefix}.custom.{request.FullName.ToLowerInvariant().Replace(' ', '_')}";
 56: 
 57: 
 58:         var existing = await _roleRepository.GetByMasterCodeAsync(masterCode);
 59:         if (existing != null)
 60:         {
 61:             response.Success = false;
 62:             response.Message = $"A role with code '{masterCode}' already exists.";
 63:             return response;
 64:         }
 65: 
 66: 
 67:         var ceilingErrors = await _capabilityCeiling.ValidatePermissionAssignmentAsync(
 68:             request.CallerRoleIds,
 69:             request.CallerHighestScope,
 70:             request.PermissionIds,
 71:             request.Scope);
 72: 
 73:         if (ceilingErrors.Count > 0)
 74:         {
 75:             response.Success = false;
 76:             response.Message = "Permission assignment validation failed.";
 77:             response.Errors = ceilingErrors;
 78:             return response;
 79:         }
 80: 
 81: 
 82:         var role = new Role
 83:         {
 84:             MasterCode = masterCode,
 85:             FullName = request.FullName,
 86:             Description = request.Description,
 87:             Scope = request.Scope,
 88:             IsSystem = false
 89:         };
 90: 
 91:         role = await _roleRepository.Create(role);
 92: 
 93: 
 94:         if (request.PermissionIds.Count > 0)
 95:         {
 96:             await _roleRepository.AssignPermissionsAsync(role.Id, request.PermissionIds);
 97:         }
 98: 
 99: 
100:         try
101:         {
102:             await _policySyncService.SyncRolePoliciesAsync(role.Id, cancellationToken);
103:         }
104:         catch (Exception ex)
105:         {
106:             _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Policy sync failed for new role {RoleId}, will retry on next sync", role.Id);
107:         }
108: 
109: 
110:         _permissionRegistry.InvalidateCache();
111: 
112:         response.Success = true;
113:         response.Id = role.Id;
114:         response.Message = $"Custom role '{role.FullName}' created with {request.PermissionIds.Count} permissions.";
115: 
116:         return response;
117:     }
118: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Roles/Handlers/Commands/DeleteCustomRoleCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using Explore.Application.Authorization;
 2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 4: using Explore.Application.Features.Roles.Requests.Commands;
 5: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 6: using MediatR;
 7: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 8: 
 9: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Roles.Handlers.Commands;
10: 
11: public class DeleteCustomRoleCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<DeleteCustomRoleCommand, BaseCommandResponse<int>>
12: {
13:     private readonly IRoleRepository _roleRepository;
14:     private readonly ICapabilityCeilingService _capabilityCeiling;
15:     private readonly IPolicySyncService _policySyncService;
16:     private readonly IPermissionRegistryService _permissionRegistry;
17:     private readonly ILogger<DeleteCustomRoleCommandHandler> _logger;
18: 
19:     public DeleteCustomRoleCommandHandler(
20:         IRoleRepository roleRepository,
21:         ICapabilityCeilingService capabilityCeiling,
22:         IPolicySyncService policySyncService,
23:         IPermissionRegistryService permissionRegistry,
24:         ILogger<DeleteCustomRoleCommandHandler> logger)
25:     {
26:         _roleRepository = roleRepository;
27:         _capabilityCeiling = capabilityCeiling;
28:         _policySyncService = policySyncService;
29:         _permissionRegistry = permissionRegistry;
30:         _logger = logger;
31:     }
32: 
33:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<int>> Handle(DeleteCustomRoleCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
34:     {
35:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<int>();
36: 
37: 
38:         var modCheck = await _capabilityCeiling.CanModifyRoleAsync(request.RoleId);
39:         if (!modCheck.IsAllowed)
40:         {
41:             response.Success = false;
42:             response.Message = modCheck.Error!;
43:             return response;
44:         }
45: 
46:         var role = await _roleRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.RoleId);
47:         if (role == null)
48:         {
49:             response.Success = false;
50:             response.Message = "Role not found.";
51:             return response;
52:         }
53: 
54: 
55:         var hasMembers = await _roleRepository.HasActiveMembersAsync(request.RoleId);
56:         if (hasMembers)
57:         {
58:             response.Success = false;
59:             response.Message = $"Cannot delete role '{role.FullName}'. It still has active members assigned.";
60:             return response;
61:         }
62: 
63: 
64:         await _roleRepository.RemoveAllPermissionsAsync(request.RoleId);
65: 
66: 
67:         await _roleRepository.HardDelete(role);
68: 
69: 
70:         try
71:         {
72:             await _policySyncService.SyncRolePoliciesAsync(request.RoleId, cancellationToken);
73:         }
74:         catch (Exception ex)
75:         {
76:             _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Policy sync failed after deleting role {RoleId}, will retry on next sync", request.RoleId);
77:         }
78: 
79: 
80:         _permissionRegistry.InvalidateCache();
81: 
82:         response.Success = true;
83:         response.Id = request.RoleId;
84:         response.Message = $"Custom role '{role.FullName}' deleted.";
85: 
86:         return response;
87:     }
88: }
````
