````csharp
 18: 
 19: public sealed class PolicySyncService : IPolicySyncService
 20: {
 21:     private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
 22:     private readonly CerbosAdminApiSettings _settings;
 23:     private readonly IRoleRepository _roleRepository;
 24:     private readonly IAdminCacheInvalidator _cacheInvalidator;
 25:     private readonly ILogger<PolicySyncService> _logger;
 26: 
 27:     public PolicySyncService(
 28:         IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory,
 29:         IOptions<CerbosAdminApiSettings> settings,
 30:         IRoleRepository roleRepository,
 31:         IAdminCacheInvalidator cacheInvalidator,
 32:         ILogger<PolicySyncService> logger)
 33:     {
 34:         _httpClient = httpClientFactory.CreateClient("CerbosAdminClient");
 35:         _settings = settings.Value;
 36:         _roleRepository = roleRepository;
 37:         _cacheInvalidator = cacheInvalidator;
 38:         _logger = logger;
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     public async Task SyncAllPoliciesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 42:     {
 43:         _logger.LogInformation("Starting full policy sync to Cerbos");
 44: 
 45:         try
 46:         {
 47:             var roles = await _roleRepository.GetAllAsync();
 48:             var syncedCount = 0;
 49: 
 50:             foreach (var role in roles)
 51:             {
 52:                 await SyncRolePoliciesAsync(role.Id, cancellationToken);
 53:                 syncedCount++;
 54:             }
 55: 
 56:             await ReloadAllInstancesAsync(cancellationToken);
 57: 
 58: 
 59:             _cacheInvalidator.InvalidateAll();
 60: 
 61:             _logger.LogInformation("Full policy sync completed. Synced {Count} roles", syncedCount);
 62:         }
 63:         catch (Exception ex)
 64:         {
 65:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Full policy sync failed. Cerbos policies may be stale");
 66:         }
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     public async Task SyncRolePoliciesAsync(int roleId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 70:     {
 71:         _logger.LogDebug("Syncing policies for role {RoleId}", roleId);
 72: 
 73:         try
 74:         {
 75:             var role = await _roleRepository.GetByIdAsync(roleId);
 76:             if (role is null)
 77:             {
 78:                 _logger.LogWarning("Role {RoleId} not found. Skipping policy sync", roleId);
 79:                 return;
 80:             }
 81: 
 82:             var permissions = await _roleRepository.GetPermissionsForRoleAsync(roleId);
 83:             if (permissions.Count == 0)
 84:             {
 85:                 _logger.LogDebug("Role {RoleId} ({MasterCode}) has no permissions. Skipping", roleId, role.MasterCode);
 86:                 return;
 87:             }
 88: 
 89: 
 90:             var derivedRolePolicy = GenerateDerivedRolePolicy(role, permissions);
 91: 
 92: 
 93:             await PushPolicyAsync(derivedRolePolicy, cancellationToken);
 94: 
 95:             _logger.LogInformation(
 96:                 "Synced policies for role {RoleId} ({MasterCode}) with {Count} permissions",
 97:                 roleId, role.MasterCode, permissions.Count);
 98:         }
 99:         catch (Exception ex)
100:         {
101: 
102:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to sync policies for role {RoleId}. Cerbos policies may be stale", roleId);
103:         }
104:     }
105: 
106:     public async Task ReloadAllInstancesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
107:     {
108:         if (_settings.Endpoints.Count == 0)
109:         {
110:             _logger.LogDebug("No Cerbos endpoints configured for reload broadcast");
111:             return;
112:         }
113: 
114:         _logger.LogInformation("Broadcasting reload to {Count} Cerbos instance(s)", _settings.Endpoints.Count);
115: 
116:         var tasks = _settings.Endpoints.Select(endpoint =>
117:             ReloadInstanceAsync(endpoint, cancellationToken));
118: 
119:         var results = await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
120:         var succeeded = results.Count(r => r);
121:         var failed = results.Length - succeeded;
122: 
123:         if (failed > 0)
124:         {
125:             _logger.LogWarning("Reload broadcast: {Succeeded} succeeded, {Failed} failed", succeeded, failed);
126:         }
127:         else
128:         {
129:             _logger.LogInformation("Reload broadcast: all {Count} instances reloaded", succeeded);
130:         }
131:     }
132: 
133:     private async Task<bool> ReloadInstanceAsync(string endpoint, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
134:     {
135:         try
136:         {
137:             using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, $"{endpoint}/admin/store/reload?wait=true");
138:             AddBasicAuth(request);
139: 
140:             using var response = await _httpClient.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
141: 
142:             if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
143:             {
144:                 _logger.LogDebug("Reloaded Cerbos instance at {Endpoint}", endpoint);
145:                 return true;
146:             }
147: 
148:             _logger.LogWarning("Failed to reload Cerbos instance at {Endpoint}: {StatusCode}", endpoint, response.StatusCode);
149:             return false;
150:         }
151:         catch (Exception ex)
152:         {
153:             _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Failed to contact Cerbos instance at {Endpoint} for reload", endpoint);
154:             return false;
155:         }
156:     }
157: 
158:     private async Task PushPolicyAsync(object policy, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
159:     {
160:         if (_settings.Endpoints.Count == 0)
161:         {
162:             _logger.LogDebug("No Cerbos endpoints configured for policy push");
163:             return;
164:         }
165: 
166:         var endpoint = _settings.Endpoints[0];
167:         using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, $"{endpoint}/admin/policy");
168:         AddBasicAuth(request);
169:         request.Content = JsonContent.Create(policy);
170: 
171:         using var response = await _httpClient.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
172: 
173:         if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
174:         {
175:             var body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);
176:             _logger.LogError(
177:                 "Failed to push policy to Cerbos at {Endpoint}: {StatusCode} - {Body}",
178:                 endpoint, response.StatusCode, body);
179:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"Cerbos policy push failed: {response.StatusCode}");
180:         }
181:     }
182: 
183:     private void AddBasicAuth(HttpRequestMessage request)
184:     {
185:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_settings.AdminUsername))
186:         {
187:             var credentials = Convert.ToBase64String(
188:                 Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes($"{_settings.AdminUsername}:{_settings.AdminPassword}"));
189:             request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Basic", credentials);
190:         }
191:     }
192: 
193: 
194: 
195: 
196: 
197:     private static object GenerateDerivedRolePolicy(
198:         Domain.Role role,
199:         IReadOnlyList<Domain.Permission> permissions)
200:     {
201: 
202:         var permsByResource = permissions
203:             .GroupBy(p => p.ResourceKind)
204:             .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(p => p.Action).ToList());
205: 
206: 
207: 
208:         return new
209:         {
210:             apiVersion = "api.cerbos.dev/v1",
211:             derivedRoles = new
212:             {
213:                 name = $"dynamic_{role.MasterCode.Replace('.', '_')}",
214:                 definitions = permsByResource.Select(kvp => new
215:                 {
216:                     name = $"{role.MasterCode}_{kvp.Key}",
217:                     parentRoles = new[] { "authenticated_user" },
218:                     condition = new
219:                     {
220:                         match = new
221:                         {
222:                             all = new
223:                             {
224:                                 of = new[]
225:                                 {
226:                                     new
227:                                     {
228:                                         expr = $"P.attr.roles.exists(r, r == \"{role.MasterCode}\")"
229:                                     }
230:                                 }
231:                             }
232:                         }
233:                     }
234:                 }).ToArray()
235:             }
236:         };
237:     }
238: }
````

````csharp
 15: public sealed class RuntimeAuthorizationProvider : IAuthorizationProvider
 16: {
 17:     private readonly CerbosAuthorizationService _cerbosProvider;
 18:     private readonly FallbackAuthorizationService _localProvider;
 19:     private readonly ISystemSettingRepository _systemSettingRepository;
 20:     private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
 21:     private readonly ILogger<RuntimeAuthorizationProvider> _logger;
 22: 
 23:     private const string CacheKey = "AuthorizationProvider_Mode";
 24:     private static readonly TimeSpan CacheDuration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1);
 25: 
 26:     public RuntimeAuthorizationProvider(
 27:         CerbosAuthorizationService cerbosProvider,
 28:         FallbackAuthorizationService localProvider,
 29:         ISystemSettingRepository systemSettingRepository,
 30:         IMemoryCache cache,
 31:         ILogger<RuntimeAuthorizationProvider> logger)
 32:     {
 33:         _cerbosProvider = cerbosProvider;
 34:         _localProvider = localProvider;
 35:         _systemSettingRepository = systemSettingRepository;
 36:         _cache = cache;
 37:         _logger = logger;
 38:     }
 39: 
 40:     public async Task<bool> IsAllowedAsync(
 41:         string resourceKind,
 42:         string resourceId,
 43:         string action,
 44:         IDictionary<string, object>? resourceAttributes = null,
 45:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 46:     {
 47:         var provider = await ResolveProviderAsync(cancellationToken);
 48: 
 49:         try
 50:         {
 51:             return await provider.IsAllowedAsync(resourceKind, resourceId, action, resourceAttributes, cancellationToken);
 52:         }
 53:         catch (Exception ex) when (provider == _cerbosProvider)
 54:         {
 55:             _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Cerbos provider failed; falling back to local provider for {ResourceKind}/{ResourceId}:{Action}",
 56:                 resourceKind, resourceId, action);
 57:             return await _localProvider.IsAllowedAsync(resourceKind, resourceId, action, resourceAttributes, cancellationToken);
 58:         }
 59:     }
 60: 
 61:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<bool>> IsAllowedBatchAsync(
 62:         IReadOnlyList<AuthorizationCheck> checks,
 63:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 64:     {
 65:         var provider = await ResolveProviderAsync(cancellationToken);
 66: 
 67:         try
 68:         {
 69:             return await provider.IsAllowedBatchAsync(checks, cancellationToken);
 70:         }
 71:         catch (Exception ex) when (provider == _cerbosProvider)
 72:         {
 73:             _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Cerbos provider failed for batch ({Count} checks); falling back to local provider", checks.Count);
 74:             return await _localProvider.IsAllowedBatchAsync(checks, cancellationToken);
 75:         }
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     public async Task<bool> CheckSettingAccessAsync(
 79:         string settingKey,
 80:         string action,
 81:         Guid? tenantId = null,
 82:         Guid? organizationId = null,
 83:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 84:     {
 85:         var provider = await ResolveProviderAsync(cancellationToken);
 86: 
 87:         try
 88:         {
 89:             return await provider.CheckSettingAccessAsync(settingKey, action, tenantId, organizationId, cancellationToken);
 90:         }
 91:         catch (Exception ex) when (provider == _cerbosProvider)
 92:         {
 93:             _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Cerbos provider failed for setting check {SettingKey}:{Action}; falling back to local provider",
 94:                 settingKey, action);
 95:             return await _localProvider.CheckSettingAccessAsync(settingKey, action, tenantId, organizationId, cancellationToken);
 96:         }
 97:     }
 98: 
 99:     private async Task<IAuthorizationProvider> ResolveProviderAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
100:     {
101:         var mode = await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(CacheKey, async entry =>
102:         {
103:             entry.AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = CacheDuration;
104: 
105:             try
106:             {
107:                 var setting = await _systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.AuthorizationProvider);
108:                 var value = setting?.Value?.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
109: 
110:                 if (value is "cerbos")
111:                 {
112:                     _logger.LogDebug("Authorization provider resolved to: Cerbos (from SystemSetting)");
113:                     return "cerbos";
114:                 }
115: 
116:                 _logger.LogDebug("Authorization provider resolved to: Local (setting={Value})", value ?? "null");
117:                 return "local";
118:             }
119:             catch (Exception ex)
120:             {
121:                 _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Failed to read authorization provider setting; defaulting to local");
122:                 return "local";
123:             }
124:         });
125: 
126:         return mode == "cerbos" ? _cerbosProvider : _localProvider;
127:     }
128: }
````

````csharp
 23: public class S3ConfigResolver : IS3ConfigResolver
 24: {
 25:     private readonly ISettingsResolver _settingsResolver;
 26:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
 27:     private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
 28:     private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
 29:     private readonly ILogger<S3ConfigResolver> _logger;
 30: 
 31:     private static readonly TimeSpan CacheExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);
 32:     private const string CacheKeyPrefix = "S3Config:";
 33: 
 34:     public S3ConfigResolver(
 35:         ISettingsResolver settingsResolver,
 36:         ITenantContext tenantContext,
 37:         IMemoryCache cache,
 38:         IConfiguration configuration,
 39:         ILogger<S3ConfigResolver> logger)
 40:     {
 41:         _settingsResolver = settingsResolver;
 42:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
 43:         _cache = cache;
 44:         _configuration = configuration;
 45:         _logger = logger;
 46:     }
 47: 
 48:     public async Task<S3Configuration?> ResolveAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 49:     {
 50:         var tenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
 51:         var cacheKey = $"{CacheKeyPrefix}{tenantId}";
 52: 
 53:         if (_cache.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out S3Configuration? cached))
 54:         {
 55:             return cached;
 56:         }
 57: 
 58:         var config = await ResolveFromSettingsAsync(tenantId, cancellationToken);
 59: 
 60:         if (config is not null)
 61:         {
 62:             _cache.Set(cacheKey, config, CacheExpiration);
 63:         }
 64: 
 65:         return config;
 66:     }
 67: 
 68:     public void InvalidateCache(Guid? tenantId = null)
 69:     {
 70:         if (tenantId.HasValue)
 71:         {
 72:             _cache.Remove($"{CacheKeyPrefix}{tenantId.Value}");
 73:         }
 74:         else
 75:         {
 76: 
 77: 
 78:             _logger.LogInformation("S3 config cache invalidation requested for all tenants");
 79:         }
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     private async Task<S3Configuration?> ResolveFromSettingsAsync(
 83:         Guid tenantId,
 84:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 85:     {
 86: 
 87: 
 88: 
 89: 
 90: 
 91:         var endpoint = await ResolveStringAsync(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3Endpoint, "S3Settings:Endpoint", tenantId, cancellationToken);
 92:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(endpoint))
 93:         {
 94:             _logger.LogDebug("S3 not configured for tenant {TenantId}: endpoint is empty", tenantId);
 95:             return null;
 96:         }
 97: 
 98:         var bucketName = await ResolveStringAsync(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3BucketName, "S3Settings:BucketName", tenantId, cancellationToken);
 99:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(bucketName))
100:         {
101:             _logger.LogDebug("S3 not configured for tenant {TenantId}: bucket_name is empty", tenantId);
102:             return null;
103:         }
104: 
105:         var accessKeyId = await ResolveStringAsync(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3AccessKeyId, "S3Settings:AccessKeyId", tenantId, cancellationToken);
106:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(accessKeyId))
107:         {
108:             _logger.LogDebug("S3 not configured for tenant {TenantId}: access_key_id is empty", tenantId);
109:             return null;
110:         }
111: 
112:         var secretAccessKey = await ResolveStringAsync(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3SecretAccessKey, "S3Settings:SecretAccessKey", tenantId, cancellationToken);
113:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secretAccessKey))
114:         {
115:             _logger.LogDebug("S3 not configured for tenant {TenantId}: secret_access_key is empty", tenantId);
116:             return null;
117:         }
118: 
119:         var uploadExpiration = await _settingsResolver.GetSettingAsync<int>(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3UploadUrlExpirationMinutes, tenantId, cancellationToken);
120:         var forcePathStyle = await _settingsResolver.GetSettingAsync<bool>(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3ForcePathStyle, tenantId, cancellationToken);
121: 
122:         var region = await ResolveStringAsync(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3Region, "S3Settings:Region", tenantId, cancellationToken);
123:         var publicEndpoint = await ResolveStringAsync(GovernanceSettingKeys.S3PublicEndpoint, "S3Settings:PublicEndpoint", tenantId, cancellationToken);
124: 
125:         return new S3Configuration
126:         {
127:             Endpoint = endpoint,
128:             BucketName = bucketName,
129:             AccessKeyId = accessKeyId,
130:             SecretAccessKey = secretAccessKey,
131:             Region = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(region) ? "us-east-1" : region,
132:             PublicEndpoint = publicEndpoint,
133:             ForcePathStyle = forcePathStyle,
134:             UploadUrlExpirationMinutes = uploadExpiration > 0 ? uploadExpiration : 60,
135:             DownloadUrlExpirationMinutes = 60
136:         };
137:     }
138: 
139: 
140: 
141: 
142: 
143:     private async Task<string?> ResolveStringAsync(
144:         string settingKey, string configKey, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
145:     {
146:         var dbValue = await _settingsResolver.GetSettingAsync<string>(settingKey, tenantId, cancellationToken);
147:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dbValue))
148:         {
149:             return dbValue;
150:         }
151: 
152: 
153:         return _configuration[configKey];
154:     }
155: }
````

````csharp
 1: using System;

 7: 
 8: namespace Explore.Persistence.Repositories;
 9: 
10: public class AudienceAgeRepository : GenericRepository<AudienceAge, int>, IAudienceAgeRepository
11: {

14:     public AudienceAgeRepository(ExploreDbContext dbContext) : base(dbContext)
15:     {
16:         _dbContext = dbContext;
17:     }
18:

20:     {

22:             .AsNoTracking()
23:             .ToListAsync();
24:         return audienceAges;

30:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(a => a.Id == id);
31:         return audienceAge;
32:     }
33: }
````

## File: Explore.Persistence/Repositories/ConfigurationChangeLogRepository.cs
````csharp
 1: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 2: using Explore.Domain;
 3: using Explore.Domain.Enums;
 4: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 5: 
 6: namespace Explore.Persistence.Repositories;
 7: 
 8: public class ConfigurationChangeLogRepository : GenericRepository<ConfigurationChangeLog, Guid>, IConfigurationChangeLogRepository
 9: {
10:     private readonly ExploreDbContext _dbContext;
11: 
12:     public ConfigurationChangeLogRepository(ExploreDbContext dbContext) : base(dbContext)
13:     {
14:         _dbContext = dbContext;
15:     }
16: 
17:     public async Task<List<ConfigurationChangeLog>> GetBySettingKey(string settingKey, int limit = 50)
18:     {
19:         return await _dbContext.Set<ConfigurationChangeLog>()
20:             .AsNoTracking()
21:             .Where(c => c.SettingKey == settingKey)
22:             .OrderByDescending(c => c.Timestamp)
23:             .Take(limit)
24:             .ToListAsync();
25:     }
26: 
27:     public async Task<List<ConfigurationChangeLog>> GetByScope(ConfigurationScopeEnum scope, Guid? scopeId = null, int limit = 50)
28:     {
29:         var query = _dbContext.Set<ConfigurationChangeLog>()
30:             .AsNoTracking()
31:             .Where(c => c.Scope == scope);
32: 
33:         if (scopeId.HasValue)
34:         {
35:             query = query.Where(c => c.ScopeId == scopeId.Value);
36:         }
37: 
38:         return await query
39:             .OrderByDescending(c => c.Timestamp)
40:             .Take(limit)
41:             .ToListAsync();
42:     }
43: 
44:     public async Task<List<ConfigurationChangeLog>> GetByUserId(Guid userId, int limit = 50)
45:     {
46:         return await _dbContext.Set<ConfigurationChangeLog>()
47:             .AsNoTracking()
48:             .Where(c => c.UserId == userId)
49:             .OrderByDescending(c => c.Timestamp)
50:             .Take(limit)
51:             .ToListAsync();
52:     }
53: }
````

## File: Explore.Persistence/Repositories/EventIslamicAspectRepository.cs
````csharp
 1: namespace Explore.Persistence.Repositories;
 2: 
 3: using System;
 4: using System.Collections.Generic;
 5: using System.Linq;
 6: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 7: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 8: using Explore.Domain;
 9: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
10: 
11: 
12: 
13: 
14: public class EventIslamicAspectRepository : GenericRepository<EventIslamicAspect, Guid>, IEventIslamicAspectRepository
15: {
16:     private readonly ExploreDbContext _dbContext;
17: 
18:     public EventIslamicAspectRepository(ExploreDbContext dbContext) : base(dbContext)
19:     {
20:         _dbContext = dbContext;
21:     }
22: 
23: 
24:     public async Task<EventIslamicAspect?> GetByEventIdWithDetails(Guid eventId)
25:     {
26:         return await _dbContext.EventIslamicAspects
27:             .Include(a => a.Madhab)
28:             .Include(a => a.PrimaryLanguage)
29:             .AsNoTracking()
30:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(a => a.Id == eventId);
31:     }
32: 
33: 
34:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<EventIslamicAspect>> GetByGenderMode(GenderSegregationMode genderMode)
35:     {
36:         return await _dbContext.EventIslamicAspects
37:             .Include(a => a.Madhab)
38:             .Include(a => a.PrimaryLanguage)
39:             .Where(a => a.GenderMode == genderMode)
40:             .AsNoTracking()
41:             .ToListAsync();
42:     }
43: 
44: 
45:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<EventIslamicAspect>> GetByMadhab(int madhabId)
46:     {
47:         return await _dbContext.EventIslamicAspects
48:             .Include(a => a.Madhab)
49:             .Include(a => a.PrimaryLanguage)
50:             .Where(a => a.MadhabId == madhabId)
51:             .AsNoTracking()
52:             .ToListAsync();
53:     }
54: 
55: 
56:     public async Task<EventIslamicAspect> Upsert(EventIslamicAspect aspect)
57:     {
58:         var existing = await _dbContext.EventIslamicAspects
59:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(a => a.Id == aspect.Id);
60: 
61:         if (existing == null)
62:         {
63:             await _dbContext.EventIslamicAspects.AddAsync(aspect);
64:         }
65:         else
66:         {
67:             _dbContext.Entry(existing).CurrentValues.SetValues(aspect);
68:         }
69: 
70:         await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
71:         return aspect;
72:     }
73: }
````

````csharp
66:             await _dbContext.EventTechAspects.AddAsync(aspect);
67:         }
68:         else
69:         {
70:             _dbContext.Entry(existing).CurrentValues.SetValues(aspect);
71:         }
72: 
73:         await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
74:         return aspect;
75:     }
76: }
````

````csharp
16: 
17:     public async Task<Permission?> GetByMasterCodeAsync(string masterCode)
18:     {
19:         return await _dbContext.Permissions
20:             .AsNoTracking()
21:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.MasterCode == masterCode);
22:     }
23: 
24:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Permission>> GetByResourceKindAsync(string resourceKind)
25:     {
26:         return await _dbContext.Permissions
27:             .AsNoTracking()
28:             .Where(p => p.ResourceKind == resourceKind && p.IsActive)
29:             .OrderBy(p => p.Action)
30:             .ToListAsync();
31:     }
32: 
33:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Permission>> GetByScopeAsync(RoleScopeEnum scope)
34:     {
35:         return await _dbContext.Permissions
36:             .AsNoTracking()
37:             .Where(p => p.Scope == scope && p.IsActive)
38:             .OrderBy(p => p.GroupName)
39:             .ThenBy(p => p.ResourceKind)
40:             .ThenBy(p => p.Action)
41:             .ToListAsync();
42:     }
43: 
44:     public async Task<bool> HasPermissionAsync(IEnumerable<int> roleIds, string permissionMasterCode)
45:     {
46:         var roleIdList = roleIds.ToList();
47:         if (roleIdList.Count == 0)
48:             return false;
49: 
50:         return await _dbContext.RolePermissions
51:             .AsNoTracking()
52:             .AnyAsync(rp =>
53:                 roleIdList.Contains(rp.RoleId) &&
54:                 rp.Permission.MasterCode == permissionMasterCode &&
55:                 rp.Permission.IsActive);
56:     }
57: 
58:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Permission>> GetAssignablePermissionsAsync(
59:         IEnumerable<int> callerRoleIds,
60:         RoleScopeEnum targetScope)
61:     {
62:         var callerRoleIdList = callerRoleIds.ToList();
63: 
64: 
65:         var callerPermissionIds = await _dbContext.RolePermissions
66:             .AsNoTracking()
67:             .Where(rp => callerRoleIdList.Contains(rp.RoleId))
68:             .Select(rp => rp.PermissionId)
69:             .Distinct()
70:             .ToListAsync();
71: 
72: 
73:         return await _dbContext.Permissions
74:             .AsNoTracking()
75:             .Where(p =>
76:                 p.IsActive &&
77:                 !p.IsFiltered &&
78:                 (int)p.Scope >= (int)targetScope &&
79:                 callerPermissionIds.Contains(p.Id))
80:             .OrderBy(p => p.GroupName)
81:             .ThenBy(p => p.ResourceKind)
82:             .ThenBy(p => p.Action)
83:             .ToListAsync();
84:     }
85: }
````

````csharp
 44:     {
 45:         return await _dbContext.RolePermissions
 46:             .AsNoTracking()
 47:             .Where(rp => rp.RoleId == roleId)
 48:             .Select(rp => rp.Permission)
 49:             .ToListAsync();

 51: 
 52:     public async Task AssignPermissionsAsync(int roleId, IEnumerable<int> permissionIds, Guid? grantedBy = null)
 53:     {
 54:         var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
 55: 
 56:         foreach (var permissionId in permissionIds)
 57:         {
 58:             var exists = await _dbContext.RolePermissions
 59:                 .AnyAsync(rp => rp.RoleId == roleId && rp.PermissionId == permissionId);
 60: 
 61:             if (!exists)
 62:             {
 63:                 _dbContext.RolePermissions.Add(new RolePermission
 64:                 {
 65:                     RoleId = roleId,
 66:                     PermissionId = permissionId,
 67:                     Role = null!,
 68:                     Permission = null!,
 69:                     GrantedAt = now,
 70:                     GrantedBy = grantedBy
 71:                 });
 72:             }
 73:         }
 74: 
 75:         await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();

 81:             .Where(rp => rp.RoleId == roleId)
 82:             .ToListAsync();
 83: 
 84:         _dbContext.RolePermissions.RemoveRange(existing);
 85: 
 86:         var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
 87:         foreach (var permissionId in permissionIds)
 88:         {
 89:             _dbContext.RolePermissions.Add(new RolePermission
 90:             {
 91:                 RoleId = roleId,
 92:                 PermissionId = permissionId,
 93:                 Role = null!,
 94:                 Permission = null!,
 95:                 GrantedAt = now,
 96:                 GrantedBy = grantedBy
 97:             });
 98:         }
 99: 
100:         await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
101:     }
102:

106:             .Where(rp => rp.RoleId == roleId)
107:             .ToListAsync();
108:

110:         await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
111:     }

114:     {

118:         if (hasOrgMembers) return true;
````

````csharp
 1: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 2: using Explore.Domain;
 3: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 4: 
 5: namespace Explore.Persistence.Repositories;
 6: 
 7: public class TenantOnboardingStateRepository : GenericRepository<TenantOnboardingState, Guid>, ITenantOnboardingStateRepository
 8: {
 9:     private readonly ExploreDbContext _dbContext;
10: 
11:     public TenantOnboardingStateRepository(ExploreDbContext dbContext) : base(dbContext)
12:     {
13:         _dbContext = dbContext;
14:     }
15: 
16:     public async Task<TenantOnboardingState?> GetByTenantId(Guid tenantId)
17:     {
18:         return await _dbContext.TenantOnboardingStates
19:             .AsNoTracking()
20:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.TenantId == tenantId);
21:     }
22: }
````

## File: Explore.Secrets/Configuration/InfisicalConfigurationProvider.cs
````csharp
  1: namespace Explore.Secrets.Configuration;
  2: 
  3: using Infisical.Sdk;
  4: using Infisical.Sdk.Model;
  5: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
  6: 
  7: 
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: public sealed class InfisicalConfigurationProvider : ConfigurationProvider, IDisposable
 12: {
 13:     private readonly InfisicalConfigurationSource _source;
 14:     private InfisicalClient? _client;
 15:     private Timer? _reloadTimer;
 16:     private bool _disposed;
 17: 
 18:     public InfisicalConfigurationProvider(InfisicalConfigurationSource source)
 19:     {
 20:         _source = source;
 21:     }
 22: 
 23: 
 24:     public override void Load()
 25:     {
 26:         try
 27:         {
 28:             LoadAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
 29: 
 30:             if (_source.ReloadOnChange && _reloadTimer is null)
 31:             {
 32:                 _reloadTimer = new Timer(
 33:                     _ => ReloadAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult(),
 34:                     null,
 35:                     _source.ReloadInterval,
 36:                     _source.ReloadInterval);
 37:             }
 38:         }
 39:         catch (Exception ex)
 40:         {
 41:             if (_source.ThrowOnFirstLoadFailure)
 42:             {
 43:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
 44:                     $"Failed to load secrets from Infisical: {ex.Message}. " +
 45:                     $"Ensure Infisical credentials are configured correctly. " +
 46:                     $"Project: {_source.ProjectId}, Environment: {_source.Environment}",
 47:                     ex);
 48:             }
 49: 
 50: 
 51:             Console.Error.WriteLine($"[Infisical] Warning: Failed to load secrets: {ex.Message}");
 52:         }
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     private async Task LoadAsync()
 56:     {
 57:         Console.WriteLine($"[Infisical] Starting LoadAsync...");
 58:         Console.WriteLine($"[Infisical] URL: {_source.Url}");
 59:         Console.WriteLine($"[Infisical] ProjectId: {_source.ProjectId}");
 60:         Console.WriteLine($"[Infisical] Environment: {_source.Environment}");
 61:         Console.WriteLine($"[Infisical] Paths: {string.Join(", ", _source.Paths)}");
 62: 
 63: 
 64:         if (_client is null)
 65:         {
 66:             Console.WriteLine($"[Infisical] Initializing client...");
 67:             var settings = new InfisicalSdkSettingsBuilder()
 68:                 .WithHostUri(_source.Url)
 69:                 .Build();
 70: 
 71:             _client = new InfisicalClient(settings);
 72: 
 73:             Console.WriteLine($"[Infisical] Authenticating with Universal Auth...");
 74:             await _client.Auth().UniversalAuth().LoginAsync(
 75:                 _source.ClientId,
 76:                 _source.ClientSecret);
 77:             Console.WriteLine($"[Infisical] Authentication successful!");
 78:         }
 79: 
 80:         var newData = new Dictionary<string, string?>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
 81:         var totalSecrets = 0;
 82: 
 83:         foreach (var path in _source.Paths)
 84:         {
 85:             Console.WriteLine($"[Infisical] Loading secrets from path: {path}");
 86:             var options = new ListSecretsOptions
 87:             {
 88:                 ProjectId = _source.ProjectId,
 89:                 EnvironmentSlug = _source.Environment,
 90:                 SecretPath = path,
 91:                 Recursive = true,
 92:                 ExpandSecretReferences = true,
 93:                 ViewSecretValue = true
 94:             };
 95: 
 96:             var secrets = await _client.Secrets().ListAsync(options);
 97: 
 98:             if (secrets is null)
 99:             {
100:                 Console.WriteLine($"[Infisical] No secrets found in path: {path}");
101:                 continue;
102:             }
103: 
104:             Console.WriteLine($"[Infisical] Found {secrets.Length} secrets in path: {path}");
105:             foreach (var secret in secrets)
106:             {
107: 
108:                 var configKey = ConvertToConfigurationKey(secret.SecretKey, path);
109:                 newData[configKey] = secret.SecretValue;
110: 
111: 
112:                 newData[secret.SecretKey] = secret.SecretValue;
113: 
114: 
115:                 Console.WriteLine($"[Infisical]   - {secret.SecretKey} -> {configKey}");
116:                 totalSecrets++;
117:             }
118:         }
119: 
120:         Console.WriteLine($"[Infisical] Total secrets loaded: {totalSecrets}");
121:         Data = newData;
122:     }
123: 
124:     private async Task ReloadAsync()
125:     {
126:         try
127:         {
128:             await LoadAsync();
129:             OnReload();
130:         }
131:         catch (Exception ex)
132:         {
133:             Console.Error.WriteLine($"[Infisical] Warning: Failed to reload secrets: {ex.Message}");
134:         }
135:     }
136: 
137: 
138: 
139: 
140: 
141: 
142: 
143: 
144: 
145: 
146: 
147: 
148: 
149: 
150: 
151:     private static string ConvertToConfigurationKey(string secretKey, string path)
152:     {
153: 
154:         if (secretKey.Equals("POSTGRESQL_PUBLIC_URL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
155:         {
156:             return "ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection";
157:         }
158: 
159: 
160:         var section = path.Trim('/');
161:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(section))
162:         {
163:             section = string.Empty;
164:         }
165:         else
166:         {
167:             section = ToPascalCase(section) + ":";
168:         }
169: 
170: 
171:         var keyWithoutSection = secretKey;
172:         var sectionUpper = section.TrimEnd(':').ToUpperInvariant();
173:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sectionUpper) &&
174:             secretKey.StartsWith(sectionUpper + "_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
175:         {
176:             keyWithoutSection = secretKey[(sectionUpper.Length + 1)..];
177:         }
178: 
179: 
180:         var parts = keyWithoutSection.Split("__", StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
181:         var configParts = parts.Select(ToPascalCase);
182:         var configKey = string.Join(":", configParts);
183: 
184:         return section + configKey;
185:     }
186: 
187: 
188: 
189: 
190:     private static string ToPascalCase(string input)
191:     {
192:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(input))
193:         {
194:             return input;
195:         }
196: 
197:         var parts = input.Split('_', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
198:         var pascalParts = parts.Select(part =>
199:         {
200:             if (part.Length == 0) return string.Empty;
201:             return char.ToUpperInvariant(part[0]) + part[1..].ToLowerInvariant();
202:         });
203: 
204:         return string.Join("", pascalParts);
205:     }
206: 
207: 
208:     public void Dispose()
209:     {
210:         if (_disposed)
211:         {
212:             return;
213:         }
214: 
215:         _reloadTimer?.Dispose();
216: 
217:         if (_client is IDisposable disposable)
218:         {
219:             disposable.Dispose();
220:         }
221: 
222:         _disposed = true;
223:     }
224: }
````

````csharp
36:
````

````csharp
41:     public TimeSpan MaxBackoffDelay { get; set; } = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);

61: 
62:     public TimeSpan CalculateBackoffDelay(int consecutiveFailures)
63:     {
64:         if (consecutiveFailures <= 0)
65:             return TimeSpan.Zero;
66: 
67: 
68:         var exponentialMs = BaseBackoffDelay.TotalMilliseconds * Math.Pow(2, consecutiveFailures - 1);
69:         var cappedMs = Math.Min(exponentialMs, MaxBackoffDelay.TotalMilliseconds);
70: 
71: 
72:         var jitter = Random.Shared.NextDouble() * JitterFactor * cappedMs;
73: 
74:         return TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(cappedMs + jitter);
75:     }
76: 
77: 
78: 
79: 
80: 
81: 
82:     public TimeSpan AddJitter(TimeSpan interval)
83:     {
84:         var jitter = Random.Shared.NextDouble() * JitterFactor * interval.TotalMilliseconds;
85:         return interval + TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(jitter);
86:     }
87: }
````

````csharp
 28:     public static IConfigurationBuilder AddInfisical(
 29:         this IConfigurationBuilder builder,
 30:         IConfiguration configuration,
 31:         Action<InfisicalConfigurationSource>? configure = null)
 32:     {
 33:         var projectId = configuration["Infisical:ProjectId"];
 34:         var clientId = configuration["Infisical:ClientId"];
 35:         var clientSecret = configuration["Infisical:ClientSecret"];
 36: 
 37: 
 38:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(projectId) ||
 39:             string.IsNullOrEmpty(clientId) ||
 40:             string.IsNullOrEmpty(clientSecret))
 41:         {
 42:             Console.WriteLine("[Infisical] Skipping: Infisical credentials not configured in user secrets.");
 43:             Console.WriteLine("[Infisical] Set Infisical:ProjectId, Infisical:ClientId, and Infisical:ClientSecret to enable.");
 44:             return builder;
 45:         }
 46: 
 47:         var source = new InfisicalConfigurationSource
 48:         {
 49:             Url = configuration["Infisical:Url"] ?? "https://app.infisical.com",
 50:             ProjectId = projectId,
 51:             ClientId = clientId,
 52:             ClientSecret = clientSecret,
 53:             Environment = configuration["Infisical:Environment"] ?? "dev"
 54:         };
 55: 
 56: 
 57:         var paths = configuration.GetSection("Infisical:Paths").Get<List<string>>();
 58:         if (paths is not null && paths.Count > 0)
 59:         {
 60:             source.Paths.Clear();
 61:             source.Paths.AddRange(paths);
 62:         }
 63: 
 64:         configure?.Invoke(source);
 65: 
 66:         return builder.Add(source);
 67:     }
````

````csharp
192: 
193:     private static void DecorateSecretProvider(this IServiceCollection services)
194:     {
195: 
196:         var descriptor = services.FirstOrDefault(d => d.ServiceType == typeof(ISecretProvider));
197:         if (descriptor is null)
198:         {
199:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
200:                 "ISecretProvider must be registered before adding auditing decorator. " +
201:                 "Call AddSecretProvider() before AddSecretObservability().");
202:         }
203: 
204:         services.Remove(descriptor);
205: 
206: 
207:         services.AddSingleton<ISecretProvider>(sp =>
208:         {
209: 
210:             ISecretProvider inner;
211:             if (descriptor.ImplementationInstance is not null)
212:             {
213:                 inner = (ISecretProvider)descriptor.ImplementationInstance;
214:             }
215:             else if (descriptor.ImplementationFactory is not null)
216:             {
217:                 inner = (ISecretProvider)descriptor.ImplementationFactory(sp);
218:             }
219:             else if (descriptor.ImplementationType is not null)
220:             {
221:                 inner = (ISecretProvider)ActivatorUtilities.CreateInstance(sp, descriptor.ImplementationType);
222:             }
223:             else
224:             {
225:                 throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot resolve inner ISecretProvider for decoration.");
226:             }
227: 
228: 
229:             var auditLogger = sp.GetRequiredService<ISecretAuditLogger>();
230:             var logger = sp.GetRequiredService<Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILogger<AuditingSecretProviderDecorator>>();
231:             var httpContextAccessor = sp.GetService<Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.IHttpContextAccessor>();
232: 
233:             return new AuditingSecretProviderDecorator(inner, auditLogger, logger, httpContextAccessor);
234:         });
235:     }
````

## File: Explore.Secrets/Observability/SecretProviderHealthCheck.cs
````csharp
  1: using Explore.Secrets.Abstractions;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.HealthChecks;
  3: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  4: 
  5: namespace Explore.Secrets.Observability;
  6: 
  7: 
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: public sealed class SecretProviderHealthCheck : IHealthCheck
 12: {
 13: 
 14: 
 15: 
 16:     public const string Name = "secret_provider";
 17: 
 18: 
 19: 
 20: 
 21:     public const string Tag = "secrets";
 22: 
 23:     private readonly ISecretProvider _provider;
 24:     private readonly SecretRefreshMetrics? _metrics;
 25:     private readonly ILogger<SecretProviderHealthCheck> _logger;
 26: 
 27:     public SecretProviderHealthCheck(
 28:         ISecretProvider provider,
 29:         ILogger<SecretProviderHealthCheck> logger,
 30:         SecretRefreshMetrics? metrics = null)
 31:     {
 32:         _provider = provider;
 33:         _logger = logger;
 34:         _metrics = metrics;
 35:     }
 36: 
 37: 
 38:     public async Task<HealthCheckResult> CheckHealthAsync(
 39:         HealthCheckContext context,
 40:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 41:     {
 42:         try
 43:         {
 44:             var healthInfo = await _provider.GetHealthAsync(cancellationToken);
 45: 
 46:             var data = new Dictionary<string, object>
 47:             {
 48:                 ["provider"] = healthInfo.ProviderType.ToString(),
 49:                 ["supportsRefresh"] = _provider.SupportsRefresh,
 50:                 ["consecutiveFailures"] = healthInfo.ConsecutiveFailures
 51:             };
 52: 
 53:             if (healthInfo.LastSuccessfulRefresh.HasValue)
 54:             {
 55:                 data["lastSuccessfulRefresh"] = healthInfo.LastSuccessfulRefresh.Value.ToString("O");
 56:                 data["secondsSinceLastRefresh"] = (DateTimeOffset.UtcNow - healthInfo.LastSuccessfulRefresh.Value).TotalSeconds;
 57:             }
 58: 
 59: 
 60:             if (_metrics is not null)
 61:             {
 62:                 data["metricsLastRefresh"] = _metrics.LastSuccessfulRefresh.ToString("O");
 63:                 data["metricsConsecutiveFailures"] = _metrics.ConsecutiveFailures;
 64:             }
 65: 
 66:             if (healthInfo.IsHealthy)
 67:             {
 68:                 return HealthCheckResult.Healthy(
 69:                     description: $"Secret provider '{healthInfo.ProviderType}' is healthy",
 70:                     data: data);
 71:             }
 72: 
 73: 
 74:             if (healthInfo.ConsecutiveFailures >= 3)
 75:             {
 76:                 _logger.LogWarning(
 77:                     "Secret provider unhealthy: {ProviderType} has {FailureCount} consecutive failures. Error: {Error}",
 78:                     healthInfo.ProviderType,
 79:                     healthInfo.ConsecutiveFailures,
 80:                     healthInfo.ErrorMessage);
 81: 
 82:                 return HealthCheckResult.Unhealthy(
 83:                     description: $"Secret provider '{healthInfo.ProviderType}' has {healthInfo.ConsecutiveFailures} consecutive failures: {healthInfo.ErrorMessage}",
 84:                     data: data);
 85:             }
 86: 
 87:             return HealthCheckResult.Degraded(
 88:                 description: $"Secret provider '{healthInfo.ProviderType}' is degraded: {healthInfo.ErrorMessage}",
 89:                 data: data);
 90:         }
 91:         catch (Exception ex)
 92:         {
 93:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Health check failed for secret provider");
 94: 
 95:             return HealthCheckResult.Unhealthy(
 96:                 description: $"Health check threw exception: {ex.Message}",
 97:                 exception: ex,
 98:                 data: new Dictionary<string, object>
 99:                 {
100:                     ["provider"] = _provider.ProviderType.ToString(),
101:                     ["exceptionType"] = ex.GetType().Name
102:                 });
103:         }
104:     }
105: }
````

````csharp
  1: using System.Diagnostics;
  2: using System.Diagnostics.Metrics;
  3: using Explore.Secrets.Abstractions;
  4: 
  5: namespace Explore.Secrets.Observability;
  6: 
  7:

 10: 
 11: public sealed class SecretRefreshMetrics : IDisposable
 12: {
 13: 
 14: 
 15: 
 16: 
 17:     public const string MeterName = "Explore.Secrets";
 18: 
 19:     private readonly Meter _meter;
 20:     private readonly Counter<long> _refreshTotal;
 21:     private readonly Counter<long> _refreshFailuresTotal;
 22:     private readonly Histogram<double> _refreshDurationSeconds;
 23:     private readonly UpDownCounter<int> _consecutiveFailures;
 24: 
 25:     private DateTimeOffset _lastSuccessfulRefresh = DateTimeOffset.MinValue;
 26:     private int _currentConsecutiveFailures;
 27:     private readonly object _lock = new();
 28: 
 29:     public SecretRefreshMetrics(IMeterFactory? meterFactory = null)
 30:     {
 31: 
 32:         _meter = meterFactory?.Create(MeterName) ?? new Meter(MeterName, "1.0.0");
 33: 
 34: 
 35:         _refreshTotal = _meter.CreateCounter<long>(
 36:             name: "secrets_refresh_total",
 37:             unit: "{refresh}",
 38:             description: "Total number of secret refresh attempts");
 39: 
 40: 
 41:         _refreshFailuresTotal = _meter.CreateCounter<long>(
 42:             name: "secrets_refresh_failures_total",
 43:             unit: "{failure}",
 44:             description: "Total number of failed secret refresh attempts");
 45: 
 46: 
 47:         _refreshDurationSeconds = _meter.CreateHistogram<double>(
 48:             name: "secrets_refresh_duration_seconds",
 49:             unit: "s",
 50:             description: "Duration of secret refresh operations in seconds");
 51: 
 52: 
 53:         _consecutiveFailures = _meter.CreateUpDownCounter<int>(
 54:             name: "secrets_consecutive_failures",
 55:             unit: "{failure}",
 56:             description: "Current number of consecutive refresh failures");
 57: 
 58: 
 59:         _meter.CreateObservableGauge(
 60:             name: "secrets_last_refresh_timestamp_seconds",
 61:             observeValue: () => _lastSuccessfulRefresh == DateTimeOffset.MinValue
 62:                 ? 0
 63:                 : _lastSuccessfulRefresh.ToUnixTimeSeconds(),
 64:             unit: "s",
 65:             description: "Unix timestamp of the last successful secret refresh");
 66:     }
 67: 
 68: 
 69: 
 70: 
 71:     public DateTimeOffset LastSuccessfulRefresh
 72:     {
 73:         get
 74:         {
 75:             lock (_lock)
 76:             {
 77:                 return _lastSuccessfulRefresh;
 78:             }
 79:         }
 80:     }
 81: 
 82: 
 83: 
 84: 
 85:     public int ConsecutiveFailures
 86:     {
 87:         get
 88:         {
 89:             lock (_lock)
 90:             {
 91:                 return _currentConsecutiveFailures;
 92:             }
 93:         }
 94:     }
 95: 
 96: 
 97: 
 98: 
 99: 
100: 
101:     public RefreshOperation StartRefreshOperation(SecretProviderType providerType)
102:     {
103:         return new RefreshOperation(this, providerType, Stopwatch.StartNew());
104:     }
105: 
106: 
107: 
108: 
109: 
110: 
111:     public void RecordRefreshSuccess(SecretProviderType providerType, double durationSeconds)
112:     {
113:         var tags = new TagList
114:         {
115:             { "provider", providerType.ToString().ToLowerInvariant() },
116:             { "status", "success" }
117:         };
118: 
119:         _refreshTotal.Add(1, tags);
120:         _refreshDurationSeconds.Record(durationSeconds, tags);
121: 
122:         lock (_lock)
123:         {
124: 
125:             if (_currentConsecutiveFailures > 0)
126:             {
127:                 _consecutiveFailures.Add(-_currentConsecutiveFailures,
128:                     new TagList { { "provider", providerType.ToString().ToLowerInvariant() } });
129:                 _currentConsecutiveFailures = 0;
130:             }
131: 
132:             _lastSuccessfulRefresh = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
133:         }
134:     }
135: 
136: 
137: 
138: 
139: 
140: 
141: 
142:     public void RecordRefreshFailure(SecretProviderType providerType, double durationSeconds, string? errorType = null)
143:     {
144:         var tags = new TagList
145:         {
146:             { "provider", providerType.ToString().ToLowerInvariant() },
147:             { "status", "failure" }
148:         };
149: 
150:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorType))
151:         {
152:             tags.Add("error_type", errorType);
153:         }
154: 
155:         _refreshTotal.Add(1, tags);
156:         _refreshFailuresTotal.Add(1, tags);
157:         _refreshDurationSeconds.Record(durationSeconds, tags);
158: 
159:         lock (_lock)
160:         {
161:             _currentConsecutiveFailures++;
162:             _consecutiveFailures.Add(1,
163:                 new TagList { { "provider", providerType.ToString().ToLowerInvariant() } });
164:         }
165:     }
166: 
167:     public void Dispose()
168:     {
169:         _meter.Dispose();
170:     }
171: 
172: 
173: 
174: 
175:     public readonly struct RefreshOperation : IDisposable
176:     {
177:         private readonly SecretRefreshMetrics _metrics;
178:         private readonly SecretProviderType _providerType;
179:         private readonly Stopwatch _stopwatch;
180: 
181:         internal RefreshOperation(SecretRefreshMetrics metrics, SecretProviderType providerType, Stopwatch stopwatch)
182:         {
183:             _metrics = metrics;
184:             _providerType = providerType;
185:             _stopwatch = stopwatch;
186:         }
187: 
188: 
189: 
190: 
191:         public void Complete()
192:         {
193:             _stopwatch.Stop();
194:             _metrics.RecordRefreshSuccess(_providerType, _stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds);
195:         }
196: 
197: 
198: 
199: 
200: 
201:         public void Fail(string? errorType = null)
202:         {
203:             _stopwatch.Stop();
204:             _metrics.RecordRefreshFailure(_providerType, _stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, errorType);
205:         }
206: 
207: 
208: 
209: 
210:         public void Dispose()
211:         {
212: 
213:             _stopwatch.Stop();
214:         }
215:     }
216: }
````

````csharp
  1: using System.Diagnostics;
  2: using Explore.Secrets.Abstractions;
  3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
  4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  5: 
  6: namespace Explore.Secrets.Providers;
  7: 
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: 
 12: 
 13: public sealed class AuditingSecretProviderDecorator : ISecretProvider
 14: {
 15:     private readonly ISecretProvider _inner;
 16:     private readonly ISecretAuditLogger _auditLogger;
 17:     private readonly IHttpContextAccessor? _httpContextAccessor;
 18:     private readonly ILogger<AuditingSecretProviderDecorator> _logger;
 19: 
 20: 
 21: 
 22: 
 23:     private static readonly string[] SensitiveKeyPatterns =
 24:     [
 25:         "password",
 26:         "secret",
 27:         "key",
 28:         "token",
 29:         "credential",
 30:         "connectionstring",
 31:         "apikey",
 32:         "accesskey",
 33:         "privatekey"
 34:     ];
 35: 
 36:     public AuditingSecretProviderDecorator(
 37:         ISecretProvider inner,
 38:         ISecretAuditLogger auditLogger,
 39:         ILogger<AuditingSecretProviderDecorator> logger,
 40:         IHttpContextAccessor? httpContextAccessor = null)
 41:     {
 42:         _inner = inner ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(inner));
 43:         _auditLogger = auditLogger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(auditLogger));
 44:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
 45:         _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
 46:     }
 47: 
 48: 
 49:     public SecretProviderType ProviderType => _inner.ProviderType;
 50: 
 51: 
 52:     public bool SupportsRefresh => _inner.SupportsRefresh;
 53: 
 54: 
 55:     public async Task InitializeAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 56:     {
 57:         var correlationId = GetCorrelationId();
 58:         var userId = GetUserId();
 59: 
 60:         _logger.LogInformation(
 61:             "Initializing secret provider {ProviderType}. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}, UserId: {UserId}",
 62:             _inner.ProviderType,
 63:             correlationId,
 64:             userId ?? "system");
 65: 
 66:         try
 67:         {
 68:             await _inner.InitializeAsync(cancellationToken);
 69: 
 70:             await _auditLogger.LogAsync(new SecretAuditEntry(
 71:                 Operation: SecretOperation.Initialize,
 72:                 ProviderType: _inner.ProviderType,
 73:                 KeyPattern: null,
 74:                 Timestamp: DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
 75:                 UserId: userId,
 76:                 CorrelationId: correlationId,
 77:                 Success: true),
 78:                 cancellationToken);
 79: 
 80:             _logger.LogInformation(
 81:                 "Secret provider {ProviderType} initialized successfully. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}",
 82:                 _inner.ProviderType,
 83:                 correlationId);
 84:         }
 85:         catch (Exception ex)
 86:         {
 87:             await _auditLogger.LogAsync(new SecretAuditEntry(
 88:                 Operation: SecretOperation.InitializeFailed,
 89:                 ProviderType: _inner.ProviderType,
 90:                 KeyPattern: null,
 91:                 Timestamp: DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
 92:                 UserId: userId,
 93:                 CorrelationId: correlationId,
 94:                 Success: false,
 95:                 ErrorMessage: ex.Message),
 96:                 cancellationToken);
 97: 
 98:             _logger.LogError(ex,
 99:                 "Secret provider {ProviderType} initialization failed. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}",
100:                 _inner.ProviderType,
101:                 correlationId);
102: 
103:             throw;
104:         }
105:     }
106: 
107: 
108:     public async Task<string?> GetSecretAsync(string key, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
109:     {
110:         var correlationId = GetCorrelationId();
111:         var userId = GetUserId();
112:         var redactedKey = RedactKeyForLogging(key);
113: 
114:         _logger.LogDebug(
115:             "Retrieving secret {RedactedKey} from {ProviderType}. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}, UserId: {UserId}",
116:             redactedKey,
117:             _inner.ProviderType,
118:             correlationId,
119:             userId ?? "system");
120: 
121:         var result = await _inner.GetSecretAsync(key, cancellationToken);
122: 
123:         await _auditLogger.LogAsync(new SecretAuditEntry(
124:             Operation: SecretOperation.Access,
125:             ProviderType: _inner.ProviderType,
126:             KeyPattern: redactedKey,
127:             Timestamp: DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
128:             UserId: userId,
129:             CorrelationId: correlationId,
130:             Success: result is not null),
131:             cancellationToken);
132: 
133:         if (result is null)
134:         {
135:             _logger.LogDebug(
136:                 "Secret {RedactedKey} not found in {ProviderType}. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}",
137:                 redactedKey,
138:                 _inner.ProviderType,
139:                 correlationId);
140:         }
141: 
142:         return result;
143:     }
144: 
145: 
146:     public async Task<SecretValue?> GetSecretWithMetadataAsync(string key, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
147:     {
148:         var correlationId = GetCorrelationId();
149:         var userId = GetUserId();
150:         var redactedKey = RedactKeyForLogging(key);
151: 
152:         _logger.LogDebug(
153:             "Retrieving secret with metadata {RedactedKey} from {ProviderType}. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}, UserId: {UserId}",
154:             redactedKey,
155:             _inner.ProviderType,
156:             correlationId,
157:             userId ?? "system");
158: 
159:         var result = await _inner.GetSecretWithMetadataAsync(key, cancellationToken);
160: 
161:         await _auditLogger.LogAsync(new SecretAuditEntry(
162:             Operation: SecretOperation.Access,
163:             ProviderType: _inner.ProviderType,
164:             KeyPattern: redactedKey,
165:             Timestamp: DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
166:             UserId: userId,
167:             CorrelationId: correlationId,
168:             Success: result is not null),
169:             cancellationToken);
170: 
171:         return result;
172:     }
173: 
174: 
175:     public async Task<IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>> GetSecretsByPathAsync(
176:         string pathPrefix,
177:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
178:     {
179:         var correlationId = GetCorrelationId();
180:         var userId = GetUserId();
181: 
182:         _logger.LogDebug(
183:             "Retrieving secrets by path {PathPrefix} from {ProviderType}. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}, UserId: {UserId}",
184:             pathPrefix,
185:             _inner.ProviderType,
186:             correlationId,
187:             userId ?? "system");
188: 
189:         var result = await _inner.GetSecretsByPathAsync(pathPrefix, cancellationToken);
190: 
191:         await _auditLogger.LogAsync(new SecretAuditEntry(
192:             Operation: SecretOperation.Access,
193:             ProviderType: _inner.ProviderType,
194:             KeyPattern: $"{pathPrefix}:* ({result.Count} secrets)",
195:             Timestamp: DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
196:             UserId: userId,
197:             CorrelationId: correlationId,
198:             Success: true),
199:             cancellationToken);
200: 
201:         _logger.LogDebug(
202:             "Retrieved {Count} secrets from path {PathPrefix}. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}",
203:             result.Count,
204:             pathPrefix,
205:             correlationId);
206: 
207:         return result;
208:     }
209: 
210: 
211:     public async Task RefreshAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
212:     {
213:         var correlationId = GetCorrelationId();
214:         var userId = GetUserId();
215: 
216:         _logger.LogInformation(
217:             "Refreshing secrets from {ProviderType}. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}",
218:             _inner.ProviderType,
219:             correlationId);
220: 
221:         try
222:         {
223:             await _inner.RefreshAsync(cancellationToken);
224: 
225:             await _auditLogger.LogAsync(new SecretAuditEntry(
226:                 Operation: SecretOperation.Refresh,
227:                 ProviderType: _inner.ProviderType,
228:                 KeyPattern: null,
229:                 Timestamp: DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
230:                 UserId: userId,
231:                 CorrelationId: correlationId,
232:                 Success: true),
233:                 cancellationToken);
234: 
235:             _logger.LogInformation(
236:                 "Secrets refreshed successfully from {ProviderType}. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}",
237:                 _inner.ProviderType,
238:                 correlationId);
239:         }
240:         catch (Exception ex)
241:         {
242:             await _auditLogger.LogAsync(new SecretAuditEntry(
243:                 Operation: SecretOperation.RefreshFailed,
244:                 ProviderType: _inner.ProviderType,
245:                 KeyPattern: null,
246:                 Timestamp: DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
247:                 UserId: userId,
248:                 CorrelationId: correlationId,
249:                 Success: false,
250:                 ErrorMessage: ex.Message),
251:                 cancellationToken);
252: 
253:             _logger.LogError(ex,
254:                 "Secret refresh failed for {ProviderType}. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}",
255:                 _inner.ProviderType,
256:                 correlationId);
257: 
258:             throw;
259:         }
260:     }
261: 
262: 
263:     public Task<ProviderHealthInfo> GetHealthAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
264:     {
265: 
266:         return _inner.GetHealthAsync(cancellationToken);
267:     }
268: 
269: 
270: 
271: 
272: 
273:     private static string RedactKeyForLogging(string key)
274:     {
275:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
276:             return key;
277: 
278: 
279:         var parts = key.Split([':', '_', '.']);
280: 
281:         if (parts.Length == 0)
282:             return key;
283: 
284: 
285:         var lastPart = parts[^1];
286:         var isSensitive = SensitiveKeyPatterns.Any(pattern =>
287:             lastPart.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
288: 
289:         if (isSensitive)
290:         {
291: 
292:             return string.Join(":", parts[..^1]) + ":***";
293:         }
294: 
295:         return key;
296:     }
297: 
298: 
299: 
300: 
301:     private string GetCorrelationId()
302:     {
303: 
304:         var httpContext = _httpContextAccessor?.HttpContext;
305:         if (httpContext is not null)
306:         {
307: 
308:             if (httpContext.Request.Headers.TryGetValue("X-Correlation-Id", out var correlationHeader) &&
309:                 !string.IsNullOrEmpty(correlationHeader.ToString()))
310:             {
311:                 return correlationHeader.ToString();
312:             }
313: 
314:             if (httpContext.Request.Headers.TryGetValue("X-Request-Id", out var requestIdHeader) &&
315:                 !string.IsNullOrEmpty(requestIdHeader.ToString()))
316:             {
317:                 return requestIdHeader.ToString();
318:             }
319: 
320: 
321:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(httpContext.TraceIdentifier))
322:             {
323:                 return httpContext.TraceIdentifier;
324:             }
325:         }
326: 
327: 
328:         var activity = Activity.Current;
329:         if (activity is not null)
330:         {
331:             return activity.TraceId.ToString();
332:         }
333: 
334: 
335:         return Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8];
336:     }
337: 
338: 
339: 
340: 
341:     private string? GetUserId()
342:     {
343:         var httpContext = _httpContextAccessor?.HttpContext;
344:         if (httpContext?.User?.Identity?.IsAuthenticated != true)
345:         {
346:             return null;
347:         }
348: 
349: 
350:         var user = httpContext.User;
351: 
352: 
353:         var userId = user.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
354:             ?? user.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
355:             ?? user.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
356: 
357:         return userId;
358:     }
359: }
````

````csharp
 15: public sealed class InfisicalSecretProvider : ISecretProvider, IAsyncDisposable
 16: {
 17:     private readonly ILogger<InfisicalSecretProvider> _logger;
 18:     private readonly InfisicalOptions _options;
 19:     private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, SecretValue> _secretCache = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
 20: 
 21:     private InfisicalClient? _client;
 22:     private bool _initialized;
 23:     private DateTime? _lastSuccessfulRefresh;
 24:     private int _consecutiveFailures;
 25:     private readonly SemaphoreSlim _initLock = new(1, 1);
 26:     private readonly SemaphoreSlim _refreshLock = new(1, 1);
 27: 
 28:     public InfisicalSecretProvider(
 29:         ILogger<InfisicalSecretProvider> logger,
 30:         IOptions<SecretProviderOptions> options)
 31:     {
 32:         _logger = logger;
 33:         _options = options.Value.Infisical;
 34:     }

 36:

 43:     public async Task InitializeAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 44:     {
 45:         await _initLock.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
 46:         try
 47:         {
 48:             if (_initialized)
 49:             {
 50:                 _logger.LogDebug("Infisical provider already initialized");
 51:                 return;
 52:             }
 53: 
 54:             ValidateConfiguration();
 55: 
 56:             _logger.LogInformation(
 57:                 "Initializing Infisical secret provider for project {ProjectId} in {Environment}",
 58:                 _options.ProjectId,
 59:                 _options.Environment);
 60: 
 61:             var settings = new InfisicalSdkSettingsBuilder()
 62:                 .WithHostUri(_options.Url ?? "https://app.infisical.com")
 63:                 .Build();
 64: 
 65:             _client = new InfisicalClient(settings);
 66: 
 67: 
 68:             await _client.Auth().UniversalAuth().LoginAsync(
 69:                 _options.ClientId!,
 70:                 _options.ClientSecret!);
 71: 
 72:             _logger.LogDebug("Infisical authentication successful");
 73: 
 74: 
 75:             await LoadSecretsAsync(cancellationToken);
 76: 
 77:             _initialized = true;
 78:             _lastSuccessfulRefresh = DateTime.UtcNow;
 79:             _consecutiveFailures = 0;
 80: 
 81:             _logger.LogInformation(
 82:                 "Infisical secret provider initialized with {Count} secrets from {PathCount} paths",
 83:                 _secretCache.Count,
 84:                 _options.Paths.Count);
 85:         }
 86:         catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
 87:         {
 88:             _consecutiveFailures++;
 89:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to initialize Infisical secret provider");
 90:             throw SecretProviderException.Permanent(
 91:                 $"Failed to initialize Infisical provider: {ex.Message}",
 92:                 SecretProviderType.Infisical,
 93:                 "Initialize",
 94:                 ex);
 95:         }
 96:         finally
 97:         {
 98:             _initLock.Release();
 99:         }

104:     {

108:         {
109:             _logger.LogDebug("Retrieved secret from cache: {Key}", RedactKey(key));
110:             return Task.FromResult<string?>(secret.Value);
111:         }
112: 
113: 
114:         var infisicalKey = ConvertToInfisicalKey(key);
115:         if (_secretCache.TryGetValue(infisicalKey, out secret))
116:         {
117:             _logger.LogDebug("Retrieved secret from cache using Infisical key: {Key}", RedactKey(key));
118:             return Task.FromResult<string?>(secret.Value);
119:         }
120: 
121:         _logger.LogDebug("Secret not found in cache: {Key}", RedactKey(key));
122:         return Task.FromResult<string?>(null);

173:     public async Task RefreshAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
174:     {
175:         EnsureInitialized();
176: 
177:         await _refreshLock.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
178:         try
179:         {
180:             _logger.LogDebug("Refreshing secrets from Infisical");
181: 
182:             var previousCount = _secretCache.Count;
183:             await LoadSecretsAsync(cancellationToken);
184: 
185:             _lastSuccessfulRefresh = DateTime.UtcNow;
186:             _consecutiveFailures = 0;
187: 
188:             _logger.LogInformation(
189:                 "Refreshed {Count} secrets from Infisical (previous: {Previous})",
190:                 _secretCache.Count,
191:                 previousCount);
192:         }
193:         catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
194:         {
195:             _consecutiveFailures++;
196:             _logger.LogWarning(
197:                 ex,
198:                 "Failed to refresh secrets from Infisical (consecutive failures: {Failures})",
199:                 _consecutiveFailures);
200: 
201:             throw SecretProviderException.Transient(
202:                 $"Failed to refresh secrets: {ex.Message}",
203:                 SecretProviderType.Infisical,
204:                 "Refresh",
205:                 ex);
206:         }
207:         finally
208:         {
209:             _refreshLock.Release();
210:         }
211:     }

215:     {
216:         return Task.FromResult(new ProviderHealthInfo(
217:             IsHealthy: _initialized && _consecutiveFailures < 3,
218:             ProviderType: SecretProviderType.Infisical,
219:             LastSuccessfulRefresh: _lastSuccessfulRefresh,
220:             ConsecutiveFailures: _consecutiveFailures));
221:     }

224: 
225: 
226:     private async Task LoadSecretsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
227:     {
228:         if (_client is null)
229:         {
230:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Infisical client not initialized");
231:         }
232: 
233:         var newSecrets = new Dictionary<string, SecretValue>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
234: 
235:         foreach (var path in _options.Paths)
236:         {
237:             cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
238: 
239:             try
240:             {
241:                 var options = new ListSecretsOptions
242:                 {
243:                     ProjectId = _options.ProjectId!,
244:                     EnvironmentSlug = _options.Environment,
245:                     SecretPath = path,
246:                     Recursive = true,
247:                     ExpandSecretReferences = true,
248:                     ViewSecretValue = true
249:                 };
250: 
251:                 var secrets = await _client.Secrets().ListAsync(options);
252: 
253:                 if (secrets is null)
254:                 {
255:                     _logger.LogWarning("No secrets returned from Infisical for path: {Path}", path);
256:                     continue;
257:                 }
258: 
259:                 foreach (var secret in secrets)
260:                 {
261: 
262:                     var canonicalKey = ConvertToCanonicalKey(secret.SecretKey, path);
263:                     var secretValue = new SecretValue(
264:                         secret.SecretValue,
265:                         Version: secret.Version.ToString());
266: 
267:                     newSecrets[canonicalKey] = secretValue;
268:                     newSecrets[secret.SecretKey] = secretValue;
269: 
270:                     _logger.LogTrace("Loaded secret: {Key} from path: {Path}", RedactKey(canonicalKey), path);
271:                 }
272:             }
273:             catch (Exception ex)
274:             {
275:                 _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load secrets from path: {Path}", path);
276:                 throw;
277:             }
278:         }
279: 
280: 
281:         _secretCache.Clear();
282:         foreach (var (key, value) in newSecrets)
283:         {
284:             _secretCache[key] = value;
285:         }
286:     }
287: 
288: 
289: 
290: 
291: 
292:     private static string ConvertToCanonicalKey(string infisicalKey, string path)
293:     {
294: 
295:         var section = path.Trim('/').Replace("/", ":");
296: 
297: 
298:         var parts = infisicalKey.Split('_', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
299:         var pascalCaseParts = parts.Select(p =>
300:             char.ToUpperInvariant(p[0]) + p[1..].ToLowerInvariant());
301:         var pascalCaseKey = string.Join("", pascalCaseParts);
302: 
303:         // If path provides context, use it
304:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(section))
305:         {
306:             // Check if the key already starts with the section name
307:             var sectionParts = section.Split(':', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
308:             var firstSectionPart = sectionParts.FirstOrDefault()?.ToUpperInvariant();
309: 
310:             if (firstSectionPart is not null &&
311:                 infisicalKey.StartsWith(firstSectionPart, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
312:             {
313:                 // Key already includes section, just convert to Pascal
314:                 return pascalCaseKey.Replace(firstSectionPart,
315:                     char.ToUpperInvariant(firstSectionPart[0]) + firstSectionPart[1..].ToLowerInvariant());
316:             }
317: 
318:             return $"{char.ToUpperInvariant(section[0])}{section[1..]}:{pascalCaseKey}";
319:         }
320: 
321:         return pascalCaseKey;
322:     }
323: 
324:     /// <summary>
325:     /// Converts a canonical key to Infisical format.
326:     /// e.g., "Keycloak:PublicUrl" -> "KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_URL"
327: 
328:     private static string ConvertToInfisicalKey(string canonicalKey)
329:     {
330:         return canonicalKey
331:             .Replace(":", "_")
332:             .ToUpperInvariant();
333:     }
334: 
335: 
336: 
337: 
338:     private static string NormalizePath(string path)
339:     {
340:         return path.Trim('/').Replace("/", ":");
341:     }
342:

346:     private void ValidateConfiguration()
347:     {
348:         var errors = new List<string>();
349: 
350:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_options.ProjectId))
351:             errors.Add("Infisical ProjectId is required");
352: 
353:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_options.ClientId))
354:             errors.Add("Infisical ClientId is required");
355: 
356:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_options.ClientSecret))
357:             errors.Add("Infisical ClientSecret is required");
358: 
359:         if (errors.Count > 0)
360:         {
361:             throw SecretProviderException.Permanent(
362:                 $"Invalid Infisical configuration: {string.Join(", ", errors)}",
363:                 SecretProviderType.Infisical,
364:                 "Initialize");
365:         }
366:     }
367: 
368:

371:     private static string RedactKey(string key)
372:     {
373:         var separatorIndex = key.IndexOfAny([':', '_']);
374:         return separatorIndex > 0 ? key[..(separatorIndex + 1)] + "***" : key;
375:     }
376: 
377:     private void EnsureInitialized()
378:     {
379:         if (!_initialized)
380:         {
381:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
382:                 "Infisical secret provider not initialized. Call InitializeAsync first.");
383:         }
384:     }
385: 
386: 
387:     public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
388:     {
389:         _initLock.Dispose();
390:         _refreshLock.Dispose();
391: 
392: 
393:         if (_client is IDisposable disposable)
394:         {
395:             disposable.Dispose();
396:         }
397:         else if (_client is IAsyncDisposable asyncDisposable)
398:         {
399:             await asyncDisposable.DisposeAsync();
400:         }
401: 
402:         _client = null;
403:         _initialized = false;
404:     }
405: }
````

````csharp
  1: namespace Explore.Secrets.Services;
  2: 
  3: using System.Security.Cryptography;
  4: using System.Text;
  5: using Explore.Secrets.Abstractions;
  6: using Explore.Secrets.Configuration;
  7: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  8: using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
  9: 
 10: 
 11: 
 12: 
 13:
````
