 13: Sentry integration typically involves configuring the Sentry SDK early in your application's `Program.cs` file. This setup enables automatic error capturing and performance monitoring for your ASP.NET Core application.
 14: 
 15: **File**: `{Project}.API/Program.cs` (or `{Project}.Blazor/Program.cs` for Blazor Server)
 16: 
 17: ```csharp
 18: // Example: Add Sentry NuGet packages
 19: // <PackageReference Include="Sentry.AspNetCore" Version="4.0.0" />
 20: // <PackageReference Include="Sentry.Extensions.Logging" Version="4.0.0" />
 21: // <PackageReference Include="Sentry.Serilog" Version="4.0.0" /> // If using Serilog
 22: 
 23: using Sentry;
 24: using Sentry.AspNetCore;
 25: 
 26: var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);
 27: 
 28: // ✅ Configure Sentry for the Web Host
 29: builder.WebHost.UseSentry(options =>
 30: {
 31:     // Configure your DSN (Data Source Name) - this is crucial!
 32:     options.Dsn = builder.Configuration["Sentry:Dsn"];
 33: 
 34:     // Set the application environment
 35:     options.Environment = builder.Environment.EnvironmentName;
 36: 
 37:     // Set the release version for better tracking in Sentry
 38:     // options.Release = "my-app@1.0.0";
 39: 
 40:     // Performance Monitoring configuration
 41:     options.TracesSampleRate = 0.1;
 42:     options.ProfilesSampleRate = 0.1;
 43: 
 44:     // Optional: Enable automatic session tracking
 45:     options.AutoSessionTracking = true;
 46: 
 47:     // Optional: Enables Sentry to capture more global context
 48:     options.IsGlobalModeEnabled = true;
 49: 
 50:     // Optional: Custom filtering or data modification before sending to Sentry
 51:     options.BeforeSend = (sentryEvent) =>
 52:     {
 53:         // ✅ Remove sensitive information from HTTP request headers
 54:         if (sentryEvent.Request?.Headers != null)
 55:         {
 56:             sentryEvent.Request.Headers.Remove("Authorization");
 57:             sentryEvent.Request.Headers.Remove("Cookie");
 58:         }
 59: 
 60:         return sentryEvent;
 61:     };
 62: });
 63: 
 64: var app = builder.Build();
 65: 
 66: // ✅ Add Sentry middleware EARLY in the pipeline for comprehensive tracking
 67: app.UseSentryTracing();
 68: app.UseSentryTracing().UseSentryRequestErrorCatching();
 69: 
 70: // ... rest of your application's middleware pipeline ...
 71: ```
 72: 
 73: ---
 74: 
 75: ## 2. Using `SentrySdk` Directly
 76: 
 77: For manual error capturing, adding custom context, or performance monitoring outside of standard HTTP requests, you can use the `SentrySdk` static class directly.
 78: 
 79: ### Capturing Exceptions
 80: 
 81: ```csharp
 82: using Sentry;
 83: 
 84: try
 85: {
 86:     // ... code that might throw an exception ...
 87:     throw new InvalidOperationException("Something bad happened!");
 88: }
 89: catch (Exception ex)
 90: {
 91:     // ✅ Capture the exception to Sentry
 92:     SentrySdk.CaptureException(ex, scope =>
 93:     {
 94:         // ✅ Add additional context to the error report
 95:         scope.User = new User { Id = "user-123", Email = "user@example.com" };
 96:         scope.SetTag("feature", "{entity}-creation");
 97:         scope.SetTag("tenant_id", "tenant-abc");
 98:         scope.SetContext("request_data", new { Title = "My {Entity}", UserAgent = "..." });
 99:         scope.Level = SentryLevel.Error;
100:     });
101:     throw;
102: }
103: ```
104: 
105: ### Capturing Messages
106: 
107: ```csharp
108: using Sentry;
109: 
110: // ✅ Capture an informational message
111: SentrySdk.CaptureMessage("User logged in successfully.", SentryLevel.Info);
112: 
113: // ✅ Capture a warning message
114: SentrySdk.CaptureMessage("Low disk space warning on server.", SentryLevel.Warning);
115: ```
116: 
117: ### Manual Performance Transactions and Spans
118: 
119: For background jobs or specific code blocks where you want to track performance, you can create manual Sentry transactions and spans.
120: 
121: ```csharp
122: using Sentry;
123: 
124: public class BackgroundSyncService
125: {
126:     public async Task SyncDataAsync()
127:     {
128:         // ✅ Start a new Sentry transaction for the background operation
129:         var transaction = SentrySdk.StartTransaction("background.job.sync_{entities}", "sync");
130:         transaction.Description = "Synchronizing {entities} from external API";
131: 
132:         try
133:         {
134:             // ✅ Start a child span for a specific part of the operation
135:             var fetchSpan = transaction.StartChild("http.client", "fetch_external_{entities}");
136:             try
137:             {
138:                 await Task.Delay(500);
139:                 fetchSpan.SetTag("http.url", "https://external.api/{entities}");
140:                 fetchSpan.SetTag("http.method", "GET");
141:             }
142:             finally
143:             {
144:                 fetchSpan.Finish(SpanStatus.Ok);
145:             }
146: 
147:             var dbSpan = transaction.StartChild("db.query", "save_{entities}_to_db");
148:             try
149:             {
150:                 await Task.Delay(800);
151:             }
152:             finally
153:             {
154:                 dbSpan.Finish(SpanStatus.Ok);
155:             }
156: 
157:             transaction.Status = SpanStatus.Ok;
158:         }
159:         catch (Exception ex)
160:         {
161:             transaction.Status = SpanStatus.InternalError;
162:             transaction.SetTag("error", "true");
163:             SentrySdk.CaptureException(ex, scope => scope.Transaction = transaction);
164:             throw;
165:         }
166:         finally
167:         {
168:             transaction.Finish();
169:         }
170:     }
171: }
172: ```
173: 
174: ---
175: 
176: ## 3. Configuration (from `appsettings.json`)
177: 
178: Sentry settings are typically managed through `appsettings.json`, allowing easy modification across environments.
179: 
180: ```json
181: {
182:   "Sentry": {
183:     "Dsn": "https://your-public-key@o000000.ingest.sentry.io/0000000",
184:     "Environment": "Development",
185:     "Release": "1.0.0",
186:     "Debug": false,
187:     "DiagnosticLevel": "Error",
188:     "TracesSampleRate": 1.0,
189:     "ProfilesSampleRate": 1.0,
190:     "SendDefaultPii": false,
191:     "AttachStackTraces": true
192:   }
193: }
194: ```
195: 
196: ---
197: 
198: ## 4. NuGet Packages
199: 
200: Ensure the necessary Sentry NuGet packages are installed in the relevant projects.
201: 
202: ### `{Project}.API`
203: ```xml
204: <PackageReference Include="Sentry.AspNetCore" Version="4.0.0" />
205: <PackageReference Include="Sentry.Extensions.Logging" Version="4.0.0" />
206: ```
207: 
208: ### `{Project}.Blazor` (for Blazor Server)
209: ```xml
210: <PackageReference Include="Sentry.AspNetCore" Version="4.0.0" />
211: <PackageReference Include="Sentry.Extensions.Logging" Version="4.0.0" />
212: ```
213: 
214: ### `{Project}.Blazor.Client` (for Blazor WebAssembly)
215: ```xml
216: <PackageReference Include="Sentry.Blazor.WebAssembly" Version="4.0.0" />
217: <PackageReference Include="Sentry.Extensions.Logging" Version="4.0.0" />
218: ```
219: 
220: ### `{Project}.Application` (Optional, if using `SentrySdk` for business logic exceptions)
221: ```xml
222: <PackageReference Include="Sentry" Version="4.0.0" />
223: ```
224: 
225: ---
226: 
227: ## 5. Key Considerations
228: 
229: *   **Sensitive Data**: Always be mindful of sensitive data (PII, secrets, tokens) and configure `BeforeSend` to strip it from payloads.
230: *   **Performance Overhead**: While Sentry is optimized, capturing too many transactions or very large payloads can introduce overhead. Adjust `TracesSampleRate` and `ProfilesSampleRate` based on your performance needs.
231: *   **Error Reporting Discipline**: Ensure that exceptions are logged and reported consistently, preferably through the centralized exception handler. Avoid swallowing errors silently.
232: *   **Sentry DSN**: The DSN is your project's unique identifier in Sentry. It must be kept secret and should not be committed to source control directly (use environment variables or secret management).
233: 
234: ---
235: 
236: **Related Resources**:
237: - [api-exception-handling.md](api-exception-handling.md) - Context for how Sentry can integrate with centralized API error handling.
238: - [db-performance-monitoring.md](db-performance-monitoring.md) - How Sentry can complement OpenTelemetry for database performance.
239: - [`blazor-error-boundary.md`](blazor-error-boundary.md) - How Sentry can capture errors caught by Blazor's `ErrorBoundary`.
````

189: ### BFF Pattern
190: 
191: Blazor communicates with API through BFF (Backend-for-Frontend):

194: - YARP proxies `/api/*` to actual API

 54: ## Important Decisions
 55: 
 56: 1. **net10.0 upgrade is Phase 1** because .NET 10 provides 76% smaller blazor.web.js, WasmStripILAfterAOT, [PersistentState], ParameterState<T>, and other optimizations that later phases depend on.

 61: 
 62: 4. **Conservative caching** - Client-side cache TTLs should be short (30s-2min) with explicit invalidation on write operations to avoid stale data.

 95: - blazor.web.js: 76% smaller in .NET 10

 97: - [PersistentState]: Replaces manual PersistComponentState usage

## File: dev/active/s3-storage-abstraction/s3-storage-abstraction-context.md
````markdown
  1: # S3 Object Storage Abstraction - Context
  2: 
  3: ## SESSION PROGRESS (2026-02-11)
  4: 
  5: ### Completed
  6: - Full research of current S3 implementation (all files read and analyzed)
  7: - Web research on S3-compatible providers, multi-tenant patterns, credential storage
  8: - Codebase exploration agent completed with comprehensive gap analysis
  9: - Plan document created with 7 phases
 10: - Research report on private/public buckets, archive tiers, WASM/SSR considerations
 11: - Context and tasks files created
 12: - Phase 1: Created `S3Configuration` POCO and `IS3ConfigResolver` interface
 13: - Phase 2: Added 8 S3 governance setting keys to `GovernanceSettingKeys.cs`
 14: - Phase 3: Added 8 seed IDs (0530-0537) and 8 SystemSetting seed entries
 15: - Phase 4: Implemented `S3ConfigResolver` in `Infrastructure/Storage/`
 16: - Phase 5: Refactored `ObjectStorageService` to use `IS3ConfigResolver`, updated DI, added `TestConnectionAsync`, updated `GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl` to `Task<string>` and all 15 callers
 17: - Phase 6: Created 13 unit tests in `S3ConfigResolverTests.cs` — all 203 app unit tests pass
 18: - Phase 7: Updated `CODEBASE_STRUCTURE.md`, updated dev docs
 19: 
 20: ### Blockers
 21: - None
 22: 
 23: ---
 24: 
 25: ## Key Decisions
 26: 
 27: 1. **Mirror email pattern exactly** — Same architecture as SmtpConfigResolver (ISettingsResolver cascade, IMemoryCache, per-tenant resolution)
 28: 2. **Keep IObjectStorageService interface unchanged** — All 23+ consumer files don't need changes
 29: 3. **No public bucket support** — Private + presigned URLs is sufficient (YAGNI)
 30: 4. **No archive tiers** — Not supported by all providers; premature optimization
 31: 5. **ForcePathStyle defaults to true** — Required by most non-AWS providers (Hetzner, MinIO, B2, R2)
 32: 6. **Cache IAmazonS3 client per tenant in resolver** — Avoid creating TCP connections per request
 33: 7. **Keep env var bootstrap** — S3Settings.cs stays during transition; env vars populate initial seed data
 34: 8. **S3 seed IDs use range 0530-0537** — After email range 0520-0528
 35: 
 36: ## Key Files
 37: 
 38: ### Current Implementation (To Be Refactored)
 39: 
 40: **`Explore.Infrastructure/Services/ObjectStorageService.cs`**
 41: - Main S3 service implementation
 42: - Uses singleton `IAmazonS3` client + `IOptions<S3Settings>`
 43: - Has `_presignClient` for PublicEndpoint presigned URLs
 44: - Hardcoded 40-min upload URL expiration
 45: - **Will be refactored** to use `IS3ConfigResolver` instead
 46: 
 47: **`Explore.Infrastructure/S3Settings.cs`**
 48: - Simple 6-property POCO (Region, BucketName, AccessKeyId, SecretAccessKey, Endpoint, PublicEndpoint)
 49: - Located in Infrastructure layer (should be Application for Clean Architecture)
 50: - **Will be superseded** by `S3Configuration` in Application/Models but kept for env var bootstrap
 51: 
 52: **`Explore.Infrastructure/InfrastructureServicesRegistration.cs`** (lines 29-78)
 53: - Singleton `IAmazonS3` client factory with complex endpoint logic
 54: - Transient `IObjectStorageService` registration
 55: - **Will be simplified** to scoped `IS3ConfigResolver` + scoped service
 56: 
 57: **`Explore.Application/Contracts/Infrastructure/IObjectStorageService.cs`**
 58: - 3 methods: GeneratePresignedUploadUrl, GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl, GetFileStream
 59: - **Minor change**: Add `TestConnectionAsync` method
 60: 
 61: ### Reference Pattern (Email — Already Implemented)
 62: 
 63: **`Explore.Infrastructure/Mail/SmtpConfigResolver.cs`**
 64: - The exact pattern to replicate for S3
 65: - Uses `ISettingsResolver`, `ITenantContext`, `IMemoryCache`
 66: - 5-min cache with `SmtpConfig:{tenantId}` key
 67: - Returns null if host is empty → S3 equivalent: return null if endpoint is empty
 68: 
 69: **`Explore.Application/Contracts/Infrastructure/ISmtpConfigResolver.cs`**
 70: - Interface: `ResolveAsync()` + `InvalidateCache(Guid?)`
 71: - S3 will have identical interface shape
 72: 
 73: **`Explore.Application/Models/SmtpConfiguration.cs`**
 74: - Clean POCO with all config properties
 75: - S3 equivalent will have: Region, BucketName, AccessKeyId, SecretAccessKey, Endpoint, PublicEndpoint, ForcePathStyle, UploadUrlExpirationMinutes
 76: 
 77: **`Explore.Domain/Constants/GovernanceSettingKeys.cs`**
 78: - Has email keys (Email*) at the bottom
 79: - S3 keys will be added in new section below email
 80: 
 81: **`Explore.Persistence/Seed/SeedIds.cs`**
 82: - Email IDs: 0520-0528
 83: - S3 IDs: 0530-0537
 84: 
 85: **`Explore.Persistence/Seed/LookupTableSeeder.cs`**
 86: - Contains `SeedSystemSettings()` method with all SystemSetting entries
 87: - S3 entries will be added at the end with Category = "ObjectStorage"
 88: 
 89: ### Consumers (No Changes Needed)
 90: 
 91: - `StorageObjectController.cs` — API endpoints
 92: - 4 CQRS handlers in `Features/StorageObjects/Handlers/`
 93: - `ImageStorageService.cs` — Blazor client
 94: - `StorageObjectRepository.cs` — persistence
 95: 
 96: ### Test Files (To Be Created)
 97: 
 98: - `Event.Application.UnitTests/Infrastructure/S3ConfigResolverTests.cs` — new
 99: 
100: ## Provider Compatibility Notes
101: 
102: - **Hetzner** (current): `ServiceURL=https://fsn1.your-objectstorage.com`, ForcePathStyle=true, AuthenticationRegion="fsn1"
103: - **MinIO** (Docker dev): `ServiceURL=http://localhost:9000`, ForcePathStyle=true
104: - **AWS S3**: Use `RegionEndpoint` (not ServiceURL), ForcePathStyle=false
105: - **Critical**: Never set both `ServiceURL` and `RegionEndpoint` — throws `AmazonClientException`
106: 
107: ## Quick Resume
108: 
109: To continue:
110: 1. Read this file for current state
111: 2. Read `s3-storage-abstraction-tasks.md` for checklist
112: 3. Start with Phase 1 (Application layer)
113: 4. Build after each phase to catch errors early
114: 5. Run tests after Phase 6
115: ## Context Reset Session Update (2026-02-15 21:25 Europe/Brussels)
116: 
117: - Current implementation state: No new implementation changes in this session for this track.
118: - Key decisions made this session: Priority shifted to analytics implementation completion and verification.
119: - Files modified and why: None in this track during this session.
120: - Blockers/issues discovered: None newly discovered for this track.
121: - Next immediate steps: Continue from highest-priority unchecked items in `s3-storage-abstraction-tasks.md`.

212: ### BMAD Framework (_bmad/)
213:

224: 
225: ## Domain Model Summary
226: 
227: ### Core Entities
228: 
229: | Entity | Purpose | Relationships |
230: |--------|---------|---------------|
231: | `Event` | Primary aggregate | EventSessions, Categories, Tags, Location |
232: | `EventSession` | Session within event | AgendaItems, Speakers, Languages |
233: | `Organization` | Event organizer | Members, Reviews, Events |
234: | `Actor` | People/groups | Can be User or external |
235: | `Location` | Physical/virtual venues | Events |
236: | `Category` | Event categorization | Events (many-to-many) |
237: | `Tag` | Flexible tagging | Events (many-to-many) |
238: 
239: ### Lookup Tables
240: 
241: `EventType` • `EventStatus` • `EventFormat` • `AudienceAge` • `AudienceGender` • `Madhab` • `Language` • `ActorType` • `ApprovalStatus` • `VisibilityType` • `RegistrationMode` • `Role` • `OrganizationPosition` • `FileType` • `TagType` • `DidCustodyType`
242: 
243: ### Multi-Tenancy
244: 
245: All entities implement `ITenantEntity` with `TenantId` for data isolation:
246: - `Tenant` - Tenant configuration
247: - `TenantSettings` - Per-tenant settings
248: - `TenantUser` - User-tenant membership
249: 
250: **See**: [MULTI_TENANCY.md](MULTI_TENANCY.md) for the complete tenant isolation model, and [ADMIN_HIERARCHY.md](ADMIN_HIERARCHY.md) for the authority model.
251: 
252: ### Federation (ATProto)
253: 
254: - `IndexedDid` - Indexed DIDs from network
255: - `AtprotoRecord` - Federated records
256: - `ActorKeyStore` - Cryptographic keys
257: - `SyncState` - Synchronization tracking
258: 
259: ---
260: 
261: ## API Reference
262: 
263: ### Endpoint Categories
264: 
265: | Category | Controller | Routes |
266: |----------|------------|--------|
267: | **Events** | `EventController` | `/api/event` |
268: | **Sessions** | `EventSessionController` | `/api/eventsession` |
269: | **Organizations** | `OrganizationController` | `/api/organization` |
270: | **Actors** | `ActorController` | `/api/actor` |
271: | **Locations** | `LocationController` | `/api/location` |
272: | **Categories** | `CategoryController` | `/api/category` |
273: | **Tags** | `TagController` | `/api/tag` |
274: | **Users** | `UserController` | `/api/user` |
275: | **Tenants** | `TenantController` | `/api/tenant` |
276: | **Storage** | `StorageObjectController` | `/api/storageobject` |
277: 
278: ### HATEOAS Support
279: 
280: All major endpoints support HAL+JSON hypermedia:
281: - Use `Accept: application/hal+json` header
282: - Embedded resources and link relations
283: - Self-documenting API responses
284:

## File: docs/NAMING_CONVENTIONS.md
````markdown
  1: # Naming Conventions
  2: 
  3: > Comprehensive naming patterns used across the codebase.
  4: > Follow these exactly when creating new files, classes, or members.
  5: > Last Updated: February 2026
  6: 
  7: ---
  8: 
  9: ## Project Naming
 10: 
 11: | Project | Pattern | Purpose |
 12: |---|---|---|
 13: | `Explore.Domain` | `Explore.{Layer}` | Core domain entities |
 14: | `Explore.Application` | `Explore.{Layer}` | Business logic / CQRS |
 15: | `Explore.Persistence` | `Explore.{Layer}` | Data access / EF Core |
 16: | `Explore.Infrastructure` | `Explore.{Layer}` | External services |
 17: | `Explore.API` | `Explore.{Layer}` | Web API host |
 18: | `Explore.Blazor` | `Explore.Blazor` | Blazor Server host |
 19: | `Explore.Blazor.Client` | `Explore.Blazor.Client` | Blazor WASM client |
 20: | `Explore.Secrets` | `Explore.{Library}` | Standalone library |
 21: | `Event.Application.UnitTests` | `Event.{Layer}.{TestType}` | Test projects (legacy "Event" prefix) |
 22: | `Event.Architecture.Tests` | `Event.Architecture.Tests` | Architecture fitness tests |
 23: 
 24: **Note:** Main projects use the `Explore.*` prefix (historical naming, will be renamed to `Event.*` in the future). Test projects already use `Event.*` prefix.
 25: 
 26: ---
 27: 
 28: ## File Naming
 29: 
 30: All source files use **PascalCase** matching the primary class/type name:
 31: 
 32: | File type | Pattern | Example |
 33: |---|---|---|
 34: | Entity | `{EntityName}.cs` | `Event.cs`, `Organization.cs` |
 35: | Enum | `{EntityName}Enum.cs` | `EventTypeEnum.cs`, `EventStatusEnum.cs` |
 36: | Interface | `I{Name}.cs` | `IEventRepository.cs`, `ITenantContext.cs` |
 37: | DTO | `{Prefix}{EntityName}Dto.cs` | `CreateEventDto.cs`, `EventListDto.cs` |
 38: | Command | `{Verb}{EntityName}Command.cs` | `CreateEventCommand.cs` |
 39: | Query | `Get{EntityName}{Suffix}Request.cs` | `GetEventListRequest.cs` |
 40: | Handler | `{CommandOrQuery}Handler.cs` | `CreateEventCommandHandler.cs` |
 41: | Repository interface | `I{EntityName}Repository.cs` | `IEventRepository.cs` |
 42: | Repository implementation | `{EntityName}Repository.cs` | `EventRepository.cs` |
 43: | EF Configuration | `{EntityName}Configuration.cs` | `EventConfiguration.cs` |
 44: | Controller | `{EntityName}Controller.cs` | `EventController.cs` |
 45: | Blazor page | `{PageName}.razor` + `{PageName}.razor.cs` | `EventList.razor` |
 46: | Blazor CSS | `{PageName}.razor.css` | `EventList.razor.css` |
 47: | Client service | `{EntityName}Service.cs` | `EventService.cs` |
 48: | Validator | `{Prefix}{EntityName}DtoValidator.cs` | `CreateEventDtoValidator.cs` |
 49: 
 50: ---
 51: 
 52: ## Namespace Conventions
 53: 
 54: **File-scoped namespaces** are required (C# 10+ style):
 55: 
 56: ```
 57: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Events.Handlers.Commands;
 58: ```
 59: 
 60: Namespace structure mirrors folder structure exactly:
 61: 
 62: | Layer | Namespace |
 63: |---|---|
 64: | Domain entities | `Explore.Domain` |
 65: | Domain enums | `Explore.Domain.Enums` |
 66: | Domain interfaces | `Explore.Domain.Interfaces` |
 67: | Application DTOs | `Explore.Application.DTOs.{EntityName}` |
 68: | Application features | `Explore.Application.Features.{EntityNames}.Handlers.{Commands\|Queries}` |
 69: | Application requests | `Explore.Application.Features.{EntityNames}.Requests.{Commands\|Queries}` |
 70: | Application contracts | `Explore.Application.Contracts.{Persistence\|Infrastructure\|Identity}` |
 71: | Persistence repos | `Explore.Persistence.Repositories` |
 72: | Persistence configs | `Explore.Persistence.Configurations.Entities` |
 73: | API controllers | `Explore.API.Controllers` |
 74: | API services | `Explore.API.Services` |
 75: | Blazor client services | `Explore.Blazor.Client.Services` |
 76: | Blazor client pages | `Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.{Area}` |
 77: 
 78: ---
 79: 
 80: ## Entity Naming
 81: 
 82: ### Primary Entities (Guid PK)
 83: 
 84: Singular noun, PascalCase. One class per file at `Explore.Domain/` root.
 85: 
 86: - `Event`, `Organization`, `Actor`, `User`, `Tenant`, `Location`, `StorageObject`, `Category`, `Tag`
 87: 
 88: ### Lookup Tables (int PK)
 89: 
 90: Singular noun. These are reference data that rarely changes.
 91: 
 92: - `EventType`, `EventStatus`, `EventFormat`, `AudienceAge`, `AudienceGender`
 93: - `Madhab`, `Language`, `VisibilityType`, `RegistrationMode`
 94: - `Role`, `OrganizationPosition`, `ActorType`, `FileType`, `DidCustodyType`
 95: 
 96: ### Link/Junction Tables (Composite PK)
 97: 
 98: Named as `{Parent}{Child}` (plural for many-to-many collections):
 99: 
100: - `EventCategories` — Event ↔ Category
101: - `EventTags` — Event ↔ Tag
102: - `EventSessionLanguage` — EventSession ↔ Language
103: - `EventSessionSpeaker` — EventSession ↔ Speaker (User)
104: - `TagTypeTags` — TagType ↔ Tag
105: - `OrganizationMember` — Organization ↔ User (with Role via `RoleId`)
106: - `TenantUser` — Tenant ↔ User (with Role via `RoleId`)
107: - `RolePermission` — Role ↔ Permission
108: 
109: **Note:** Some junction table names are plural (`EventCategories`, `EventTags`) while others are singular (`OrganizationMember`, `EventSessionLanguage`). Follow the existing pattern when extending.
110: 
111: ### Aspect Tables (1:1 Optional Extension)
112: 
113: Named as `{Parent}{Module}Aspect`:
114: 
115: - `EventIslamicAspect` — Islamic-specific fields for Event
116: - `EventTechAspect` — Tech-specific fields for Event
117: 
118: ### Settings Entities
119: 
120: - `SystemSetting` — Instance-wide settings (global)
121: - `TenantSetting` — Per-tenant setting overrides
122: - `TenantSettings` — Tenant settings snapshot entity (different from TenantSetting)
123: - `AppSetting` — Application-level settings
124: 
125: ---
126: 
127: ## Enum Naming
128: 
129: Enums are named `{EntityName}Enum` and placed in `Explore.Domain/Enums/`. They mirror the int IDs used in lookup tables:
130: 
131: ```
132: EventTypeEnum.cs       → values: Conference = 1, Workshop = 2, ...
133: EventStatusEnum.cs     → values: Draft = 1, Published = 2, ...
134: AudienceAgeEnum.cs     → values: AllAges = 1, Children = 2, ...
135: ```
136: 
137: Each enum value maps to a lookup table row's int `Id`.
138: 
139: ---
140: 
141: ## DTO Naming
142: 
143: DTOs follow a strict prefix/suffix pattern per entity:
144: 
145: | DTO Purpose | Pattern | Example |
146: |---|---|---|
147: | Full details (read) | `{EntityName}Dto` | `EventDto`, `OrganizationDto` |
148: | List view (read) | `{EntityName}ListDto` | `EventListDto`, `OrganizationListDto` |
149: | Create payload (write) | `Create{EntityName}Dto` | `CreateEventDto` |
150: | Update payload (write) | `Update{EntityName}Dto` | `UpdateEventDto` |
151: 
152: DTOs live in `Explore.Application/DTOs/{EntityName}/` — one folder per entity, all DTOs for that entity in the same folder.
153: 
154: ---
155: 
156: ## CQRS Naming
157: 
158: ### Commands (Write Operations)
159: 
160: | Component | Pattern | Example |
161: |---|---|---|
162: | Command request | `{Verb}{EntityName}Command` | `CreateEventCommand` |
163: | Command handler | `{Verb}{EntityName}CommandHandler` | `CreateEventCommandHandler` |
164: 
165: Common verbs: `Create`, `Update`, `Delete`, `Add`, `Remove`
166: 
167: ### Queries (Read Operations)
168: 
169: | Component | Pattern | Example |
170: |---|---|---|
171: | Query request | `Get{EntityName}{Suffix}Request` | `GetEventListRequest`, `GetEventDetailsRequest` |
172: | Query handler | `Get{EntityName}{Suffix}RequestHandler` | `GetEventListRequestHandler` |
173: 
174: Common suffixes: `List`, `Details`, `ById`, `By{RelatedEntity}`
175: 
176: ### Folder Structure
177: 
178: Features are pluralized: `Events/`, `Organizations/`, `AudienceAges/`
179: 
180: ```
181: Features/{EntityNames}/
182: ├── Requests/
183: │   ├── Commands/    — {Verb}{EntityName}Command.cs
184: │   └── Queries/     — Get{EntityName}{Suffix}Request.cs
185: └── Handlers/
186:     ├── Commands/    — {Verb}{EntityName}CommandHandler.cs
187:     └── Queries/     — Get{EntityName}{Suffix}RequestHandler.cs
188: ```
189: 
190: ---
191: 
192: ## Repository Naming
193: 
194: | Component | Pattern | Example |
195: |---|---|---|
196: | Interface | `I{EntityName}Repository` | `IEventRepository` |
197: | Implementation | `{EntityName}Repository` | `EventRepository` |
198: | Generic base | `IGenericRepository<T, TKey>` | `GenericRepository<T, TKey>` |
199: 
200: Interfaces in: `Explore.Application/Contracts/Persistence/`
201: Implementations in: `Explore.Persistence/Repositories/`
202: 
203: ---
204: 
205: ## Controller Naming
206: 
207: Controllers are named `{EntityName}Controller` and placed in `Explore.API/Controllers/`. They map 1:1 with domain aggregates:
208: 
209: | Controller | Route |
210: |---|---|
211: | `EventController` | `api/event` |
212: | `OrganizationController` | `api/organization` |
213: | `EventSessionController` | `api/eventsession` |
214: 
215: Route convention: `api/[controller]` (controller name lowercased, no hyphens).
216: 
217: ---
218: 
219: ## Blazor Page Naming
220: 
221: Pages use PascalCase and are organized by area:
222: 
223: | Area | Page pattern | Example |
224: |---|---|---|
225: | Event pages | `Pages/Event/{Action}.razor` | `EventList.razor`, `CreateEvent.razor` |
226: | Organization | `Pages/Organization/{Action}.razor` | `OrganizationDetails.razor` |
227: | Admin | `Pages/Admin/{Area}.razor` | `LookupTables.razor` |
228: 
229: Each page has a code-behind: `{PageName}.razor.cs` (partial class).
230: Optional scoped CSS: `{PageName}.razor.css`.
231: 
232: ---
233: 
234: ## Service Naming (Blazor Client)
235: 
236: Client services follow `{EntityName}Service` with interface `I{EntityName}Service`:
237: 
238: | Service | Purpose |
239: |---|---|
240: | `EventService` / `IEventService` | Event API calls |
241: | `OrganizationService` / `IOrganizationService` | Organization API calls |
242: | `LookupCacheService` / `ILookupCacheService` | Caches lookup table data |
243: | `AuthStateService` / `IAuthStateService` | Centralized auth state |
244: | `BffClient` | Low-level BFF HTTP calls with XSRF |
245: | `ImageStorageService` / `IImageStorageService` | S3 presigned URL uploads |
246: 
247: ---
248: 
249: ## Database Column Naming
250: 
251: EF Core is configured with **snake_case naming convention** (via `UseSnakeCaseNamingConvention()`):
252: 
253: | C# Property | Database Column |
254: |---|---|
255: | `EventTypeId` | `event_type_id` |
256: | `CreatedAt` | `created_at` |
257: | `IsDeleted` | `is_deleted` |
258: | `TenantId` | `tenant_id` |
259: 
260: Table names are also snake_case plurals of the entity name.
261: 
262: ---
263: 
264: ## Seed Data ID Conventions
265: 
266: - **Lookup tables** (int PK): IDs defined in enum files, seeded via `HasData()` in EF configurations
267: - **Main entities** (Guid PK): IDs defined in `SeedIds.cs` using deterministic **UUIDv7** format
268: - UUIDv7 pattern: `018e4e5c-xxxx-7xxx-8xxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx` (time-ordered, unique per entity type)
269: - Seed IDs must never change once used in production
270: 
271: ---
272: 
273: ## Test Naming
274: 
275: ### Test Projects
276: 
277: | Project | Test type | Framework |
278: |---|---|---|
279: | `Event.Application.UnitTests` | Unit | TUnit |
280: | `Event.Domain.UnitTests` | Unit | TUnit |
281: | `Event.Architecture.Tests` | Architecture | TUnit |
282: | `Event.Persistence.IntegrationTests` | Integration | TUnit |
283: | `Event.API.IntegrationTests` | Integration | TUnit |
284: | `Explore.Blazor.Client.Tests` | Component | bUnit + TUnit |
285: | `Explore.Secrets.UnitTests` | Unit | TUnit |
286: 
287: ### Test Class Naming
288: 
289: Test classes mirror the class under test with a `Tests` suffix:
290: 
291: - `CreateEventCommandHandlerTests` — Tests `CreateEventCommandHandler`
292: - `EventRepositoryTests` — Tests `EventRepository`
293: - `CleanArchitectureTests` — Architecture rule tests
294: 
295: ### Test Method Naming
296: 
297: Methods use descriptive names: `{Method}_{Scenario}_{ExpectedResult}`
298: 
299: ---
300: 
301: ## Configuration Naming
302: 
303: ### EF Core Configuration
304: 
305: | Component | Pattern | Location |
306: |---|---|---|
307: | Entity config class | `{EntityName}Configuration` | `Configurations/Entities/` |
308: | Implements | `IEntityTypeConfiguration<{EntityName}>` | — |
309: 
310: ### DI Registration
311: 
312: | Registration file | Pattern |
313: |---|---|
314: | `PersistenceServicesRegistration.cs` | `CongfigurePersistenceServices()` (note: typo is intentional/existing) |
315: | `InfrastructureServicesRegistration.cs` | `ConfigureInfrastructureServices()` |
316: | `Explore.Blazor.Client/Program.cs` | Direct service registration |
317: | `Explore.API/Program.cs` | Calls all registration methods |
318: 
319: ---
320: 
321: ## Constants and Settings Key Naming
322: 
323: Governance setting keys use dot-separated hierarchical names:
324: 
325: ```
326: Deployment.Mode
327: Events.MaxSessionsPerEvent
328: Events.RequireApproval
329: Modules.Islamic.Enabled
330: Modules.Tech.Enabled
331: Branding.DisplayName
332: Domains.InstanceBaseDomain
333: ```
334: 
335: Defined in `Explore.Domain/Constants/GovernanceSettingKeys.cs`.
336: 
337: ---
338: 
339: ## Summary: Quick Rules
340: 
341: 1. **Entities** = singular PascalCase, one per file at Domain root
342: 2. **Enums** = `{Entity}Enum` in `Domain/Enums/`
343: 3. **DTOs** = `{Prefix}{Entity}Dto` in `Application/DTOs/{Entity}/`
344: 4. **Commands** = `{Verb}{Entity}Command` in `Features/{Entities}/Requests/Commands/`
345: 5. **Queries** = `Get{Entity}{Suffix}Request` in `Features/{Entities}/Requests/Queries/`
346: 6. **Handlers** = mirror command/query name + `Handler` suffix
347: 7. **Repositories** = `I{Entity}Repository` (interface) / `{Entity}Repository` (impl)
348: 8. **Controllers** = `{Entity}Controller`, route `api/[controller]`
349: 9. **Blazor pages** = `{Action}{Entity}.razor` or `{Entity}{Action}.razor` (varies by area)
350: 10. **Client services** = `{Entity}Service` / `I{Entity}Service`
351: 11. **DB columns** = snake_case (automatic via EF Core convention)
352: 12. **Namespaces** = file-scoped, mirror folder structure exactly
````

 90:         var expectedDto = new EventSessionDto

 93:             LocationId = locationId,
 94:             LocationFullName = "Test Location",
 95:             EventTitle = string.Empty
 96:         };

 98:         _eventSessionRepository.GetSessionWithDetails(sessionId).Returns(eventSession);
 99:         _mapper.Map<EventSessionDto>(eventSession).Returns(expectedDto);
100: 
101: 
102:         var result = await _handler.Handle(request, CancellationToken.None);

  1: namespace Event.Architecture.Tests;

 14:     #region Command Pattern Tests

 16:     [Test]
 17:     public async Task Commands_ShouldResideIn_CommandsNamespace()

 19:         var result = Types.InAssembly(ApplicationAssembly)
 20:             .That()
 21:             .HaveNameEndingWith("Command")
 22:             .And()
 23:             .AreClasses()
 24:             .Should()
 25:             .ResideInNamespaceContaining("Commands")
 26:             .GetResult();
 27: 
 28:         await Assert.That(result.IsSuccessful).IsTrue();
 29:     }
 30: 
 31:     [Test]
 32:     public async Task CommandHandlers_ShouldResideIn_CommandsNamespace()
 33:     {
 34: 
 35:         var result = Types.InAssembly(ApplicationAssembly)
 36:             .That()
 37:             .HaveNameEndingWith("CommandHandler")
 38:             .And()
 39:             .AreClasses()
 40:             .Should()
 41:             .ResideInNamespaceContaining("Commands")
 42:             .GetResult();
 43: 
 44:         await Assert.That(result.IsSuccessful).IsTrue();
 45:     }
 46: 
 47:     #endregion
 48: 
 49:     #region Query Pattern Tests
 50: 
 51:     [Test]

 58:             .AreClasses()

 61:             .Should()

 16: {
 17:     private readonly IModuleService _moduleService;

 20:

 32: 
 33: 
 34:     [HttpGet("available")]
 35:     [EndpointSummary("Get Available Modules")]
 36:     [EndpointDescription("Returns all modules that are globally active in the system. " +
 37:         "Does not filter by tenant - use /enabled for tenant-specific modules.")]
 38:     [AllowAnonymous]
 39:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(IReadOnlyList<ModuleInfo>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
 40:     public async Task<ActionResult<IReadOnlyList<ModuleInfo>>> GetAvailableModules(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 41:     {
 42:         var modules = await _moduleService.GetAllModulesAsync(cancellationToken);
 43:         return Ok(modules);
 44:     }
 45: 
 46: 
 47: 
 48: 
 49:     [HttpGet("enabled")]
 50:     [EndpointSummary("Get Enabled Modules")]
 51:     [EndpointDescription("Returns modules enabled for the current tenant. " +
 52:         "These modules determine which aspects/features are available for events. " +
 53:         "Used by the frontend to drive dynamic form generation.")]
 54:     [AllowAnonymous]
 55:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(IReadOnlyList<ModuleInfo>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
 56:     public async Task<ActionResult<IReadOnlyList<ModuleInfo>>> GetEnabledModules(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 57:     {
 58:         var tenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
 59:         var modules = await _moduleService.GetEnabledModulesAsync(tenantId, cancellationToken);
 60:         return Ok(modules);
 61:     }

 64: 
 65: 
 66:     [HttpGet("{moduleKey}/enabled")]
 67:     [EndpointSummary("Check Module Enabled")]
 68:     [EndpointDescription("Checks if a specific module is enabled for the current tenant. " +
 69:         "Returns a simple boolean response.")]
 70:     [AllowAnonymous]
 71:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ModuleEnabledResponse), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
 72:     public async Task<ActionResult<ModuleEnabledResponse>> IsModuleEnabled(
 73:         string moduleKey,
 74:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 75:     {
 76:         var tenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
 77:         var isEnabled = await _moduleService.IsModuleEnabledAsync(tenantId, moduleKey, cancellationToken);
 78: 
 79:         return Ok(new ModuleEnabledResponse
 80:         {
 81:             ModuleKey = moduleKey,
 82:             IsEnabled = isEnabled
 83:         });
 84:     }
 85: 
 86: 
 87: 
 88: 
 89:     [HttpGet("{moduleKey}/schema")]
 90:     [EndpointSummary("Get Module Schema URL")]
 91:     [EndpointDescription("Returns the wizard schema URL for a module. " +
 92:         "The schema is used to generate dynamic forms for module-specific features.")]
 93:     [AllowAnonymous]
 94:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ModuleSchemaResponse), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
 95:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
 96:     public async Task<ActionResult<ModuleSchemaResponse>> GetModuleSchemaUrl(
 97:         string moduleKey,
 98:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 99:     {
100:         var schemaUrl = await _moduleService.GetModuleWizardSchemaUrlAsync(moduleKey, cancellationToken);
101: 
102:         if (schemaUrl == null)
103:         {
104:             return NotFound(new { error = $"Module '{moduleKey}' not found or has no schema" });
105:         }
106: 
107:         return Ok(new ModuleSchemaResponse
108:         {
109:             ModuleKey = moduleKey,
110:             SchemaUrl = schemaUrl
111:         });
112:     }
113: 
114: 
115: 
116: 
117:     [HttpPost("{moduleKey}/enable")]
118:     [EndpointSummary("Enable Module")]
119:     [EndpointDescription("Enables a module for the current tenant. " +
120:         "Requires admin privileges.")]
121:     [Authorize]
122:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ModuleActionResponse), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
123:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
124:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
125:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
126:     public async Task<ActionResult<ModuleActionResponse>> EnableModule(
127:         string moduleKey,
128:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
129:     {
130:         var tenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
131: 
132: 
133:         var userIdClaim = User.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
134:             ?? User.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
135:             ?? User.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
136: 
137:         Guid? enabledBy = Guid.TryParse(userIdClaim, out var userId) ? userId : null;
138: 
139:         var success = await _moduleService.EnableModuleAsync(tenantId, moduleKey, enabledBy, cancellationToken);
140: 
141:         if (!success)
142:         {
143:             return BadRequest(new { error = $"Module '{moduleKey}' not found or not active" });
144:         }
145: 
146:         return Ok(new ModuleActionResponse
147:         {
148:             ModuleKey = moduleKey,
149:             Action = "enabled",
150:             Success = true
151:         });
152:     }
153: 
154: 
155: 
156: 
157:     [HttpPost("{moduleKey}/disable")]
158:     [EndpointSummary("Disable Module")]
159:     [EndpointDescription("Disables a module for the current tenant. " +
160:         "Existing data using this module's features will be preserved but hidden. " +
161:         "Requires admin privileges.")]
162:     [Authorize]
163:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ModuleActionResponse), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
164:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
165:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
166:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
167:     public async Task<ActionResult<ModuleActionResponse>> DisableModule(
168:         string moduleKey,
169:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
170:     {
171:         var tenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
172:         var success = await _moduleService.DisableModuleAsync(tenantId, moduleKey, cancellationToken);
173: 
174:         if (!success)
175:         {
176:             return BadRequest(new { error = $"Module '{moduleKey}' is not enabled for this tenant" });
177:         }
178: 
179:         return Ok(new ModuleActionResponse
180:         {
181:             ModuleKey = moduleKey,
182:             Action = "disabled",
183:             Success = true
184:         });
185:     }
186: }

26: 
27:     [HttpGet(Name = RouteNames.GetRoles)]
28:     [EndpointSummary("Get all Roles")]

30:     [AllowAnonymous]
31:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(List<RoleListDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
32:     [OutputCache(PolicyName = "LookupData")]
33:     public async Task<ActionResult<List<RoleListDto>>> GetAll(
34:         [FromQuery] RoleScopeEnum? scope = null,
35:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
36:     {
37:         var roles = await _mediator.Send(new GetRoleListRequest { Scope = scope }, cancellationToken);
38:         return Ok(roles);

40: 
41:

45:     [AllowAnonymous]
46:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(RoleDto), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
47:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
48:     [OutputCache(PolicyName = "DetailData")]
49:     public async Task<ActionResult<RoleDto>> GetById(int id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
50:     {

53:         {
54:             return NotFound();
55:         }
56: 
57:         return Ok(role);

## File: Explore.API/Extensions/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs
````csharp
 1: using Explore.API.OpenApi;
 2: using Microsoft.OpenApi;
 3: 
 4: namespace Explore.API.Extensions;
 5: 
 6: internal static class ServiceCollectionExtensions
 7: {
 8:     internal static IServiceCollection AddSwaggerGenWithAuth(
 9:         this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
10:     {
11:         services.AddSwaggerGen(options =>
12:         {
13:             options.SwaggerDoc("v0.1", new OpenApiInfo
14:             {
15:                 Title = "Explore API",
16:                 Version = "v0.1"
17:             });
18: 
19:             options.CustomSchemaIds(id => id.FullName!.Replace('+', '-'));
20: 
21: 
22:             options.SchemaFilter<HalSchemaFilter>();
23: 
24:             options.AddSecurityDefinition("Keycloak", new OpenApiSecurityScheme
25:             {
26:                 Type = SecuritySchemeType.OAuth2,
27:                 Flows = new OpenApiOAuthFlows
28:                 {
29:                     Implicit = new OpenApiOAuthFlow
30:                     {
31:                         AuthorizationUrl = new Uri(configuration["Keycloak:AuthorizationUrl"]!),
32:                         Scopes = new Dictionary<string, string>
33:                         {
34:                             { "openid", "openid" },
35:                             { "profile", "profile" }
36:                         }
37:                     }
38:                 }
39:             });
40: 
41: 
42:             options.AddSecurityRequirement(document =>
43:             {
44: 
45:                 var securitySchemeRef = new OpenApiSecuritySchemeReference("Keycloak", document);
46: 
47:                 return new OpenApiSecurityRequirement
48:                 {
49:                     { securitySchemeRef, new List<string>() }
50:                 };
51:             });
52:         });
53: 
54:         return services;
55:     }
56: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/Actor/Validators/UpdateActorDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 2: using FluentValidation;
 3: 
 4: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.Actor.Validators;
 5: 
 6: public class UpdateActorDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<UpdateActorDto>
 7: {
 8:     private readonly IActorTypeRepository _actorTypeRepository;
 9:     private readonly IDidCustodyTypeRepository _didCustodyTypeRepository;
10:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
11:     private readonly IActorRepository _actorRepository;
12: 
13:     public UpdateActorDtoValidator(
14:         IActorTypeRepository actorTypeRepository,
15:         IDidCustodyTypeRepository didCustodyTypeRepository,
16:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository,
17:         IActorRepository actorRepository)
18:     {
19:         _actorTypeRepository = actorTypeRepository;
20:         _didCustodyTypeRepository = didCustodyTypeRepository;
21:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
22:         _actorRepository = actorRepository;
23: 
24:         RuleFor(x => x.Id)
25:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Actor ID is required");
26: 
27:         RuleFor(x => x.DisplayName)
28:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Display name is required")
29:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("Display name cannot exceed 500 characters");
30: 
31:         RuleFor(x => x.ActorTypeId)
32:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Actor type is required")
33:             .MustAsync(async (actorTypeId, cancellation) =>
34:             {
35:                 return await _actorTypeRepository.Exists(actorTypeId);
36:             }).WithMessage("Invalid actor type");
37: 
38:         RuleFor(x => x.DidCustodyTypeId)
39:             .MustAsync(async (didCustodyTypeId, cancellation) =>
40:             {
41:                 if (!didCustodyTypeId.HasValue)
42:                     return true;
43: 
44:                 return await _didCustodyTypeRepository.Exists(didCustodyTypeId.Value);
45:             })
46:             .When(x => x.DidCustodyTypeId.HasValue)
47:             .WithMessage("Invalid DID custody type");
48: 
49:         RuleFor(x => x.ProfilePictureId)
50:             .MustAsync(async (profilePictureId, cancellation) =>
51:             {
52:                 if (!profilePictureId.HasValue)
53:                     return true;
54: 
55:                 return await _storageObjectRepository.Exists(profilePictureId.Value);
56:             })
57:             .When(x => x.ProfilePictureId.HasValue)
58:             .WithMessage("Invalid profile picture");
59: 
60:         RuleFor(x => x.Did)
61:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("DID cannot exceed 500 characters")
62:             .MustAsync(async (dto, did, cancellation) =>
63:             {
64:                 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(did))
65:                     return true;
66: 
67:                 var existingActor = await _actorRepository.GetActorByDid(did);
68:                 return existingActor == null || existingActor.Id == dto.Id;
69:             })
70:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.Did))
71:             .WithMessage("DID already exists for another actor");
72: 
73:         RuleFor(x => x.Handle)
74:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("Handle cannot exceed 500 characters");
75: 
76:         RuleFor(x => x.PdsHost)
77:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("PDS host cannot exceed 500 characters");
78: 
79:         RuleFor(x => x.Description)
80:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("Description cannot exceed 500 characters");
81: 
82:         RuleFor(x => x.ProfilePictureCid)
83:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("Profile picture CID cannot exceed 500 characters");
84: 
85:         RuleFor(x => x.ProfilePictureUri)
86:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("Profile picture URI cannot exceed 500 characters");
87:     }
88: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/Category/Validators/UpdateCategoryDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 2: using FluentValidation;
 3: 
 4: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.Category.Validators;
 5: 
 6: public class UpdateCategoryDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<UpdateCategoryDto>
 7: {
 8:     private readonly ICategoryRepository _categoryRepository;
 9: 
10:     public UpdateCategoryDtoValidator(ICategoryRepository categoryRepository)
11:     {
12:         _categoryRepository = categoryRepository;
13: 
14:         RuleFor(p => p.Id)
15:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.");
16: 
17:         RuleFor(p => p.MasterCode)
18:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
19:             .NotNull()
20:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
21: 
22:         RuleFor(p => p.FullName)
23:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
24:             .NotNull()
25:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
26: 
27:         RuleFor(p => p.ParentId)
28:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
29:             {
30:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
31:                 var exists = await _categoryRepository.Exists(id.Value);
32:                 return exists;
33:             }).WithMessage("{PropertyName} does not exist.")
34:             .Must((dto, parentId) => parentId != dto.Id)
35:             .WithMessage("A category cannot be its own parent.");
36:     }
37: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/EventSession/Validators/UpdateEventSessionDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 2: using Explore.Domain;
 3: using FluentValidation;
 4: 
 5: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.EventSession.Validators;
 6: 
 7: public class UpdateEventSessionDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<UpdateEventSessionDto>
 8: {
 9:     private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
10:     private readonly ILocationRepository _locationRepository;
11:     private readonly IRegistrationModeRepository _registrationModeRepository;
12: 
13:     public UpdateEventSessionDtoValidator(
14:         IEventRepository eventRepository,
15:         ILocationRepository locationRepository,
16:         IRegistrationModeRepository registrationModeRepository)
17:     {
18:         _eventRepository = eventRepository;
19:         _locationRepository = locationRepository;
20:         _registrationModeRepository = registrationModeRepository;
21: 
22:         RuleFor(p => p.Id)
23:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.");
24: 
25:         RuleFor(p => p.EventId)
26:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
27:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
28:             {
29:                 var exists = await _eventRepository.Exists(id);
30:                 return exists;
31:             }).WithMessage("{PropertyName} does not exist.");
32: 
33:         RuleFor(p => p.StartTime)
34:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.");
35: 
36:         RuleFor(p => p.EndTime)
37:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
38:             .GreaterThan(p => p.StartTime).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be after StartTime.");
39: 
40:         RuleFor(p => p.LocationId)
41:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
42:             {
43:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
44:                 var exists = await _locationRepository.Exists(id.Value);
45:                 return exists;
46:             }).WithMessage("{PropertyName} does not exist.");
47: 
48:         RuleFor(p => p.Title)
49:             .MaximumLength(500).When(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.Title))
50:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
51: 
52:         RuleFor(p => p.Description)
53:             .MaximumLength(500).When(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.Description))
54:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
55: 
56:         RuleFor(p => p.Slug)
57:             .MaximumLength(500).When(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.Slug))
58:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
59: 
60:         RuleFor(p => p.MaxAudienceAttendees)
61:             .GreaterThan(0).When(p => p.MaxAudienceAttendees.HasValue)
62:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be greater than 0.");
63: 
64:         RuleFor(p => p.RegistrationModeId)
65:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
66:             {
67:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
68:                 var exists = await _registrationModeRepository.Exists(id.Value);
69:                 return exists;
70:             }).WithMessage("{PropertyName} does not exist.");
71: 
72:         RuleFor(p => p.Price)
73:             .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0).When(p => p.Price.HasValue)
74:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be greater than or equal to 0.");
75: 
76:         RuleFor(p => p.CurrencyCode)
77:             .MaximumLength(3).When(p => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p.CurrencyCode))
78:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be a valid 3-letter currency code.");
79: 
80:         RuleFor(p => p)
81:             .Must(p =>
82:             {
83:                 if (p.IslamicAspect == null)
84:                 {
85:                     return true;
86:                 }
87: 
88:                 if (p.IslamicAspect.StartTimeType == SessionStartTimeType.Fixed)
89:                 {
90:                     return true;
91:                 }
92: 
93:                 return p.IslamicAspect.ReferencePrayer.HasValue
94:                     && p.IslamicAspect.OffsetMinutes.HasValue
95:                     && p.LocationId.HasValue;
96:             })
97:             .WithMessage("Islamic session scheduling requires LocationId, ReferencePrayer, and OffsetMinutes when StartTimeType is RelativeToPrayer.");
98:     }
99: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/IndexedDid/Validators/CreateIndexedDidDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 2: using FluentValidation;
 3: 
 4: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.IndexedDid.Validators;
 5: 
 6: public class CreateIndexedDidDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateIndexedDidDto>
 7: {
 8:     public CreateIndexedDidDtoValidator()
 9:     {
10:         RuleFor(x => x.Did)
11:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Did is required")
12:             .MaximumLength(255).WithMessage("Did must not exceed 255 characters")
13:             .Must(BeValidDidFormat).WithMessage("Did must be in valid format (did:plc:xxx or did:web:xxx)");
14: 
15:         RuleFor(x => x.PdsHost)
16:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("PDS host is required")
17:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("PDS host must not exceed 500 characters");
18: 
19:         RuleFor(x => x.Handle)
20:             .MaximumLength(255).WithMessage("Handle must not exceed 255 characters");
21: 
22:         RuleFor(x => x.SigningKey)
23:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("Signing key must not exceed 500 characters");
24: 
25:         RuleFor(x => x.LastIndexedAt)
26:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Last indexed at is required");
27:     }
28: 
29:     private bool BeValidDidFormat(string did)
30:     {
31:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(did)) return false;
32:         return did.StartsWith("did:plc:") || did.StartsWith("did:web:");
33:     }
34: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/Location/Validators/UpdateLocationDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: using FluentValidation;
 2: 
 3: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.Location.Validators;
 4: 
 5: public class UpdateLocationDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<UpdateLocationDto>
 6: {
 7:     public UpdateLocationDtoValidator()
 8:     {
 9:         RuleFor(p => p.Id)
10:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.");
11: 
12:         RuleFor(p => p.FullName)
13:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
14:             .NotNull()
15:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
16: 
17:         RuleFor(p => p.Address)
18:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
19:             .NotNull()
20:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
21: 
22:         RuleFor(p => p.Postcode)
23:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
24:             .NotNull()
25:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
26: 
27:         RuleFor(p => p.Country)
28:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
29:             .NotNull()
30:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
31: 
32:         RuleFor(p => p.City)
33:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
34:             .NotNull()
35:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
36: 
37:         RuleFor(p => p.Latitude)
38:             .InclusiveBetween(-90, 90).When(p => p.Latitude.HasValue)
39:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be between -90 and 90.");
40: 
41:         RuleFor(p => p.Longitude)
42:             .InclusiveBetween(-180, 180).When(p => p.Longitude.HasValue)
43:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be between -180 and 180.");
44: 
45:         RuleFor(p => p.Timezone)
46:             .MaximumLength(500).When(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.Timezone))
47:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
48:     }
49: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/StorageObject/Validators/UploadRequestDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: using FluentValidation;
 2: 
 3: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.StorageObject.Validators;
 4: 
 5: public class UploadRequestDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<UploadRequestDto>
 6: {
 7:     public UploadRequestDtoValidator()
 8:     {
 9:         RuleFor(x => x.FileName)
10:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
11:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters");
12: 
13:         RuleFor(x => x.ContentType)
14:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
15:             .MaximumLength(100).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 100 characters")
16:             .Must(BeValidContentType).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be a valid MIME type");
17:     }
18: 
19:     private bool BeValidContentType(string contentType)
20:     {
21:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(contentType)) return false;
22: 
23:         return contentType.Contains("/") && contentType.Split('/').Length == 2;
24:     }
25: }
````

16:         _tagTypeRepository = tagTypeRepository;
17: 
18:         RuleFor(x => x.Id)
19:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Id is required");
20: 
21:         RuleFor(x => x.TagId)
22:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Tag is required")
23:             .MustAsync(TagExists)
24:             .WithMessage("Tag not found");
25: 
26:         RuleFor(x => x.TagTypeId)
27:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Tag Type is required")
28:             .MustAsync(TagTypeExists)
29:             .WithMessage("Tag Type not found");
30:     }
31: 
32:     private async Task<bool> TagExists(Guid tagId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
33:     {
34:         return await _tagRepository.Exists(tagId);
35:     }
36: 
37:     private async Task<bool> TagTypeExists(int tagTypeId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
38:     {
39:         return await _tagTypeRepository.Exists(tagTypeId);
40:     }
41: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/ActorKeyStores/Handlers/Commands/UpdateActorKeyStoreCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using AutoMapper;
 2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 3: using Explore.Application.DTOs.ActorKeyStore;
 4: using Explore.Application.DTOs.ActorKeyStore.Validators;
 5: using Explore.Application.Features.ActorKeyStores.Requests.Commands;
 6: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 7: using Explore.Domain;
 8: using FluentValidation;
 9: using MediatR;
10: 
11: namespace Explore.Application.Features.ActorKeyStores.Handlers.Commands;
12: 
13: public class UpdateActorKeyStoreCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateActorKeyStoreCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
14: {
15:     private readonly IActorKeyStoreRepository _actorKeyStoreRepository;
16:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
17:     private readonly IValidator<UpdateActorKeyStoreDto> _validator;
18: 
19:     public UpdateActorKeyStoreCommandHandler(
20:         IActorKeyStoreRepository actorKeyStoreRepository,
21:         IMapper mapper,
22:         IValidator<UpdateActorKeyStoreDto> validator)
23:     {
24:         _actorKeyStoreRepository = actorKeyStoreRepository;
25:         _mapper = mapper;
26:         _validator = validator;
27:     }
28: 
29:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateActorKeyStoreCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
30:     {
31:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
32: 
33:         var validationResult = await _validator.ValidateAsync(request.ActorKeyStoreDto, cancellationToken);
34: 
35:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
36:         {
37:             response.Success = false;
38:             response.Message = "Actor Key Store update failed.";
39:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
40:             return response;
41:         }
42: 
43:         var existingKeyStore = await _actorKeyStoreRepository.GetById(request.ActorKeyStoreDto.Id);
44:         if (existingKeyStore == null)
45:         {
46:             response.Success = false;
47:             response.Message = "Actor Key Store not found.";
48:             return response;
49:         }
50: 
51:         _mapper.Map(request.ActorKeyStoreDto, existingKeyStore);
52:         await _actorKeyStoreRepository.Update(existingKeyStore);
53: 
54:         response.Success = true;
55:         response.Id = existingKeyStore.Id;
56:         response.Message = "Actor Key Store updated successfully.";
57: 
58:         return response;
59:     }
60: }
````

15:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
16:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
17: 
18:     public UpdateActorCommandHandler(
19:         IActorRepository actorRepository,
20:         IActorTypeRepository actorTypeRepository,
21:         IDidCustodyTypeRepository didCustodyTypeRepository,
22:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository,
23:         IMapper mapper)
24:     {
25:         _actorRepository = actorRepository;
26:         _actorTypeRepository = actorTypeRepository;
27:         _didCustodyTypeRepository = didCustodyTypeRepository;
28:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
29:         _mapper = mapper;
30:     }
31: 
32:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateActorCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
33:     {

35:

37:             _actorTypeRepository,
38:             _didCustodyTypeRepository,

62:

## File: Explore.Application/Features/AtprotoRecords/Handlers/Commands/CreateAtprotoRecordCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using AutoMapper;
 2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 3: using Explore.Application.DTOs.AtprotoRecord.Validators;
 4: using Explore.Application.Features.AtprotoRecords.Requests.Commands;
 5: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 6: using Explore.Domain;
 7: using MediatR;
 8: 
 9: namespace Explore.Application.Features.AtprotoRecords.Handlers.Commands;
10: 
11: public class CreateAtprotoRecordCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateAtprotoRecordCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
12: {
13:     private readonly IAtprotoRecordRepository _atprotoRecordRepository;
14:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
15: 
16:     public CreateAtprotoRecordCommandHandler(
17:         IAtprotoRecordRepository atprotoRecordRepository,
18:         IMapper mapper)
19:     {
20:         _atprotoRecordRepository = atprotoRecordRepository;
21:         _mapper = mapper;
22:     }
23: 
24:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(CreateAtprotoRecordCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
25:     {
26:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
27: 
28: 
29:         var validator = new CreateAtprotoRecordDtoValidator();
30:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.AtprotoRecordDto, cancellationToken);
31: 
32:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
33:         {
34:             response.Success = false;
35:             response.Message = "AtprotoRecord creation failed.";
36:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
37:             return response;
38:         }
39: 
40:         var atprotoRecord = _mapper.Map<AtprotoRecord>(request.AtprotoRecordDto);
41: 
42:         atprotoRecord = await _atprotoRecordRepository.Create(atprotoRecord);
43: 
44:         response.Success = true;
45:         response.Id = atprotoRecord.Id;
46:         response.Message = "AtprotoRecord created successfully.";
47: 
48:         return response;
49:     }
50: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Categories/Handlers/Commands/UpdateCategoryCommandHandler.cs

 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;

 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 7: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Category.Validators;
 8: using Explore.Application.Features.Categories.Requests.Commands;

11: using MediatR;
12: using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Hybrid;
13: 
14: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Categories.Handlers.Commands;
15: 
16: public class UpdateCategoryCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateCategoryCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
17: {
18:     private readonly ICategoryRepository _categoryRepository;
19:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
20:     private readonly HybridCache _cache;
21: 
22:     public UpdateCategoryCommandHandler(
23:         ICategoryRepository categoryRepository,
24:         IMapper mapper,
25:         HybridCache cache)
26:     {
27:         _categoryRepository = categoryRepository;
28:         _mapper = mapper;
29:         _cache = cache;
30:     }
31: 
32:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateCategoryCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
33:     {
34:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
35: 
36:         var validator = new UpdateCategoryDtoValidator(_categoryRepository);
37:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.CategoryDto, cancellationToken);
38: 
39:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
40:         {
41:             response.Success = false;
42:             response.Message = "Category update failed.";
43:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
44:             return response;
45:         }
46: 
47:         var category = await _categoryRepository.GetById(request.CategoryDto.Id);
48: 
49:         if (category == null)
50:         {
51:             response.Success = false;
52:             response.Message = "Category not found.";
53:             return response;
54:         }
55: 
56:         _mapper.Map(request.CategoryDto, category);
57: 
58:         await _categoryRepository.Update(category);
59: 
60:         response.Success = true;
61:         response.Id = category.Id;
62:         response.Message = "Category updated successfully.";
63: 
64:         await _cache.RemoveAsync("categories:list:1:20", cancellationToken);
65: 
66:         return response;
67:     }
68: }

## File: Explore.Application/Features/EventCategories/Handlers/Commands/UpdateEventCategoriesCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 7: using Explore.Application.DTOs.EventCategories.Validators;
 8: using Explore.Application.Features.EventCategories.Requests.Commands;
 9: using Explore.Application.Responses;
10: using MediatR;
11: 
12: namespace Explore.Application.Features.EventCategories.Handlers.Commands;
13: 
14: public class UpdateEventCategoriesCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateEventCategoriesCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
15: {
16:     private readonly IEventCategoriesRepository _eventCategoriesRepository;
17:     private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
18:     private readonly ICategoryRepository _categoryRepository;
19:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
20: 
21:     public UpdateEventCategoriesCommandHandler(
22:         IEventCategoriesRepository eventCategoriesRepository,
23:         IEventRepository eventRepository,
24:         ICategoryRepository categoryRepository,
25:         IMapper mapper)
26:     {
27:         _eventCategoriesRepository = eventCategoriesRepository;
28:         _eventRepository = eventRepository;
29:         _categoryRepository = categoryRepository;
30:         _mapper = mapper;
31:     }
32: 
33:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateEventCategoriesCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
34:     {
35:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
36: 
37:         var validator = new UpdateEventCategoriesDtoValidator(_eventRepository, _categoryRepository, _eventCategoriesRepository);
38:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.EventCategoriesDto, cancellationToken);
39: 
40:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
41:         {
42:             response.Success = false;
43:             response.Message = "Event Category update failed.";
44:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
45:             return response;
46:         }
47: 
48:         var eventCategories = await _eventCategoriesRepository.GetById(request.EventCategoriesDto.Id);
49: 
50:         if (eventCategories == null)
51:         {
52:             response.Success = false;
53:             response.Message = "Event Category not found.";
54:             return response;
55:         }
56: 
57:         _mapper.Map(request.EventCategoriesDto, eventCategories);
58:         await _eventCategoriesRepository.Update(eventCategories);
59: 
60:         response.Success = true;
61:         response.Id = eventCategories.Id;
62:         response.Message = "Event Category updated successfully.";
63: 
64:         return response;
65:     }
66: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Events/Handlers/Queries/GetEventDetailsRequestHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Collections.Generic;
 3: using System.Text;
 4: using AutoMapper;
 5: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 7: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Event;
 8: using Explore.Application.Features.Events.Requests.Queries;
 9: using MediatR;
10: using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Hybrid;
11: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
12: 
13: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Events.Handlers.Queries;
14: 
15: public class GetEventDetailsRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetEventDetailsRequest, EventDto>
16: {
17:     private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
18:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
19:     private readonly IObjectStorageService _objectStorageService;
20:     private readonly ILogger<GetEventDetailsRequestHandler> _logger;
21:     private readonly HybridCache _cache;
22: 
23:     public GetEventDetailsRequestHandler(
24:         IEventRepository eventRepository,
25:         IMapper mapper,
26:         IObjectStorageService objectStorageService,
27:         ILogger<GetEventDetailsRequestHandler> logger,
28:         HybridCache cache)
29:     {
30:         _eventRepository = eventRepository;
31:         _mapper = mapper;
32:         _objectStorageService = objectStorageService;
33:         _logger = logger;
34:         _cache = cache;
35:     }
36: 
37:     public async Task<EventDto> Handle(GetEventDetailsRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
38:     {
39:         var cacheKey = $"event:detail:{request.Id}";
40: 
41:         var eventDto = await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
42:             cacheKey,
43:             async _ =>
44:             {
45:                 var @event = await _eventRepository.GetEventWithDetails(request.Id);
46:                 return _mapper.Map<EventDto>(@event);
47:             },
48:             new HybridCacheEntryOptions
49:             {
50:                 Expiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
51:                 LocalCacheExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
52:             },
53:             cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
54: 
55: 
56:         if (eventDto != null)
57:         {
58:             eventDto.FeaturedImageUri = await ResolveImageUrl(eventDto.FeaturedImageUri);
59:             eventDto.ActorProfilePictureUri = await ResolveImageUrl(eventDto.ActorProfilePictureUri);
60:         }
61: 
62:         return eventDto;
63:     }
64: 
65: 
66: 
67: 
68: 
69:     private async Task<string?> ResolveImageUrl(string? objectKeyOrUri)
70:     {
71:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(objectKeyOrUri))
72:             return null;
73: 
74:         try
75:         {
76: 
77:             if (objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
78:                 objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
79:             {
80: 
81:                 if (Uri.TryCreate(objectKeyOrUri, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
82:                 {
83:                     var objectKey = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
84:                     return await _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKey, 60);
85:                 }
86:                 return objectKeyOrUri;
87:             }
88: 
89: 
90:             return await _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKeyOrUri, 60);
91:         }
92:         catch (Exception ex)
93:         {
94:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to generate presigned URL for object key: {ObjectKey}", objectKeyOrUri);
95:             return null;
96:         }
97:     }
98: }
````

 3: using System.Threading;

 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 7: using Explore.Application.DTOs.EventSessionAgendaItem.Validators;

14: public class UpdateEventSessionAgendaItemCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateEventSessionAgendaItemCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
15: {
16:     private readonly IEventSessionAgendaItemRepository _agendaItemRepository;
17:     private readonly IEventSessionRepository _eventSessionRepository;
18:     private readonly ILocationRepository _locationRepository;
19:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
20: 
21:     public UpdateEventSessionAgendaItemCommandHandler(
22:         IEventSessionAgendaItemRepository agendaItemRepository,
23:         IEventSessionRepository eventSessionRepository,
24:         ILocationRepository locationRepository,
25:         IMapper mapper)
26:     {
27:         _agendaItemRepository = agendaItemRepository;
28:         _eventSessionRepository = eventSessionRepository;
29:         _locationRepository = locationRepository;
30:         _mapper = mapper;
31:     }
32: 
33:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateEventSessionAgendaItemCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
34:     {
35:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
36: 
37:         var validator = new UpdateEventSessionAgendaItemDtoValidator(_eventSessionRepository, _locationRepository);
38:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.AgendaItemDto, cancellationToken);
39: 
40:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
41:         {
42:             response.Success = false;
43:             response.Message = "Agenda item update failed.";
44:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
45:             return response;
46:         }
47: 
48:         var agendaItem = await _agendaItemRepository.GetById(request.AgendaItemDto.Id);
49: 
50:         if (agendaItem == null)
51:         {
52:             response.Success = false;
53:             response.Message = "Agenda item not found.";
54:             return response;
55:         }
56: 
57:         _mapper.Map(request.AgendaItemDto, agendaItem);
58: 
59:         await _agendaItemRepository.Update(agendaItem);
60: 
61:         response.Success = true;
62:         response.Id = agendaItem.Id;
63:         response.Message = "Agenda item updated successfully.";
64: 
65:         return response;
66:     }
67: }
