## File: Explore.Application/Features/EventSessions/Handlers/Commands/UpdateEventSessionCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 7: using Explore.Application.DTOs.EventSession.Validators;
 8: using Explore.Application.Features.EventSessions.Requests.Commands;
 9: using Explore.Application.Responses;
10: using Explore.Domain;
11: using MediatR;
12: 
13: namespace Explore.Application.Features.EventSessions.Handlers.Commands;
14: 
15: public class UpdateEventSessionCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateEventSessionCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
16: {
17:     private readonly IEventSessionRepository _eventSessionRepository;
18:     private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
19:     private readonly ILocationRepository _locationRepository;
20:     private readonly IRegistrationModeRepository _registrationModeRepository;
21:     private readonly IEventSessionIslamicAspectRepository _eventSessionIslamicAspectRepository;
22:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
23: 
24:     public UpdateEventSessionCommandHandler(
25:         IEventSessionRepository eventSessionRepository,
26:         IEventRepository eventRepository,
27:         ILocationRepository locationRepository,
28:         IRegistrationModeRepository registrationModeRepository,
29:         IEventSessionIslamicAspectRepository eventSessionIslamicAspectRepository,
30:         IMapper mapper)
31:     {
32:         _eventSessionRepository = eventSessionRepository;
33:         _eventRepository = eventRepository;
34:         _locationRepository = locationRepository;
35:         _registrationModeRepository = registrationModeRepository;
36:         _eventSessionIslamicAspectRepository = eventSessionIslamicAspectRepository;
37:         _mapper = mapper;
38:     }
39: 
40:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateEventSessionCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
41:     {
42:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
43: 
44:         var validator = new UpdateEventSessionDtoValidator(_eventRepository, _locationRepository, _registrationModeRepository);
45:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.EventSessionDto, cancellationToken);
46: 
47:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
48:         {
49:             response.Success = false;
50:             response.Message = "Event session update failed.";
51:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
52:             return response;
53:         }
54: 
55:         var eventSession = await _eventSessionRepository.GetById(request.EventSessionDto.Id);
56: 
57:         if (eventSession == null)
58:         {
59:             response.Success = false;
60:             response.Message = "Event session not found.";
61:             return response;
62:         }
63: 
64:         _mapper.Map(request.EventSessionDto, eventSession);
65: 
66:         await _eventSessionRepository.Update(eventSession);
67: 
68:         var existingIslamicAspect = await _eventSessionIslamicAspectRepository.GetById(eventSession.Id);
69:         if (request.EventSessionDto.IslamicAspect == null)
70:         {
71:             if (existingIslamicAspect != null)
72:             {
73:                 await _eventSessionIslamicAspectRepository.Delete(existingIslamicAspect);
74:             }
75:         }
76:         else if (existingIslamicAspect == null)
77:         {
78:             var newAspect = _mapper.Map<EventSessionIslamicAspect>(request.EventSessionDto.IslamicAspect);
79:             newAspect.EventSessionId = eventSession.Id;
80:             newAspect.EventSession = null;
81:             await _eventSessionIslamicAspectRepository.Create(newAspect);
82:         }
83:         else
84:         {
85:             _mapper.Map(request.EventSessionDto.IslamicAspect, existingIslamicAspect);
86:             await _eventSessionIslamicAspectRepository.Update(existingIslamicAspect);
87:         }
88: 
89:         response.Success = true;
90:         response.Id = eventSession.Id;
91:         response.Message = "Event session updated successfully.";
92: 
93:         return response;
94:     }
95: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/EventSessionSpeakers/Handlers/Commands/UpdateEventSessionSpeakerCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 7: using Explore.Application.DTOs.EventSessionSpeaker.Validators;
 8: using Explore.Application.Features.EventSessionSpeakers.Requests.Commands;
 9: using Explore.Application.Responses;
10: using MediatR;
11: 
12: namespace Explore.Application.Features.EventSessionSpeakers.Handlers.Commands;
13: 
14: public class UpdateEventSessionSpeakerCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateEventSessionSpeakerCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
15: {
16:     private readonly IEventSessionSpeakerRepository _speakerRepository;
17:     private readonly IActorRepository _actorRepository;
18:     private readonly IEventSessionRepository _eventSessionRepository;
19:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
20: 
21:     public UpdateEventSessionSpeakerCommandHandler(
22:         IEventSessionSpeakerRepository speakerRepository,
23:         IActorRepository actorRepository,
24:         IEventSessionRepository eventSessionRepository,
25:         IMapper mapper)
26:     {
27:         _speakerRepository = speakerRepository;
28:         _actorRepository = actorRepository;
29:         _eventSessionRepository = eventSessionRepository;
30:         _mapper = mapper;
31:     }
32: 
33:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateEventSessionSpeakerCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
34:     {
35:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
36: 
37:         var validator = new UpdateEventSessionSpeakerDtoValidator(_actorRepository, _eventSessionRepository);
38:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.SpeakerDto, cancellationToken);
39: 
40:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
41:         {
42:             response.Success = false;
43:             response.Message = "Speaker assignment update failed.";
44:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
45:             return response;
46:         }
47: 
48:         var speaker = await _speakerRepository.GetById(request.SpeakerDto.Id);
49: 
50:         if (speaker == null)
51:         {
52:             response.Success = false;
53:             response.Message = "Speaker assignment not found.";
54:             return response;
55:         }
56: 
57:         _mapper.Map(request.SpeakerDto, speaker);
58: 
59:         await _speakerRepository.Update(speaker);
60: 
61:         response.Success = true;
62:         response.Id = speaker.Id;
63:         response.Message = "Speaker assignment updated successfully.";
64: 
65:         return response;
66:     }
67: }
````

 10: internal static class InstanceGovernanceSettingHelpers

 18:     internal static async Task<InstanceGovernanceSettingsDto> ReadSettingsAsync(ISystemSettingRepository systemSettingRepository)
 19:     {
 20:         var deploymentMode = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.DeploymentMode);
 21:         var tenantSelfService = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.TenantSelfServiceRegistration);
 22:         var tenantWhiteLabeling = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.TenantWhiteLabelingEnabled);
 23:         var defaultHomePage = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.RoutingDefaultPublicHomePage);
 24:         var islamicModule = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.ModulesIslamicEnabled);
 25:         var techModule = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.ModulesTechEnabled);
 26:         var userSubmittedEvents = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.EventsUserSubmissionEnabled);
 27:         var orgVerificationRequired = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.OrganizationsVerificationRequired);
 28:         var tenantCanOmitVerification = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.OrganizationsTenantCanOmitVerification);
 29:         var instanceBaseDomain = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.DomainsInstanceBaseDomain);
 30:         var allowTenantCustomDomains = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.DomainsAllowTenantCustomDomain);
 31:         var tenantSubdomain = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.DomainsTenantSubdomain);
 32:         var tenantCustomDomain = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.DomainsTenantCustomDomain);
 33:         var brandingDisplayName = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.BrandingDisplayName);
 34:         var brandingLogoUrl = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.BrandingLogoUrl);
 35:         var brandingFaviconUrl = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.BrandingFaviconUrl);
 36:         var brandingCustomCssUrl = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.BrandingCustomCssUrl);
 37: 
 38:         return new InstanceGovernanceSettingsDto
 39:         {
 40:             DeploymentMode = DeserializeString(deploymentMode?.Value, "SingleTenant"),
 41:             AllowTenantSelfServiceRegistration = DeserializeBoolean(tenantSelfService?.Value, false),
 42:             AllowTenantWhiteLabeling = DeserializeBoolean(tenantWhiteLabeling?.Value, false),
 43:             DefaultPublicHomePage = NormalizeHomePage(DeserializeString(defaultHomePage?.Value, DefaultPublicHomePage)),
 44:             EnableIslamicModule = DeserializeBoolean(islamicModule?.Value, true),
 45:             EnableTechModule = DeserializeBoolean(techModule?.Value, true),
 46:             AllowUserSubmittedEvents = DeserializeBoolean(userSubmittedEvents?.Value, true),
 47:             RequireOrganizationVerification = DeserializeBoolean(orgVerificationRequired?.Value, true),
 48:             AllowTenantToOmitVerification = DeserializeBoolean(tenantCanOmitVerification?.Value, false),
 49:             InstanceBaseDomain = DeserializeString(instanceBaseDomain?.Value, string.Empty),
 50:             AllowTenantCustomDomains = DeserializeBoolean(allowTenantCustomDomains?.Value, true),
 51:             DefaultBrandDisplayName = DeserializeString(brandingDisplayName?.Value, DefaultBrandDisplayName),
 52:             DefaultBrandLogoUrl = DeserializeString(brandingLogoUrl?.Value, string.Empty),
 53:             DefaultBrandFaviconUrl = DeserializeString(brandingFaviconUrl?.Value, string.Empty),
 54:             DefaultBrandCustomCssUrl = DeserializeString(brandingCustomCssUrl?.Value, string.Empty),
 55:             LockTenantHomePagePreference = defaultHomePage?.IsLocked == true,
 56:             LockTenantSubdomain = tenantSubdomain?.IsLocked == true,
 57:             LockTenantCustomDomain = tenantCustomDomain?.IsLocked == true,
 58:             LockTenantBrandDisplayName = brandingDisplayName?.IsLocked == true,
 59:             LockTenantBrandLogoUrl = brandingLogoUrl?.IsLocked == true,
 60:             LockTenantBrandFaviconUrl = brandingFaviconUrl?.IsLocked == true,
 61:             LockTenantBrandCustomCssUrl = brandingCustomCssUrl?.IsLocked == true
 62:         };
 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     internal static async Task ApplySettingsAsync(
 66:         ISystemSettingRepository systemSettingRepository,
 67:         ITenantCapabilityRepository tenantCapabilityRepository,
 68:         IModuleDefinitionRepository moduleDefinitionRepository,
 69:         Guid defaultTenantId,
 70:         InstanceGovernanceSettingsDto settings,
 71:         Guid? actorUserId)
 72:     {
 73:         settings.DefaultPublicHomePage = NormalizeHomePage(settings.DefaultPublicHomePage);
 74:         settings.InstanceBaseDomain = NormalizeOptionalHost(settings.InstanceBaseDomain);
 75:         settings.DefaultBrandDisplayName = NormalizeRequiredDisplayName(settings.DefaultBrandDisplayName);
 76:         settings.DefaultBrandLogoUrl = NormalizeOptionalUrl(settings.DefaultBrandLogoUrl);
 77:         settings.DefaultBrandFaviconUrl = NormalizeOptionalUrl(settings.DefaultBrandFaviconUrl);
 78:         settings.DefaultBrandCustomCssUrl = NormalizeOptionalUrl(settings.DefaultBrandCustomCssUrl);
 79: 
 80:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(
 81:             systemSettingRepository,
 82:             GovernanceSettingKeys.DeploymentMode,
 83:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.DeploymentMode),
 84:             SettingValueType.String,
 85:             true,
 86:             "System",
 87:             1,
 88:             "Deployment mode of the application",
 89:             "[\"SingleTenant\", \"MultiTenant\"]");
 90: 
 91:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(
 92:             systemSettingRepository,
 93:             GovernanceSettingKeys.TenantSelfServiceRegistration,
 94:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.AllowTenantSelfServiceRegistration),
 95:             SettingValueType.Boolean,
 96:             false,
 97:             "Tenant",
 98:             1,
 99:             "Whether tenants can self-register without manual instance admin invitation");
100: 
101:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(
102:             systemSettingRepository,
103:             GovernanceSettingKeys.TenantWhiteLabelingEnabled,
104:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.DeploymentMode == "MultiTenant" && settings.AllowTenantWhiteLabeling),
105:             SettingValueType.Boolean,
106:             false,
107:             "Tenant",
108:             2,
109:             "Whether tenant-level white-label branding overrides are enabled in multi-tenant mode");
110: 
111:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(
112:             systemSettingRepository,
113:             GovernanceSettingKeys.RoutingDefaultPublicHomePage,
114:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.DefaultPublicHomePage),
115:             SettingValueType.String,
116:             settings.LockTenantHomePagePreference,
117:             "Routing",
118:             1,
119:             "Default public landing experience for tenant domains",
120:             "[\"EventList\", \"LandingPage\"]");
121: 
122:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(
123:             systemSettingRepository,
124:             GovernanceSettingKeys.ModulesIslamicEnabled,
125:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.EnableIslamicModule),
126:             SettingValueType.Boolean,
127:             false,
128:             "Modules",
129:             1,
130:             "Enable Islamic event module");
131: 
132:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(
133:             systemSettingRepository,
134:             GovernanceSettingKeys.ModulesTechEnabled,
135:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.EnableTechModule),
136:             SettingValueType.Boolean,
137:             false,
138:             "Modules",
139:             2,
140:             "Enable Tech event module");
141: 
142:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(
143:             systemSettingRepository,
144:             GovernanceSettingKeys.EventsUserSubmissionEnabled,
145:             JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings.AllowUserSubmittedEvents),
146:             SettingValueType.Boolean,
147:             false,
148:             "Events",
149:             3,
150:             "Whether tenant users are allowed to submit events");
151: 
152:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(
153:             systemSettingRepository,
154:             GovernanceSettingKeys.OrganizationsVerificationRequired,

161:

166:             SettingValueType.Boolean,

168:             "Organizations",

171: 
172:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(
173:             systemSettingRepository,
174:             GovernanceSettingKeys.DomainsInstanceBaseDomain,

178:             "Domains",
179:             1,

181: 
182:         await UpsertSystemSettingAsync(

277:     internal static int DeserializeInt(string? rawValue, int defaultValue)
278:     {
279:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawValue))
280:         {
281:             return defaultValue;
282:         }
283: 
284:         try
285:         {
286:             return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<int>(rawValue);
287:         }
288:         catch
289:         {
290:             return int.TryParse(rawValue, out var parsed) ? parsed : defaultValue;
291:         }
292:     }
293: 
294:     internal static bool DeserializeBoolean(string? rawValue, bool defaultValue)
295:     {
296:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawValue))
297:         {
298:             return defaultValue;
299:         }
300: 
301:         try
302:         {
303:             return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<bool>(rawValue);
304:         }
305:         catch
306:         {
307:             return bool.TryParse(rawValue, out var parsed) ? parsed : defaultValue;
308:         }
309:     }
310: 
311:     private static string NormalizeRequiredDisplayName(string? value)
312:     {
313:         return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? DefaultBrandDisplayName : value.Trim();
314:     }
315: 
316:     private static string NormalizeOptionalUrl(string? value)
317:     {
318:         return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? string.Empty : value.Trim();
319:     }
320: 
321:     private static string NormalizeOptionalHost(string? value)
322:     {
323:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
324:         {
325:             return string.Empty;
326:         }
327: 
328:         var sanitized = value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
329:         sanitized = sanitized.Replace("https://", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
330:         sanitized = sanitized.Replace("http://", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
331:         sanitized = sanitized.Trim().Trim('/');
332:         return sanitized;
333:     }
334: 
335:     private static string NormalizeHomePage(string? raw)
336:     {
337:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw))
338:         {
339:             return DefaultPublicHomePage;
340:         }
341: 
342:         if (raw.Equals("LandingPage", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
343:         {
344:             return "LandingPage";
345:         }
346: 
347:         return "EventList";
348:     }
349: 
350:     internal static string DeserializeString(string? rawValue, string defaultValue)
351:     {
352:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawValue))
353:         {
354:             return defaultValue;
355:         }
356: 
357:         try
358:         {
359:             var deserialized = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<string>(rawValue);
360:             return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(deserialized) ? defaultValue : deserialized;
361:         }
362:         catch
363:         {
364:             return rawValue.Trim('"');
365:         }
366:     }
367: 
368:     private static async Task UpsertSystemSettingAsync(
369:         ISystemSettingRepository systemSettingRepository,
370:         string settingKey,
371:         string value,
372:         SettingValueType valueType,
373:         bool isLocked,
374:         string category,
375:         int displayOrder,
376:         string description,
377:         string? allowedValues = null)
378:     {
379:         var existing = await systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(settingKey);
380: 
381:         if (existing == null)
382:         {
383:             await systemSettingRepository.Create(new SystemSetting
384:             {
385:                 SettingKey = settingKey,
386:                 Value = value,
387:                 ValueType = valueType,
388:                 IsLocked = isLocked,
389:                 AllowedValues = allowedValues,
390:                 Description = description,
391:                 Category = category,
392:                 DisplayOrder = displayOrder,
393:                 CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
394:             });
395: 
396:             return;
397:         }
398: 
399:         existing.Value = value;
400:         existing.ValueType = valueType;
401:         existing.IsLocked = isLocked;
402:         existing.AllowedValues = allowedValues;
403:         existing.Description = description;
404:         existing.Category = category;
405:         existing.DisplayOrder = displayOrder;
406:         existing.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
407: 
408:         await systemSettingRepository.Update(existing);
409:     }
410: 
411:     private static async Task UpsertTenantCapabilityAsync(
412:         ITenantCapabilityRepository tenantCapabilityRepository,
413:         IModuleDefinitionRepository moduleDefinitionRepository,
414:         Guid tenantId,
415:         string moduleKey,
416:         bool isEnabled,
417:         Guid? actorUserId)
418:     {
419:         var module = await moduleDefinitionRepository.GetByKey(moduleKey);
420:         if (module == null)
421:         {
422:             return;
423:         }
424: 
425:         var existing = await tenantCapabilityRepository.GetByTenantAndModuleKey(tenantId, moduleKey);
426:         if (existing == null)
427:         {
428:             await tenantCapabilityRepository.Create(new TenantCapability
429:             {
430:                 TenantId = tenantId,
431:                 Tenant = null!,
432:                 ModuleId = module.Id,
433:                 Module = null!,
434:                 IsEnabled = isEnabled,
435:                 EnabledAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
436:                 EnabledBy = actorUserId
437:             });
438: 
439:             return;
440:         }
441: 
442:         existing.IsEnabled = isEnabled;
443:         if (isEnabled && existing.EnabledAt == default)
444:         {
445:             existing.EnabledAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
446:             existing.EnabledBy = actorUserId;
447:         }
448: 
449:         await tenantCapabilityRepository.Update(existing);
450:     }
451: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Locations/Handlers/Commands/UpdateLocationCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 7: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Location.Validators;
 8: using Explore.Application.Features.Locations.Requests.Commands;
 9: using Explore.Application.Responses;
10: using Explore.Domain;
11: using MediatR;
12: 
13: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Locations.Handlers.Commands;
14: 
15: public class UpdateLocationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateLocationCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
16: {
17:     private readonly ILocationRepository _locationRepository;
18:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
19: 
20:     public UpdateLocationCommandHandler(
21:         ILocationRepository locationRepository,
22:         IMapper mapper)
23:     {
24:         _locationRepository = locationRepository;
25:         _mapper = mapper;
26:     }
27: 
28:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateLocationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
29:     {
30:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
31: 
32:         var validator = new UpdateLocationDtoValidator();
33:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.LocationDto, cancellationToken);
34: 
35:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
36:         {
37:             response.Success = false;
38:             response.Message = "Location update failed.";
39:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
40:             return response;
41:         }
42: 
43:         var location = await _locationRepository.GetById(request.LocationDto.Id);
44: 
45:         if (location == null)
46:         {
47:             response.Success = false;
48:             response.Message = "Location not found.";
49:             return response;
50:         }
51: 
52:         _mapper.Map(request.LocationDto, location);
53: 
54:         await _locationRepository.Update(location);
55: 
56:         response.Success = true;
57:         response.Id = location.Id;
58:         response.Message = "Location updated successfully.";
59: 
60:         return response;
61:     }
62: }
````

21:     private readonly HybridCache _cache;
22: 
23:     public GetOrganizationDetailsRequestHandler(
24:         IOrganizationRepository organizationRepository,
25:         IMapper mapper,
26:         IObjectStorageService objectStorageService,
27:         ILogger<GetOrganizationDetailsRequestHandler> logger,
28:         HybridCache cache)
29:     {
30:         _organizationRepository = organizationRepository;
31:         _mapper = mapper;
32:         _objectStorageService = objectStorageService;
33:         _logger = logger;
34:         _cache = cache;
35:     }
36: 
37:     public async Task<OrganizationDto> Handle(GetOrganizationDetailsRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
38:     {
39:         var cacheKey = $"organization:detail:{request.Id}";
40:         var dto = await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
41:             cacheKey,
42:             async _ =>
43:             {
44:                 var organization = await _organizationRepository.GetOrganizationWithDetails(request.Id);
45:                 return _mapper.Map<OrganizationDto>(organization);
46:             },
47:             new HybridCacheEntryOptions
48:             {
49:                 Expiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
50:                 LocalCacheExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
51:             },
52:             cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
53: 
54: 
55:         if (dto != null)
56:         {
57:             dto.ActorProfilePictureUri = await ResolveImageUrl(dto.ActorProfilePictureUri);
58:         }
59: 
60:         return dto;
61:     }
62: 
63: 
64: 
65: 
66:     private async Task<string?> ResolveImageUrl(string? objectKeyOrUri)
67:     {
68:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(objectKeyOrUri))
69:             return null;
70: 
71:         try
72:         {
73: 
74:             if (objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
75:                 objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
76:             {
77:                 if (Uri.TryCreate(objectKeyOrUri, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
78:                 {
79:                     var objectKey = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
80:                     return await _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKey, 60);
81:                 }
82:                 return objectKeyOrUri;
83:             }
84: 
85: 
86:             return await _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKeyOrUri, 60);
87:         }
88:         catch (Exception ex)
89:         {
90:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to generate presigned URL for object key: {ObjectKey}", objectKeyOrUri);
91:             return null;
92:         }
93:     }
94: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Tags/Handlers/Commands/UpdateTagCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 7: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Tag.Validators;
 8: using Explore.Application.Features.Tags.Requests.Commands;
 9: using Explore.Application.Responses;
10: using MediatR;
11: 
12: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Tags.Handlers.Commands;
13: 
14: public class UpdateTagCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateTagCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
15: {
16:     private readonly ITagRepository _tagRepository;
17:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
18: 
19:     public UpdateTagCommandHandler(
20:         ITagRepository tagRepository,
21:         IMapper mapper)
22:     {
23:         _tagRepository = tagRepository;
24:         _mapper = mapper;
25:     }
26: 
27:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateTagCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
28:     {
29:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
30: 
31:         var validator = new UpdateTagDtoValidator();
32:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.TagDto, cancellationToken);
33: 
34:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
35:         {
36:             response.Success = false;
37:             response.Message = "Tag update failed.";
38:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
39:             return response;
40:         }
41: 
42:         var tag = await _tagRepository.GetById(request.TagDto.Id);
43: 
44:         if (tag == null)
45:         {
46:             response.Success = false;
47:             response.Message = "Tag not found.";
48:             return response;
49:         }
50: 
51:         _mapper.Map(request.TagDto, tag);
52: 
53:         await _tagRepository.Update(tag);
54: 
55:         response.Success = true;
56:         response.Id = tag.Id;
57:         response.Message = "Tag updated successfully.";
58: 
59:         return response;
60:     }
61: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Users/Handlers/Commands/USER_SYNC_DIAGNOSTICS.md
````markdown
  1: # User Sync Duplicate Email Error - Diagnostic Guide
  2: 
  3: ## Problem Description
  4: 
  5: **Error**: `PostgresException: 23505: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "ix_users_email"`
  6: 
  7: **When**: User sync endpoint `POST /api/User/sync` fails when there's already a user in the database with the same email.
  8: 
  9: ## Root Cause Analysis
 10: 
 11: The error occurs because of **insufficient checking** before attempting to create a user. The system needs to handle two distinct scenarios:
 12: 
 13: ### Scenario 1: Same User (? Should Update)
 14: - **Keycloak User ID**: `abc-123-def`
 15: - **Keycloak Email**: `user@example.com`
 16: - **Database User ID**: `abc-123-def` (same)
 17: - **Database Email**: `user@example.com` (same)
 18: - **Expected Behavior**: UPDATE existing user
 19: - **Current Behavior**: ? Works correctly (with recent fixes)
 20: 
 21: ### Scenario 2: Different Users (? Should Error)
 22: - **Keycloak User ID**: `xyz-789-ghi`
 23: - **Keycloak Email**: `user@example.com`
 24: - **Database User ID**: `abc-123-def` (different!)
 25: - **Database Email**: `user@example.com` (same)
 26: - **Expected Behavior**: Return error - email conflict
 27: - **Current Behavior**: ? Correctly returns error message
 28: 
 29: ### Scenario 3: Race Condition (? Should Retry)
 30: - Two concurrent sync requests for the same new user
 31: - Thread A creates user successfully
 32: - Thread B tries to create ? Gets duplicate key error
 33: - Thread B catches exception, fetches user, updates instead
 34: - **Current Behavior**: ? Handles correctly
 35: 
 36: ## How to Diagnose Your Specific Issue
 37: 
 38: With the enhanced logging added, when you run user sync, you'll see output like:
 39: 
 40: ```
 41: [USER SYNC] Starting sync for user - ID: abc-123-def, Email: user@example.com
 42: [USER SYNC] Existing user by ID: abc-123-def
 43: [USER SYNC] Existing user by email: abc-123-def
 44: [USER SYNC] Existing user found - Updating user ID: abc-123-def
 45: [USER SYNC] User update completed - ID: abc-123-def
 46: ```
 47: 
 48: ### If You See Scenario 1 (Same User):
 49: ```
 50: [USER SYNC] Existing user by ID: abc-123-def
 51: [USER SYNC] Existing user by email: abc-123-def
 52: ```
 53: ? **This is CORRECT** - the user should be updated, not created
 54: 
 55: ### If You See Scenario 2 (Email Conflict):
 56: ```
 57: [USER SYNC] Existing user by ID: NOT FOUND
 58: [USER SYNC] Existing user by email: xyz-789-ghi
 59: [USER SYNC] CONFLICT - Email exists with different ID...
 60: ```
 61: ? **This is a DATA INTEGRITY ISSUE** - you have two different Keycloak accounts with the same email
 62: 
 63: ### If You See Scenario 3 (Race Condition):
 64: ```
 65: [USER SYNC] No existing user found - Creating new user
 66: [USER SYNC] Race condition detected - User was created by another thread
 67: [USER SYNC] Found user created by another thread - ID: abc-123-def
 68: ```
 69: ? **This is NORMAL** - handled gracefully
 70: 
 71: ## Checking Your Database
 72: 
 73: Run this SQL to see what's in your database:
 74: 
 75: ```sql
 76: -- Check all users
 77: SELECT id, email, first_name, last_name, auth_provider, auth_provider_id, actor_id
 78: FROM users
 79: ORDER BY email;
 80: 
 81: -- Find duplicate emails
 82: SELECT email, COUNT(*) as count
 83: FROM users
 84: GROUP BY email
 85: HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
 86: 
 87: -- Check specific user
 88: SELECT id, email, first_name, last_name, auth_provider, auth_provider_id
 89: FROM users
 90: WHERE email = 'YOUR_EMAIL_HERE';
 91: ```
 92: 
 93: ## Current Logic Flow
 94: 
 95: ```
 96: START User Sync
 97:   ?
 98: Get Keycloak User Info (ID, Email, Name from JWT token)
 99:   ?
100: Check DB for existing user by ID
101:   ?
102: Check DB for existing user by Email
103:   ?
104: ???????????????????????????????????????????
105: ? Does email exist with DIFFERENT ID?     ?
106: ? (existingUserByEmail != null &&         ?
107: ?  existingUserByEmail.Id != userDto.Id)  ?
108: ???????????????????????????????????????????
109:   ? YES                              ? NO
110:   ?                                  ?
111: Return Error                    Continue
112: "Email conflict"                    ?
113:                               ???????????????????
114:                               ? User exists?    ?
115:                               ???????????????????
116:                               ? YES      ? NO
117:                               ?          ?
118:                          UPDATE     CREATE
119:                          User        ?
120:                          ?         Try Create
121:                                     ?
122:                               ??????????????????
123:                               ? Duplicate Key? ?
124:                               ??????????????????
125:                               ? YES      ? NO
126:                               ?          ?
127:                          Fetch &     Success
128:                          Update      ?
129:                          (Race 
130:                          Condition)
131:                          ?
132: ```
133: 
134: ## What To Do Based on Logs
135: 
136: ### Log Shows: "Existing user found - Updating"
137: ? **WORKING CORRECTLY**
138: - Your user exists in DB with same ID and email
139: - System is updating, not creating
140: - No duplicate key error should occur
141: - If error still occurs, check the UPDATE query
142: 
143: ### Log Shows: "CONFLICT - Email exists with different ID"
144: ? **DATA INTEGRITY ISSUE**
145: - You have TWO Keycloak accounts with the same email
146: - This is a configuration problem in Keycloak
147: - **Solution**: 
148:   1. Decide which Keycloak account is the correct one
149:   2. Merge or delete the other account in Keycloak
150:   3. OR: Manually update the database user record
151: 
152: ### Log Shows: "No existing user found - Creating new user" followed by duplicate error
153: ?? **POSSIBLE ISSUES**:
154: 
155: 1. **Case Sensitivity**:
156:    - Email in DB: `User@Example.com`
157:    - Email from Keycloak: `user@example.com`
158:    - PostgreSQL is case-sensitive by default
159:    - **Fix**: Normalize emails to lowercase
160: 
161: 2. **Whitespace**:
162:    - Email in DB: `user@example.com `
163:    - Email from Keycloak: `user@example.com`
164:    - **Fix**: Trim emails
165: 
166: 3. **Race Condition** (should be handled, but check logs):
167:    - Should see: "Race condition detected"
168:    - If not, the exception isn't being caught properly
169: 
170: ## Fixes Applied
171: 
172: ### 1. Enhanced Duplicate Detection
173: ? Check by BOTH ID and email before creating
174: ? Detect email conflicts with different IDs
175: ? Prefer existing user by ID over email
176: 
177: ### 2. Race Condition Handling
178: ? Catch `InvalidOperationException` when creating user
179: ? Retry by fetching user created by concurrent thread
180: ? Update instead of failing
181: 
182: ### 3. Comprehensive Logging
183: ? Log every step of the sync process
184: ? Log user IDs and emails for debugging
185: ? Log conflicts and race conditions
186: ? Log all exceptions with full details
187: 
188: ## Testing Your Fix
189: 
190: 1. **Test Same User Sync** (should work):
191:    ```bash
192:    # Login with existing user
193:    # Call POST /api/User/sync
194:    # Check logs for: "Existing user found - Updating"
195:    ```
196: 
197: 2. **Test New User Sync** (should work):
198:    ```bash
199:    # Login with brand new Keycloak user
200:    # Call POST /api/User/sync
201:    # Check logs for: "User created successfully"
202:    ```
203: 
204: 3. **Test Concurrent Syncs** (should work):
205:    ```bash
206:    # Open two browser tabs
207:    # Login with same NEW user in both
208:    # Call sync simultaneously
209:    # One should create, other should detect race condition
210:    ```
211: 
212: 4. **Test Email Conflict** (should error gracefully):
213:    ```bash
214:    # Manually create user in DB with email X and ID A
215:    # Login to Keycloak with different account (email X, ID B)
216:    # Call sync
217:    # Should see: "Email exists with different ID"
218:    ```
219: 
220: ## Recommended Next Steps
221: 
222: 1. **Run the application** with the enhanced logging
223: 2. **Try to sync your user** that's causing the error
224: 3. **Check the console logs** for the `[USER SYNC]` messages
225: 4. **Based on what you see**:
226:    - If "Existing user found" ? Should work! (update path)
227:    - If "CONFLICT" ? Fix Keycloak duplicate emails
228:    - If "Creating new user" then error ? Check for case/whitespace issues
229: 
230: ---
231: 
232: **With the enhanced logging, we can now precisely diagnose what's happening in your specific case.**

 1: using System.Threading;

 3: using AutoMapper;

 5: using Explore.Application.DTOs.VisibilityType;
 6: using Explore.Application.Features.VisibilityTypes.Requests.Queries;
 7: using MediatR;
 8: 
 9: namespace Explore.Application.Features.VisibilityTypes.Handlers.Queries;
10: 
11: public class GetVisibilityTypeDetailsRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetVisibilityTypeDetailsRequest, VisibilityTypeDto>
12: {
13:     private readonly IVisibilityTypeRepository _visibilityTypeRepository;
14:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
15: 
16:     public GetVisibilityTypeDetailsRequestHandler(IVisibilityTypeRepository visibilityTypeRepository, IMapper mapper)
17:     {
18:         _visibilityTypeRepository = visibilityTypeRepository;
19:         _mapper = mapper;
20:     }
21: 
22:     public async Task<VisibilityTypeDto> Handle(GetVisibilityTypeDetailsRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
23:     {
24:         var visibilityType = await _visibilityTypeRepository.GetById(request.Id);
25:         return _mapper.Map<VisibilityTypeDto>(visibilityType);
26:     }
27: }
````

 43:         var tenantCanOmitVerification = await _systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(GovernanceSettingKeys.OrganizationsTenantCanOmitVerification);

275:     private static int DeserializeInt(string? rawValue, int defaultValue)
276:     {
277:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawValue))
278:         {
279:             return defaultValue;
280:         }
281: 
282:         try
283:         {
284:             return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<int>(rawValue);
285:         }
286:         catch
287:         {
288:             return int.TryParse(rawValue, out var parsed) ? parsed : defaultValue;
289:         }
290:     }
291: 
292:     private static bool DeserializeBoolean(string? rawValue, bool defaultValue)
293:     {
294:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawValue))
295:         {
296:             return defaultValue;
297:         }
298: 
299:         try
300:         {
301:             return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<bool>(rawValue);
302:         }
303:         catch
304:         {
305:             return bool.TryParse(rawValue, out var parsed) ? parsed : defaultValue;
306:         }
307:     }
308: 
309:     private static string NormalizeRequiredDisplayName(string? value)
310:     {
311:         return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? DefaultBrandDisplayName : value.Trim();
312:     }
313: 
314:     private static string NormalizeOptionalUrl(string? value)
315:     {
316:         return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? string.Empty : value.Trim();
317:     }
318: 
319:     private static string NormalizeOptionalHost(string? value)
320:     {
321:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
322:         {
323:             return string.Empty;
324:         }
325: 
326:         var sanitized = value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
327:         sanitized = sanitized.Replace("https://", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
328:         sanitized = sanitized.Replace("http://", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
329:         sanitized = sanitized.Trim().Trim('/');
330:         return sanitized;
331:     }
332: 
333:     private static string NormalizeHomePage(string? raw)
334:     {
335:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw))
336:         {
337:             return DefaultPublicHomePage;
338:         }
339: 
340:         if (raw.Equals("LandingPage", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
341:         {
342:             return "LandingPage";
343:         }
344: 
345:         return "EventList";
346:     }
347: 
348:     private static string NormalizeAuthorizationProvider(string? raw)
349:     {
350:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw))
351:             return "local";
352: 
353:         return raw.Trim().ToLowerInvariant() switch
354:         {
355:             "cerbos" => "cerbos",
356:             _ => "local"
357:         };
358:     }
359: 
360:     private static string DeserializeString(string? rawValue, string defaultValue)
361:     {
362:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawValue))
363:         {
364:             return defaultValue;
365:         }
366: 
367:         try
368:         {
369:             var deserialized = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<string>(rawValue);
370:             return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(deserialized) ? defaultValue : deserialized;
371:         }
372:         catch
373:         {
374:             return rawValue.Trim('"');
375:         }
376:     }
377: 
378:     private async Task UpsertSystemSettingAsync(
379:         string settingKey,
380:         string value,
381:         SettingValueType valueType,
382:         bool isLocked,
383:         string category,
384:         int displayOrder,
385:         string description,
386:         string? allowedValues = null)
387:     {
388:         var existing = await _systemSettingRepository.GetByKey(settingKey);
389: 
390:         if (existing == null)
391:         {
392:             await _systemSettingRepository.Create(new SystemSetting
393:             {
394:                 SettingKey = settingKey,
395:                 Value = value,
396:                 ValueType = valueType,
397:                 IsLocked = isLocked,
398:                 AllowedValues = allowedValues,
399:                 Description = description,
400:                 Category = category,
401:                 DisplayOrder = displayOrder,
402:                 CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
403:             });
404: 
405:             return;
406:         }
407: 
408:         existing.Value = value;
409:         existing.ValueType = valueType;
410:         existing.IsLocked = isLocked;
411:         existing.AllowedValues = allowedValues;
412:         existing.Description = description;
413:         existing.Category = category;
414:         existing.DisplayOrder = displayOrder;
415:         existing.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
416: 
417:         await _systemSettingRepository.Update(existing);
418:     }
419: 
420:     private async Task UpsertTenantCapabilityAsync(
421:         Guid tenantId,
422:         string moduleKey,
423:         bool isEnabled,
424:         Guid? actorUserId)
425:     {
426:         var module = await _moduleDefinitionRepository.GetByKey(moduleKey);
427:         if (module == null)
428:         {
429:             return;
430:         }
431: 
432:         var existing = await _tenantCapabilityRepository.GetByTenantAndModuleKey(tenantId, moduleKey);
433:         if (existing == null)
434:         {
435:             await _tenantCapabilityRepository.Create(new TenantCapability
436:             {
437:                 TenantId = tenantId,
438:                 Tenant = null!,
439:                 ModuleId = module.Id,
440:                 Module = null!,
441:                 IsEnabled = isEnabled,
442:                 EnabledAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
443:                 EnabledBy = actorUserId
444:             });
445: 
446:             return;
447:         }
448: 
449:         existing.IsEnabled = isEnabled;
450:         if (isEnabled && existing.EnabledAt == default)
451:         {
452:             existing.EnabledAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
453:             existing.EnabledBy = actorUserId;
454:         }
455: 
456:         await _tenantCapabilityRepository.Update(existing);
457:     }
458: }
````

## File: Explore.Infrastructure/Identity/UserContext.cs
````csharp
 1: using System.Security.Claims;
 2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Identity;
 3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
 4: 
 5: namespace Explore.Infrastructure.Identity;
 6: 
 7: 
 8: 
 9: 
10: 
11: public class UserContext : IUserContext
12: {
13:     private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
14: 
15:     public UserContext(IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor)
16:     {
17:         _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
18:     }
19: 
20:     private ClaimsPrincipal? User => _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User;
21: 
22:     public bool IsAuthenticated => User?.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? false;
23: 
24:     public Guid? UserId
25:     {
26:         get
27:         {
28:             var userIdClaim = User?.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
29:                 ?? User?.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
30: 
31:             if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdClaim))
32:                 return null;
33: 
34:             return Guid.TryParse(userIdClaim, out var userId) ? userId : null;
35:         }
36:     }
37: 
38:     public string? Email => User?.FindFirst("email")?.Value
39:         ?? User?.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Email)?.Value;
40: 
41:     public string? Username => User?.FindFirst("preferred_username")?.Value
42:         ?? User?.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Name)?.Value;
43: 
44:     public Guid GetRequiredUserId()
45:     {
46:         var userId = UserId;
47:         if (!userId.HasValue)
48:         {
49:             throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("User is not authenticated or user ID is not available in the token.");
50:         }
51:         return userId.Value;
52:     }
53: }
````

````csharp
  1: using System.Diagnostics;
  2: using System.Net.Http.Json;
  3: using System.Text.Json;
  4: using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
  5: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Identity;
  6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
  7: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  8: using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
  9: 
 10: namespace Explore.Infrastructure.Services;
 11: 
 12: 
 13: 
 14: 
 15: 
 16: 
 17: public class CerbosAuthorizationService : IAuthorizationProvider
 18: {
 19:     private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
 20:     private readonly CerbosPrincipalBuilder _principalBuilder;
 21:     private readonly IAdminContext _adminContext;
 22:     private readonly ISettingsResolver _settingsResolver;
 23:     private readonly ILogger<CerbosAuthorizationService> _logger;
 24:     private readonly CerbosSettings _settings;
 25: 
 26:     private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions JsonOptions = new()
 27:     {
 28:         PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase,
 29:         DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull
 30:     };
 31: 
 32:     public CerbosAuthorizationService(
 33:         IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory,
 34:         CerbosPrincipalBuilder principalBuilder,
 35:         IAdminContext adminContext,
 36:         ISettingsResolver settingsResolver,
 37:         ITenantContext tenantContext,
 38:         IOptions<CerbosSettings> settings,
 39:         ILogger<CerbosAuthorizationService> logger)
 40:     {
 41:         _httpClient = httpClientFactory.CreateClient("CerbosClient");
 42:         _principalBuilder = principalBuilder;
 43:         _adminContext = adminContext;
 44:         _settingsResolver = settingsResolver;
 45:         _ = tenantContext;
 46:         _logger = logger;
 47:         _settings = settings.Value;
 48:     }
 49: 
 50:     public async Task<bool> IsAllowedAsync(
 51:         string resourceKind,
 52:         string resourceId,
 53:         string action,
 54:         IDictionary<string, object>? resourceAttributes = null,
 55:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 56:     {
 57:         var checks = new[]
 58:         {
 59:             new AuthorizationCheck(
 60:                 resourceKind,
 61:                 resourceId,
 62:                 action,
 63:                 resourceAttributes is null ? null : new Dictionary<string, object>(resourceAttributes))
 64:         };
 65: 
 66:         var results = await IsAllowedBatchAsync(checks, cancellationToken);
 67:         return results.Count > 0 && results[0];
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<bool>> IsAllowedBatchAsync(
 71:         IReadOnlyList<AuthorizationCheck> checks,
 72:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 73:     {
 74:         if (checks.Count == 0)
 75:             return [];
 76: 
 77:         var userId = _adminContext.UserId;
 78:         if (userId == null)
 79:         {
 80:             _logger.LogWarning("Cerbos auth denied: no user id in admin context.");
 81:             return DenyAll(checks.Count);
 82:         }
 83: 
 84:         var requestId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 85:         var correlationId = Activity.Current?.Id ?? string.Empty;
 86:         var principal = await _principalBuilder.BuildAsync(userId.Value, cancellationToken);
 87:         var resources = BuildResources(checks);
 88: 
 89:         try
 90:         {
 91:             var response = await _httpClient.PostAsJsonAsync(
 92:                 "/api/check/resources",
 93:                 new { requestId, principal, resources },
 94:                 JsonOptions,
 95:                 cancellationToken);
 96: 
 97:             if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
 98:             {
 99:                 _logger.LogWarning(
100:                     "Cerbos auth denied batch: status={StatusCode} requestId={RequestId} correlationId={CorrelationId}",
101:                     response.StatusCode,
102:                     requestId,
103:                     correlationId);
104:                 return DenyAll(checks.Count);
105:             }
106: 
107:             var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<CerbosCheckResponse>(JsonOptions, cancellationToken);
108: 
109:             return BuildDecisionResults(checks, result, requestId, correlationId);
110:         }
111:         catch (Exception ex) when (ex is HttpRequestException or TaskCanceledException)
112:         {
113:             _logger.LogError(
114:                 ex,
115:                 "Cerbos PDP unreachable at {Endpoint}. Denying access for requestId={RequestId} correlationId={CorrelationId}",
116:                 _settings.Endpoint,
117:                 requestId,
118:                 correlationId);
119:             return DenyAll(checks.Count);
120:         }
121:     }
122: 
123:     private static CerbosResourceAction[] BuildResources(IReadOnlyList<AuthorizationCheck> checks)
124:     {
125:         return checks
126:             .Select(check => new CerbosResourceAction
127:             {
128:                 Resource = new CerbosResource
129:                 {
130:                     Kind = check.ResourceKind,
131:                     Id = check.ResourceId,
132:                     Attr = check.ResourceAttributes is null
133:                         ? new Dictionary<string, object>()
134:                         : new Dictionary<string, object>(check.ResourceAttributes)
135:                 },
136:                 Actions = [check.Action]
137:             })
138:             .ToArray();
139:     }
140: 
141:     private IReadOnlyList<bool> BuildDecisionResults(
142:         IReadOnlyList<AuthorizationCheck> checks,
143:         CerbosCheckResponse? result,
144:         string requestId,
145:         string correlationId)
146:     {
147:         var decisions = new bool[checks.Count];
148: 
149:         for (var i = 0; i < checks.Count; i++)
150:         {
151:             var check = checks[i];
152:             var actionResult = result?.Results?.ElementAtOrDefault(i)?.Actions;
153: 
154:             if (actionResult != null && actionResult.TryGetValue(check.Action, out var effect))
155:             {
156:                 var isAllowed = effect == "EFFECT_ALLOW";
157:                 decisions[i] = isAllowed;
158:                 _logger.LogDebug(
159:                     "Cerbos decision: effect={Effect} resource={Resource}/{ResourceId} action={Action} requestId={RequestId} correlationId={CorrelationId}",
160:                     effect,
161:                     check.ResourceKind,
162:                     check.ResourceId,
163:                     check.Action,
164:                     requestId,
165:                     correlationId);
166:                 continue;
167:             }
168: 
169:             _logger.LogWarning(
170:                 "Cerbos decision missing. Default deny for resource={Resource}/{ResourceId} action={Action} requestId={RequestId} correlationId={CorrelationId}",
171:                 check.ResourceKind,
172:                 check.ResourceId,
173:                 check.Action,
174:                 requestId,
175:                 correlationId);
176:             decisions[i] = false;
177:         }
178: 
179:         return decisions;
180:     }
181: 
182:     private static bool[] DenyAll(int count)
183:     {
184:         return Enumerable.Repeat(false, count).ToArray();
185:     }
186: 
187:     public async Task<bool> CheckSettingAccessAsync(
188:         string settingKey,
189:         string action,
190:         Guid? tenantId = null,
191:         Guid? organizationId = null,
192:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
193:     {
194:         var attributes = new Dictionary<string, object> { ["settingKey"] = settingKey };
195:         string resourceKind;
196: 
197:         if (organizationId.HasValue)
198:         {
199:             resourceKind = "organization";
200:             attributes["organizationId"] = organizationId.Value.ToString();
201:         }
202:         else if (tenantId.HasValue)
203:         {
204:             resourceKind = "tenant_setting";
205:             attributes["tenantId"] = tenantId.Value.ToString();
206:             var canOverride = await _settingsResolver.CanOverrideAsync(settingKey, cancellationToken);
207:             attributes["isLockedByInstance"] = !canOverride;
208:         }
209:         else
210:         {
211:             resourceKind = "instance_setting";
212:         }
213: 
214:         return await IsAllowedAsync(resourceKind, settingKey, action, attributes, cancellationToken);
215:     }
216: }
217:

## File: Explore.Infrastructure/Services/ModuleService.cs
````csharp
  1: namespace Explore.Infrastructure.Services;
  2: 
  3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
  4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  5: using Explore.Domain.Modules;
  6: using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;
  7: 
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: public class ModuleService : IModuleService
 12: {
 13:     private readonly IModuleDefinitionRepository _moduleDefinitionRepository;
 14:     private readonly ITenantCapabilityRepository _tenantCapabilityRepository;
 15:     private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
 16:     private readonly TimeSpan _cacheExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);
 17: 
 18:     private const string AllModulesCacheKey = "Modules_All";
 19:     private const string TenantModulesCacheKeyPrefix = "Modules_Tenant_";
 20: 
 21:     public ModuleService(
 22:         IModuleDefinitionRepository moduleDefinitionRepository,
 23:         ITenantCapabilityRepository tenantCapabilityRepository,
 24:         IMemoryCache cache)
 25:     {
 26:         _moduleDefinitionRepository = moduleDefinitionRepository;
 27:         _tenantCapabilityRepository = tenantCapabilityRepository;
 28:         _cache = cache;
 29:     }
 30: 
 31:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<ModuleInfo>> GetAllModulesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 32:     {
 33:         return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(AllModulesCacheKey, async entry =>
 34:         {
 35:             entry.AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = _cacheExpiration;
 36:             var modules = await _moduleDefinitionRepository.GetAllActive();
 37:             return modules.Select(m => MapToModuleInfo(m)).ToList();
 38:         }) ?? new List<ModuleInfo>();
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<ModuleInfo>> GetEnabledModulesAsync(Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 42:     {
 43:         var cacheKey = $"{TenantModulesCacheKeyPrefix}{tenantId}";
 44: 
 45:         return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(cacheKey, async entry =>
 46:         {
 47:             entry.AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = _cacheExpiration;
 48: 
 49:             var capabilities = await _tenantCapabilityRepository.GetEnabledByTenantId(tenantId);
 50:             return capabilities
 51:                 .Where(c => c.Module != null)
 52:                 .Select(c => MapToModuleInfo(c.Module!, isEnabledForTenant: true))
 53:                 .ToList();
 54:         }) ?? new List<ModuleInfo>();
 55:     }
 56: 
 57:     public async Task<bool> IsModuleEnabledAsync(Guid tenantId, string moduleKey, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 58:     {
 59: 
 60:         var enabledModules = await GetEnabledModulesAsync(tenantId, cancellationToken);
 61:         return enabledModules.Any(m => m.ModuleKey.Equals(moduleKey, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 62:     }
 63: 
 64:     public async Task<string?> GetModuleWizardSchemaUrlAsync(string moduleKey, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 65:     {
 66:         var module = await _moduleDefinitionRepository.GetByKey(moduleKey);
 67:         return module?.WizardSchemaUrl;
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     public async Task<bool> EnableModuleAsync(Guid tenantId, string moduleKey, Guid? enabledBy = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 71:     {
 72: 
 73:         var module = await _moduleDefinitionRepository.GetByKey(moduleKey);
 74:         if (module == null || !module.IsActive)
 75:             return false;
 76: 
 77: 
 78:         var existing = await _tenantCapabilityRepository.GetByTenantAndModuleKey(tenantId, moduleKey);
 79:         if (existing != null)
 80:         {
 81: 
 82:             if (!existing.IsEnabled)
 83:             {
 84:                 existing.IsEnabled = true;
 85:                 existing.EnabledAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
 86:                 existing.EnabledBy = enabledBy;
 87:                 await _tenantCapabilityRepository.Update(existing);
 88:                 InvalidateCache(tenantId);
 89:             }
 90:             return true;
 91:         }
 92: 
 93: 
 94:         var capability = new TenantCapability
 95:         {
 96:             TenantId = tenantId,
 97:             Tenant = null!,
 98:             ModuleId = module.Id,
 99:             Module = null!,
100:             IsEnabled = true,
101:             EnabledAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
102:             EnabledBy = enabledBy
103:         };
104: 
105:         await _tenantCapabilityRepository.Create(capability);
106:         InvalidateCache(tenantId);
107:         return true;
108:     }
109: 
110:     public async Task<bool> DisableModuleAsync(Guid tenantId, string moduleKey, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
111:     {
112:         var capability = await _tenantCapabilityRepository.GetByTenantAndModuleKey(tenantId, moduleKey);
113:         if (capability == null)
114:             return false;
115: 
116: 
117:         capability.IsEnabled = false;
118:         await _tenantCapabilityRepository.Update(capability);
119:         InvalidateCache(tenantId);
120:         return true;
121:     }
122: 
123:     public void InvalidateCache(Guid? tenantId = null)
124:     {
125:         _cache.Remove(AllModulesCacheKey);
126: 
127:         if (tenantId.HasValue)
128:         {
129:             _cache.Remove($"{TenantModulesCacheKeyPrefix}{tenantId}");
130:         }
131:     }
132: 
133:     private static ModuleInfo MapToModuleInfo(ModuleDefinition module, bool? isEnabledForTenant = null)
134:     {
135:         return new ModuleInfo
136:         {
137:             Id = module.Id,
138:             ModuleKey = module.ModuleKey,
139:             Name = module.Name,
140:             Description = module.Description,
141:             IconName = module.IconName,
142:             Category = module.Category,
143:             DisplayOrder = module.DisplayOrder,
144:             WizardSchemaUrl = module.WizardSchemaUrl,
145:             IsActive = module.IsActive,
146:             IsEnabledForTenant = isEnabledForTenant
147:         };
148:     }
149: }
````

````csharp
  1: namespace Explore.Infrastructure.Services;

  8:

 10: 
 11: 
 12: public class SettingsResolver : ISettingsResolver
 13: {
 14:     private readonly ISystemSettingRepository _systemSettingRepository;
 15:     private readonly ITenantSettingRepository _tenantSettingRepository;
 16:     private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
 17:     private readonly TimeSpan _cacheExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);
 18: 
 19:     private const string SystemSettingsCacheKey = "SystemSettings_All";
 20:     private const string TenantSettingsCacheKeyPrefix = "TenantSettings_";
 21: 
 22:     public SettingsResolver(
 23:         ISystemSettingRepository systemSettingRepository,
 24:         ITenantSettingRepository tenantSettingRepository,
 25:         IMemoryCache cache)
 26:     {
 27:         _systemSettingRepository = systemSettingRepository;
 28:         _tenantSettingRepository = tenantSettingRepository;
 29:         _cache = cache;
 30:     }
 31: 
 32:     public async Task<T?> GetSettingAsync<T>(string settingKey, Guid? tenantId = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 33:     {
 34:         var resolved = await GetSettingWithMetadataAsync(settingKey, tenantId, cancellationToken);
 35:         if (resolved == null)
 36:             return default;
 37: 
 38:         try
 39:         {
 40:             return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(resolved.Value);
 41:         }
 42:         catch
 43:         {
 44:             return default;
 45:         }
 46:     }
 47: 
 48:     public async Task<ResolvedSetting?> GetSettingWithMetadataAsync(string settingKey, Guid? tenantId = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 49:     {
 50: 
 51:         var systemSettings = await GetSystemSettingsAsync(cancellationToken);
 52:         var systemSetting = systemSettings.FirstOrDefault(s => s.SettingKey == settingKey);
 53: 
 54:         if (systemSetting == null)
 55:             return null;
 56: 
 57: 
 58:         if (systemSetting.IsLocked || tenantId == null)
 59:         {
 60:             return new ResolvedSetting
 61:             {
 62:                 Key = systemSetting.SettingKey,
 63:                 Value = systemSetting.Value,
 64:                 ValueType = systemSetting.ValueType,
 65:                 Source = systemSetting.IsLocked ? SettingSource.SystemLocked : SettingSource.SystemDefault,
 66:                 IsLocked = systemSetting.IsLocked,
 67:                 Description = systemSetting.Description,
 68:                 Category = systemSetting.Category,
 69:                 AllowedValues = systemSetting.AllowedValues
 70:             };
 71:         }
 72: 
 73: 
 74:         var tenantSettings = await GetTenantSettingsAsync(tenantId.Value, cancellationToken);
 75:         var tenantOverride = tenantSettings.FirstOrDefault(s => s.SettingKey == settingKey);
 76: 
 77:         if (tenantOverride != null)
 78:         {
 79:             return new ResolvedSetting
 80:             {
 81:                 Key = settingKey,
 82:                 Value = tenantOverride.Value,
 83:                 ValueType = systemSetting.ValueType,
 84:                 Source = SettingSource.TenantOverride,
 85:                 IsLocked = false,
 86:                 Description = systemSetting.Description,
 87:                 Category = systemSetting.Category,
 88:                 AllowedValues = systemSetting.AllowedValues
 89:             };
 90:         }
 91: 
 92: 
 93:         return new ResolvedSetting
 94:         {
 95:             Key = systemSetting.SettingKey,
 96:             Value = systemSetting.Value,
 97:             ValueType = systemSetting.ValueType,
 98:             Source = SettingSource.SystemDefault,
 99:             IsLocked = false,
100:             Description = systemSetting.Description,
101:             Category = systemSetting.Category,
102:             AllowedValues = systemSetting.AllowedValues
103:         };
104:     }
105: 
106:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<ResolvedSetting>> GetAllSettingsAsync(Guid? tenantId = null, string? category = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
107:     {
108:         var systemSettings = await GetSystemSettingsAsync(cancellationToken);
109:         var tenantSettings = tenantId.HasValue
110:             ? await GetTenantSettingsAsync(tenantId.Value, cancellationToken)
111:             : new List<TenantSetting>();
112: 
113:         var tenantSettingsDict = tenantSettings.ToDictionary(s => s.SettingKey, s => s.Value);
114: 
115:         var result = systemSettings
116:             .Where(s => category == null || s.Category == category)
117:             .Select(s =>
118:             {
119:                 var hasOverride = tenantSettingsDict.TryGetValue(s.SettingKey, out var overrideValue);
120:                 var effectiveValue = s.IsLocked || !hasOverride ? s.Value : overrideValue!;
121:                 var source = s.IsLocked ? SettingSource.SystemLocked
122:                     : hasOverride ? SettingSource.TenantOverride
123:                     : SettingSource.SystemDefault;
124: 
125:                 return new ResolvedSetting
126:                 {
127:                     Key = s.SettingKey,
128:                     Value = effectiveValue,
129:                     ValueType = s.ValueType,
130:                     Source = source,
131:                     IsLocked = s.IsLocked,
132:                     Description = s.Description,
133:                     Category = s.Category,
134:                     AllowedValues = s.AllowedValues
135:                 };
136:             })
137:             .ToList();
138: 
139:         return result;
140:     }
141: 
142:     public async Task<bool> CanOverrideAsync(string settingKey, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
143:     {
144:         return !await _systemSettingRepository.IsLocked(settingKey);
145:     }
146: 
147:     public async Task<bool> SetTenantOverrideAsync(string settingKey, object value, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
148:     {
149: 
150:         if (!await CanOverrideAsync(settingKey, cancellationToken))
151:             return false;
152: 
153:         var existingOverride = await _tenantSettingRepository.GetByTenantAndKey(tenantId, settingKey);
154:         var jsonValue = JsonSerializer.Serialize(value);
155: 
156:         if (existingOverride != null)
157:         {
158:             existingOverride.Value = jsonValue;
159:             existingOverride.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
160:             await _tenantSettingRepository.Update(existingOverride);
161:         }
162:         else
163:         {
164:             var newOverride = new TenantSetting
165:             {
166:                 TenantId = tenantId,
167:                 Tenant = null!,
168:                 SettingKey = settingKey,
169:                 Value = jsonValue,
170:                 CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
171:             };
172:             await _tenantSettingRepository.Create(newOverride);
173:         }
174: 
175:         InvalidateCache(settingKey, tenantId);
176:         return true;
177:     }
178: 
179:     public async Task<bool> RemoveTenantOverrideAsync(string settingKey, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
180:     {
181:         var result = await _tenantSettingRepository.RemoveOverride(tenantId, settingKey);
182:         if (result)
183:         {
184:             InvalidateCache(settingKey, tenantId);
185:         }
186:         return result;
187:     }
188: 
189:     public void InvalidateCache(string? settingKey = null, Guid? tenantId = null)
190:     {
191:         if (settingKey == null && tenantId == null)
192:         {
193:             _cache.Remove(SystemSettingsCacheKey);
194:         }
195:         else if (tenantId.HasValue)
196:         {
197:             _cache.Remove($"{TenantSettingsCacheKeyPrefix}{tenantId}");
198:         }
199:         else
200:         {
201:             _cache.Remove(SystemSettingsCacheKey);
202:         }
203:     }
204: 
205:     private async Task<List<SystemSetting>> GetSystemSettingsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
206:     {
207:         return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(SystemSettingsCacheKey, async entry =>
208:         {
209:             entry.AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = _cacheExpiration;
210:             return await _systemSettingRepository.GetAllSettings();
211:         }) ?? new List<SystemSetting>();
212:     }
213: 
214:     private async Task<List<TenantSetting>> GetTenantSettingsAsync(Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
215:     {
216:         var cacheKey = $"{TenantSettingsCacheKeyPrefix}{tenantId}";
217:         return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(cacheKey, async entry =>
218:         {
219:             entry.AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = _cacheExpiration;
220:             return await _tenantSettingRepository.GetAllForTenant(tenantId);
221:         }) ?? new List<TenantSetting>();
222:     }
223: }
````

## File: Explore.Persistence/Repositories/AppSettingRepository.cs
````csharp
  1: namespace Explore.Persistence.Repositories;
  2: 
  3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  4: using Explore.Domain;
  5: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
  6: 
  7: public class AppSettingRepository : IAppSettingRepository
  8: {
  9:     private readonly ExploreDbContext _dbContext;
 10: 
 11:     public AppSettingRepository(ExploreDbContext dbContext)
 12:     {
 13:         _dbContext = dbContext;
 14:     }
 15: 
 16:     public async Task<AppSetting?> GetByKeyAsync(string configKey)
 17:     {
 18:         return await _dbContext.AppSettings
 19:             .AsNoTracking()
 20:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(s => s.ConfigKey == configKey);
 21:     }
 22: 
 23:     public async Task<List<AppSetting>> GetByCategoryAsync(string? category = null)
 24:     {
 25:         var query = _dbContext.AppSettings.AsNoTracking();
 26: 
 27:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(category))
 28:         {
 29:             query = query.Where(s => s.Category == category);
 30:         }
 31: 
 32:         return await query
 33:             .OrderBy(s => s.Category)
 34:             .ThenBy(s => s.ConfigKey)
 35:             .ToListAsync();
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     public async Task<List<AppSetting>> GetSettingsNeedingReEncryptionAsync(int currentKeyVersion)
 39:     {
 40:         return await _dbContext.AppSettings
 41:             .AsNoTracking()
 42:             .Where(s => s.KeyVersion < currentKeyVersion)
 43:             .OrderBy(s => s.ConfigKey)
 44:             .ToListAsync();
 45:     }
 46: 
 47:     public async Task<List<AppSetting>> GetAllAsync()
 48:     {
 49:         return await _dbContext.AppSettings
 50:             .AsNoTracking()
 51:             .OrderBy(s => s.ConfigKey)
 52:             .ToListAsync();
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     public async Task<AppSetting> CreateAsync(AppSetting setting)
 56:     {
 57:         await _dbContext.AppSettings.AddAsync(setting);
 58:         await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 59:         return setting;
 60:     }
 61: 
 62:     public async Task UpdateAsync(AppSetting setting)
 63:     {
 64: 
 65:         _dbContext.AppSettings.Update(setting);
 66:         await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     public async Task<bool> DeleteAsync(string configKey)
 70:     {
 71:         var setting = await _dbContext.AppSettings.FirstOrDefaultAsync(s => s.ConfigKey == configKey);
 72:         if (setting == null)
 73:         {
 74:             return false;
 75:         }
 76: 
 77:         _dbContext.AppSettings.Remove(setting);
 78:         await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 79:         return true;
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     public async Task<bool> ExistsAsync(string configKey)
 83:     {
 84:         return await _dbContext.AppSettings
 85:             .AsNoTracking()
 86:             .AnyAsync(s => s.ConfigKey == configKey);
 87:     }
 88: 
 89:     public async Task BulkUpdateAsync(IEnumerable<AppSetting> settings)
 90:     {
 91:         await using var transaction = await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync();
 92:         try
 93:         {
 94:             foreach (var setting in settings)
 95:             {
 96:                 _dbContext.AppSettings.Update(setting);
 97:             }
 98:             await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 99:             await transaction.CommitAsync();
100:         }
101:         catch
102:         {
103:             await transaction.RollbackAsync();
104:             throw;
105:         }
106:     }
107: }
````
