````csharp
  8: using Explore.Application.Features.InstanceOnboarding.Requests.Queries;
  9: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 10: using MediatR;
 11: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
 12: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
 13: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
 14: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
 15: 
 16: namespace Explore.API.Controllers;
 17: 
 18: [ApiVersion("0.1")]
 19: [Route("api/[controller]")]
 20: [ApiController]
 21: public class InstanceOnboardingController : ControllerBase
 22: {
 23:     private readonly IMediator _mediator;
 24:     private readonly ISetupSecretProvider _setupSecretProvider;
 25:     private readonly ILogger<InstanceOnboardingController> _logger;
 26: 
 27:     public InstanceOnboardingController(
 28:         IMediator mediator,
 29:         ISetupSecretProvider setupSecretProvider,
 30:         ILogger<InstanceOnboardingController> logger)
 31:     {
 32:         _mediator = mediator;
 33:         _setupSecretProvider = setupSecretProvider;
 34:         _logger = logger;
 35:     }
 36: 
 37:     [HttpGet("status")]
 38:     [AllowAnonymous]
 39:     [EndpointSummary("Get Instance Onboarding Status")]
 40:     [EndpointDescription("Returns whether first-run onboarding is completed and whether the current user is instance admin.")]
 41:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(InstanceOnboardingStatusDto), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
 42:     public async Task<ActionResult<InstanceOnboardingStatusDto>> GetStatus(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 43:     {
 44:         var status = await _mediator.Send(new GetInstanceOnboardingStatusQuery(), cancellationToken);
 45:         return Ok(status);
 46:     }
 47: 
 48:     [HttpGet("settings")]
 49:     [Authorize]
 50:     [EndpointSummary("Get Instance Governance Settings")]
 51:     [EndpointDescription("Returns instance governance settings. If onboarding is already complete, only instance admins can access this endpoint.")]
 52:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(InstanceGovernanceSettingsDto), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
 53:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
 54:     public async Task<ActionResult<InstanceGovernanceSettingsDto>> GetSettings(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 55:     {
 56:         var status = await _mediator.Send(new GetInstanceOnboardingStatusQuery(), cancellationToken);
 57:         if (status.IsCompleted && !status.IsCurrentUserInstanceAdmin)
 58:         {
 59:             return Forbid();
 60:         }
 61: 
 62:         var settings = await _mediator.Send(new GetInstanceGovernanceSettingsQuery(), cancellationToken);
 63:         return Ok(settings);
 64:     }
 65: 
 66:     [HttpPost("complete")]
 67:     [Authorize]
 68:     [SetupSecretRequired]
 69:     [EnableRateLimiting("SetupSecret")]
 70:     [EndpointSummary("Complete Instance Onboarding")]
 71:     [EndpointDescription("Completes first-run onboarding, assigns the current user as instance admin, and persists instance governance settings.")]
 72:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<Guid>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
 73:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<Guid>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
 74:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>> Complete([FromBody] InstanceGovernanceSettingsDto settings, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 75:     {
 76:         var currentUserId = GetCurrentUserId();
 77:         if (!currentUserId.HasValue)
 78:         {
 79:             return BadRequest(new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>
 80:             {
 81:                 Success = false,
 82:                 Message = "Invalid user identity."
 83:             });
 84:         }
 85: 
 86:         var command = new CompleteInstanceOnboardingCommand
 87:         {
 88:             UserId = currentUserId.Value,
 89:             Settings = settings
 90:         };
 91: 
 92:         var response = await _mediator.Send(command, cancellationToken);
 93:         if (!response.Success)
 94:         {
 95:             return BadRequest(response);
 96:         }
 97: 
 98:         _logger.LogWarning(
 99:             "Instance claimed by admin (userId: {UserId}) from IP: {IpAddress}. Bootstrap mode disabled.",
100:             currentUserId, HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress);
101: 
102:         return Ok(response);
103:     }
104: 
105:     [HttpPut("settings")]
106:     [Authorize]
107:     [SetupSecretRequired]
108:     [EnableRateLimiting("SetupSecret")]
109:     [EndpointSummary("Update Instance Governance Settings")]
110:     [EndpointDescription("Updates instance governance settings at runtime. Requires instance administrator membership.")]
111:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<Guid>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
112:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<Guid>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
113:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
114:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>> UpdateSettings([FromBody] InstanceGovernanceSettingsDto settings, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
115:     {
116:         var currentUserId = GetCurrentUserId();
117:         if (!currentUserId.HasValue)
118:         {
119:             return BadRequest(new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>
120:             {
121:                 Success = false,
122:                 Message = "Invalid user identity."
123:             });
124:         }
125: 
126:         var command = new UpdateInstanceGovernanceSettingsCommand
127:         {
128:             UserId = currentUserId.Value,
129:             Settings = settings
130:         };
131: 
132:         var response = await _mediator.Send(command, cancellationToken);
133:         if (!response.Success)
134:         {
135:             if (response.Message.Contains("Only instance administrators", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
136:             {
137:                 return Forbid();
138:             }
139: 
140:             return BadRequest(response);
141:         }
142: 
143:         return Ok(response);
144:     }
145: 
146:     [HttpGet("storage-settings")]
147:     [Authorize]
148:     [EndpointSummary("Get Instance Storage Settings")]
149:     [EndpointDescription("Returns instance S3 storage settings. Only instance admins can access this endpoint.")]
150:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(InstanceStorageSettingsDto), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
151:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
152:     public async Task<ActionResult<InstanceStorageSettingsDto>> GetStorageSettings(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
153:     {
154:         var status = await _mediator.Send(new GetInstanceOnboardingStatusQuery(), cancellationToken);
155:         if (status.IsCompleted && !status.IsCurrentUserInstanceAdmin)
156:         {
157:             return Forbid();
158:         }
159: 
160:         var settings = await _mediator.Send(new GetInstanceStorageSettingsQuery(), cancellationToken);
161:         return Ok(settings);
162:     }
163: 
164:     [HttpPut("storage-settings")]
165:     [Authorize]
166:     [SetupSecretRequired]
167:     [EnableRateLimiting("SetupSecret")]
168:     [EndpointSummary("Update Instance Storage Settings")]
169:     [EndpointDescription("Updates instance S3 storage settings. Requires instance administrator membership.")]
170:     [Consumes("application/json")]
171:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<Guid>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
172:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<Guid>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
173:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
174:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>> UpdateStorageSettings([FromBody] InstanceStorageSettingsDto settings, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
175:     {
176:         var currentUserId = GetCurrentUserId();
177:         if (!currentUserId.HasValue)
178:         {
179:             return BadRequest(new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>
180:             {
181:                 Success = false,
182:                 Message = "Invalid user identity."
183:             });
184:         }
185: 
186:         var command = new UpdateInstanceStorageSettingsCommand
187:         {
188:             UserId = currentUserId.Value,
189:             Settings = settings
190:         };
191: 
192:         var response = await _mediator.Send(command, cancellationToken);
193:         if (!response.Success)
194:         {
195:             if (response.Message.Contains("Only instance administrators", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
196:             {
197:                 return Forbid();
198:             }
199: 
200:             return BadRequest(response);
201:         }
202: 
203:         return Ok(response);
204:     }
205: 
206:     [HttpPost("test-storage")]
207:     [Authorize]
208:     [SetupSecretRequired]
209:     [EnableRateLimiting("SetupSecret")]
210:     [EndpointSummary("Test Storage Connection")]
211:     [EndpointDescription("Tests the S3 storage connection using current settings. Returns success or failure with message.")]
212:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(object), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
213:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
214:     public async Task<ActionResult> TestStorageConnection(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
215:     {
216:         var status = await _mediator.Send(new GetInstanceOnboardingStatusQuery(), cancellationToken);
217:         if (status.IsCompleted && !status.IsCurrentUserInstanceAdmin)
218:         {
219:             return Forbid();
220:         }
221: 
222:         var storageService = HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure.IObjectStorageService>();
223:         var success = await storageService.TestConnectionAsync(cancellationToken);
224: 
225:         return Ok(new { success, message = success ? "Connection successful." : "Connection failed. Please verify your S3 settings." });
226:     }
227: 
228:     [HttpPost("validate-secret")]
229:     [AllowAnonymous]
230:     [EnableRateLimiting("SetupSecret")]
231:     [EndpointSummary("Validate Setup Secret")]
232:     [EndpointDescription("Validates the provided setup secret. Returns whether the secret is correct. Rate limited to 5 attempts per minute.")]
233:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(object), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
234:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(object), StatusCodes.Status410Gone)]
235:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests)]
236:     public ActionResult ValidateSecret([FromBody] ValidateSetupSecretRequest request)
237:     {
238:         if (!_setupSecretProvider.IsSetupModeActive)
239:             return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status410Gone, new { valid = false, error = "Setup already completed." });
240: 
241:         var isValid = _setupSecretProvider.ValidateSecret(request.Secret);
242:         return Ok(new { valid = isValid });
243:     }
244: 
245:     private Guid? GetCurrentUserId()
246:     {
247:         var claim = User.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
248:             ?? User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value
249:             ?? User.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
250: 
251:         return Guid.TryParse(claim, out var parsedUserId) ? parsedUserId : null;
252:     }
253: }
254: 
255: public class ValidateSetupSecretRequest
256: {
257:     public string? Secret { get; set; }
258: }
````

## File: Explore.API/Dockerfile
````
 1: # Explore.API/Dockerfile
 2: # Multi-stage build for production deployment
 3: # Secrets are loaded at runtime via AddSecretManagement() - no CLI needed
 4: # Supports zero-downtime deployments with Coolify
 5: 
 6: FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0 AS base
 7: USER $APP_UID
 8: WORKDIR /app
 9: EXPOSE 8080
10: EXPOSE 8081
11: 
12: FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 AS build
13: ARG BUILD_CONFIGURATION=Release
14: WORKDIR /src
15: 
16: # Copy all project files for restore
17: COPY ["Explore.API/Explore.API.csproj", "Explore.API/"]
18: COPY ["Explore.Application/Explore.Application.csproj", "Explore.Application/"]
19: COPY ["Explore.Domain/Explore.Domain.csproj", "Explore.Domain/"]
20: COPY ["Explore.Infrastructure/Explore.Infrastructure.csproj", "Explore.Infrastructure/"]
21: COPY ["Explore.Persistence/Explore.Persistence.csproj", "Explore.Persistence/"]
22: COPY ["Explore.Secrets/Explore.Secrets.csproj", "Explore.Secrets/"]
23: COPY ["Explore.ServiceDefaults/Explore.ServiceDefaults.csproj", "Explore.ServiceDefaults/"]
24: 
25: RUN dotnet restore "./Explore.API/Explore.API.csproj"
26: COPY . .
27: WORKDIR "/src/Explore.API"
28: RUN dotnet build "./Explore.API.csproj" -c $BUILD_CONFIGURATION -o /app/build
29: 
30: FROM build AS publish
31: ARG BUILD_CONFIGURATION=Release
32: RUN dotnet publish "./Explore.API.csproj" -c $BUILD_CONFIGURATION -o /app/publish /p:UseAppHost=false
33: 
34: FROM base AS final
35: WORKDIR /app
36: 
37: # Copy published application
38: COPY --from=publish /app/publish .
39: 
40: # Secret management is handled by the application via AddSecretManagement()
41: # Configure via environment variables:
42: #   SECRET_PROVIDER=infisical (or "none" for env vars only)
43: #   Infisical__ProjectId, Infisical__ClientId, Infisical__ClientSecret, etc.
44: # See docs/CONFIGURATION.md for full list of options
45: 
46: ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "Explore.API.dll"]
````

## File: Explore.API/Services/OpenApiExportService.cs
````csharp
  1: using System.Text.Json;
  2: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
  3: using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
  4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  5: 
  6: namespace Explore.API.Services;
  7: 
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: 
 12: 
 13: 
 14: 
 15: public class OpenApiExportService : BackgroundService
 16: {
 17:     private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
 18:     private readonly ILogger<OpenApiExportService> _logger;
 19:     private readonly IHostEnvironment _hostEnvironment;
 20:     private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
 21: 
 22:     public OpenApiExportService(
 23:         IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
 24:         ILogger<OpenApiExportService> logger,
 25:         IHostEnvironment hostEnvironment,
 26:         IConfiguration configuration)
 27:     {
 28:         _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
 29:         _logger = logger;
 30:         _hostEnvironment = hostEnvironment;
 31:         _configuration = configuration;
 32:     }
 33: 
 34:     protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
 35:     {
 36: 
 37:         if (!_hostEnvironment.IsDevelopment())
 38:         {
 39:             _logger.LogInformation("OpenAPI export skipped - not in Development environment");
 40:             return;
 41:         }
 42: 
 43: 
 44:         await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3), stoppingToken);
 45: 
 46:         try
 47:         {
 48:             await ExportOpenApiSpecAsync(stoppingToken);
 49:         }
 50:         catch (Exception ex)
 51:         {
 52:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to export OpenAPI specification");
 53:         }
 54:     }
 55: 
 56:     private async Task ExportOpenApiSpecAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
 57:     {
 58:         using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
 59: 
 60: 
 61:         var httpClientFactory = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IHttpClientFactory>();
 62:         var client = httpClientFactory.CreateClient();
 63: 
 64: 
 65:         var baseUrl = _configuration["ASPNETCORE_URLS"]?.Split(';').FirstOrDefault()
 66:                       ?? "https://localhost:7039";
 67: 
 68: 
 69: 
 70: 
 71:         var openApiSchemaUri = $"{baseUrl}/openapi/event-api.json";
 72: 
 73:         _logger.LogInformation("Fetching OpenAPI spec from {Url}", openApiSchemaUri);
 74: 
 75: 
 76:         const int maxRetries = 5;
 77:         for (int i = 0; i < maxRetries; i++)
 78:         {
 79:             try
 80:             {
 81: 
 82:                 var handler = new HttpClientHandler
 83:                 {
 84:                     ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback = (_, _, _, _) => true
 85:                 };
 86:                 using var httpClient = new HttpClient(handler);
 87: 
 88:                 var response = await httpClient.GetAsync(openApiSchemaUri, stoppingToken);
 89:                 response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
 90: 
 91:                 var swaggerJson = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(stoppingToken);
 92: 
 93: 
 94:                 var jsonDoc = JsonDocument.Parse(swaggerJson);
 95:                 var prettyJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(jsonDoc, new JsonSerializerOptions
 96:                 {
 97:                     WriteIndented = true
 98:                 });
 99: 
100: 
101:                 var projectDir = _hostEnvironment.ContentRootPath;
102:                 var outputPath = Path.Combine(projectDir, "swagger.json");
103: 
104:                 await File.WriteAllTextAsync(outputPath, prettyJson, stoppingToken);
105: 
106:                 _logger.LogInformation("? OpenAPI spec exported to {Path}", outputPath);
107:                 _logger.LogInformation("   Blazor.Client can now regenerate the API client");
108: 
109:                 return;
110:             }
111:             catch (HttpRequestException ex) when (i < maxRetries - 1)
112:             {
113:                 _logger.LogWarning("Attempt {Attempt}/{MaxRetries} failed: {Message}. Retrying...",
114:                     i + 1, maxRetries, ex.Message);
115:                 await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2), stoppingToken);
116:             }
117:         }
118: 
119:         _logger.LogError("Failed to fetch OpenAPI spec after {MaxRetries} attempts", maxRetries);
120:     }
121: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/Actor/Validators/CreateActorDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
  1: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  2: using FluentValidation;
  3: 
  4: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.Actor.Validators;
  5: 
  6: public class CreateActorDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateActorDto>
  7: {
  8:     private readonly IActorTypeRepository _actorTypeRepository;
  9:     private readonly IDidCustodyTypeRepository _didCustodyTypeRepository;
 10:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
 11:     private readonly ITenantRepository _tenantRepository;
 12:     private readonly IActorRepository _actorRepository;
 13:     private readonly IUserRepository _userRepository;
 14:     private readonly IOrganizationRepository _organizationRepository;
 15: 
 16:     public CreateActorDtoValidator(
 17:         IActorTypeRepository actorTypeRepository,
 18:         IDidCustodyTypeRepository didCustodyTypeRepository,
 19:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository,
 20:         ITenantRepository tenantRepository,
 21:         IActorRepository actorRepository,
 22:         IUserRepository userRepository,
 23:         IOrganizationRepository organizationRepository)
 24:     {
 25:         _actorTypeRepository = actorTypeRepository;
 26:         _didCustodyTypeRepository = didCustodyTypeRepository;
 27:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
 28:         _tenantRepository = tenantRepository;
 29:         _actorRepository = actorRepository;
 30:         _userRepository = userRepository;
 31:         _organizationRepository = organizationRepository;
 32: 
 33: 
 34:         RuleFor(x => x)
 35:             .Must(x => (x.UserId.HasValue && !x.OrganizationId.HasValue) ||
 36:                        (!x.UserId.HasValue && x.OrganizationId.HasValue))
 37:             .WithMessage("Actor must have exactly one of UserId or OrganizationId set (not both, not neither).");
 38: 
 39: 
 40:         RuleFor(x => x.UserId)
 41:             .MustAsync(async (userId, cancellation) =>
 42:             {
 43:                 if (!userId.HasValue) return true;
 44:                 return await _userRepository.Exists(userId.Value);
 45:             })
 46:             .When(x => x.UserId.HasValue)
 47:             .WithMessage("User does not exist.");
 48: 
 49: 
 50:         RuleFor(x => x.OrganizationId)
 51:             .MustAsync(async (orgId, cancellation) =>
 52:             {
 53:                 if (!orgId.HasValue) return true;
 54:                 return await _organizationRepository.Exists(orgId.Value);
 55:             })
 56:             .When(x => x.OrganizationId.HasValue)
 57:             .WithMessage("Organization does not exist.");
 58: 
 59: 
 60:         RuleFor(x => x.UserId)
 61:             .MustAsync(async (userId, cancellation) =>
 62:             {
 63:                 if (!userId.HasValue) return true;
 64:                 var existingActor = await _actorRepository.GetActorByUserId(userId.Value);
 65:                 return existingActor == null;
 66:             })
 67:             .When(x => x.UserId.HasValue)
 68:             .WithMessage("This user already has an associated actor.");
 69: 
 70: 
 71:         RuleFor(x => x.OrganizationId)
 72:             .MustAsync(async (orgId, cancellation) =>
 73:             {
 74:                 if (!orgId.HasValue) return true;
 75:                 var existingActor = await _actorRepository.GetActorByOrganizationId(orgId.Value);
 76:                 return existingActor == null;
 77:             })
 78:             .When(x => x.OrganizationId.HasValue)
 79:             .WithMessage("This organization already has an associated actor.");
 80: 
 81:         RuleFor(x => x.DisplayName)
 82:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Display name is required")
 83:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("Display name cannot exceed 500 characters");
 84: 
 85:         RuleFor(x => x.ActorTypeId)
 86:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Actor type is required")
 87:             .MustAsync(async (actorTypeId, cancellation) =>
 88:             {
 89:                 return await _actorTypeRepository.Exists(actorTypeId);
 90:             }).WithMessage("Invalid actor type");
 91: 
 92: 
 93: 
 94: 
 95:         RuleFor(x => x.DidCustodyTypeId)
 96:             .MustAsync(async (didCustodyTypeId, cancellation) =>
 97:             {
 98:                 if (!didCustodyTypeId.HasValue) return true;
 99:                 return await _didCustodyTypeRepository.Exists(didCustodyTypeId.Value);
100:             })
101:             .When(x => x.DidCustodyTypeId.HasValue)
102:             .WithMessage("Invalid DID custody type");
103: 
104:         RuleFor(x => x.ProfilePictureId)
105:             .MustAsync(async (profilePictureId, cancellation) =>
106:             {
107:                 if (!profilePictureId.HasValue) return true;
108:                 return await _storageObjectRepository.Exists(profilePictureId.Value);
109:             })
110:             .When(x => x.ProfilePictureId.HasValue)
111:             .WithMessage("Invalid profile picture");
112: 
113:         RuleFor(x => x.Did)
114:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("DID cannot exceed 500 characters")
115:             .MustAsync(async (did, cancellation) =>
116:             {
117:                 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(did)) return true;
118:                 return !await _actorRepository.DidExists(did);
119:             })
120:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.Did))
121:             .WithMessage("DID already exists");
122: 
123:         RuleFor(x => x.Handle)
124:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("Handle cannot exceed 500 characters");
125: 
126:         RuleFor(x => x.PdsHost)
127:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("PDS host cannot exceed 500 characters");
128: 
129:         RuleFor(x => x.Description)
130:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("Description cannot exceed 500 characters");
131: 
132:         RuleFor(x => x.ProfilePictureCid)
133:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("Profile picture CID cannot exceed 500 characters");
134: 
135:         RuleFor(x => x.ProfilePictureUri)
136:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("Profile picture URI cannot exceed 500 characters");
137:     }
138: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/EventRegistration/Validators/CreateEventRegistrationDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Threading;
 3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 5: using FluentValidation;
 6: 
 7: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.EventRegistration.Validators;
 8: 
 9: public class CreateEventRegistrationDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateEventRegistrationDto>
10: {
11:     private readonly IUserRepository _userRepository;
12:     private readonly IEventSessionRepository _eventSessionRepository;
13:     private readonly IApprovalStatusRepository _approvalStatusRepository;
14:     private readonly IEventRegistrationRepository _eventRegistrationRepository;
15: 
16:     public CreateEventRegistrationDtoValidator(
17:         IUserRepository userRepository,
18:         IEventSessionRepository eventSessionRepository,
19:         IApprovalStatusRepository approvalStatusRepository,
20:         IEventRegistrationRepository eventRegistrationRepository)
21:     {
22:         _userRepository = userRepository;
23:         _eventSessionRepository = eventSessionRepository;
24:         _approvalStatusRepository = approvalStatusRepository;
25:         _eventRegistrationRepository = eventRegistrationRepository;
26: 
27:         RuleFor(x => x.UserId)
28:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
29:             .MustAsync(UserExists)
30:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} not found");
31: 
32:         RuleFor(x => x.EventSessionId)
33:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
34:             .MustAsync(EventSessionExists)
35:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} not found");
36: 
37:         RuleFor(x => x.ApprovalStatusId)
38:             .MustAsync(ApprovalStatusExists)
39:             .When(x => x.ApprovalStatusId.HasValue)
40:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} not found");
41: 
42: 
43: 
44: 
45:         RuleFor(x => x)
46:             .MustAsync(UserNotAlreadyRegistered)
47:             .WithMessage("User is already registered for this Event Session");
48:     }
49: 
50:     private async Task<bool> UserExists(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
51:     {
52:         return await _userRepository.Exists(userId);
53:     }
54: 
55:     private async Task<bool> EventSessionExists(Guid eventSessionId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
56:     {
57:         return await _eventSessionRepository.Exists(eventSessionId);
58:     }
59: 
60:     private async Task<bool> ApprovalStatusExists(int? approvalStatusId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
61:     {
62:         if (!approvalStatusId.HasValue) return true;
63:         return await _approvalStatusRepository.Exists(approvalStatusId.Value);
64:     }
65: 
66:     private async Task<bool> UserNotAlreadyRegistered(CreateEventRegistrationDto dto, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
67:     {
68:         return !await _eventRegistrationRepository.IsUserRegisteredForSession(dto.UserId, dto.EventSessionId);
69:     }
70: }
````

````csharp
 1: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 2: using Explore.Domain;
 3: using FluentValidation;
 4: 
 5: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.EventSession.Validators;
 6: 
 7: public class CreateEventSessionDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateEventSessionDto>
 8: {
 9:     private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
10:     private readonly ILocationRepository _locationRepository;
11:     private readonly IRegistrationModeRepository _registrationModeRepository;
12: 
13:     public CreateEventSessionDtoValidator(
14:         IEventRepository eventRepository,
15:         ILocationRepository locationRepository,
16:         IRegistrationModeRepository registrationModeRepository)
17:     {
18:         _eventRepository = eventRepository;
19:         _locationRepository = locationRepository;
20:         _registrationModeRepository = registrationModeRepository;
21: 
22:         RuleFor(p => p.EventId)
23:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
24:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
25:             {
26:                 var exists = await _eventRepository.Exists(id);
27:                 return exists;
28:             }).WithMessage("{PropertyName} does not exist.");
29: 
30:         RuleFor(p => p.StartTime)
31:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.");
32: 
33:         RuleFor(p => p.EndTime)
34:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
35:             .GreaterThan(p => p.StartTime).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be after StartTime.");
36: 
37:         RuleFor(p => p.LocationId)
38:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
39:             {
40:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
41:                 var exists = await _locationRepository.Exists(id.Value);
42:                 return exists;
43:             }).WithMessage("{PropertyName} does not exist.");
44: 
45:         RuleFor(p => p.Title)
46:             .MaximumLength(500).When(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.Title))
47:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
48: 
49:         RuleFor(p => p.Description)
50:             .MaximumLength(500).When(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.Description))
51:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
52: 
53:         RuleFor(p => p.Slug)
54:             .MaximumLength(500).When(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.Slug))
55:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
56: 
57:         RuleFor(p => p.MaxAudienceAttendees)
58:             .GreaterThan(0).When(p => p.MaxAudienceAttendees.HasValue)
59:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be greater than 0.");
60: 
61:         RuleFor(p => p.RegistrationModeId)
62:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
63:             {
64:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
65:                 var exists = await _registrationModeRepository.Exists(id.Value);
66:                 return exists;
67:             }).WithMessage("{PropertyName} does not exist.");
68: 
69:         RuleFor(p => p.Price)
70:             .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0).When(p => p.Price.HasValue)
71:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be greater than or equal to 0.");
72: 
73:         RuleFor(p => p.CurrencyCode)
74:             .MaximumLength(3).When(p => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p.CurrencyCode))
75:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be a valid 3-letter currency code.");
76: 
77:         RuleFor(p => p)
78:             .Must(p =>
79:             {
80:                 if (p.IslamicAspect == null)
81:                 {
82:                     return true;
83:                 }
84: 
85:                 if (p.IslamicAspect.StartTimeType == SessionStartTimeType.Fixed)
86:                 {
87:                     return true;
88:                 }
89: 
90:                 return p.IslamicAspect.ReferencePrayer.HasValue
91:                     && p.IslamicAspect.OffsetMinutes.HasValue
92:                     && p.LocationId.HasValue;
93:             })
94:             .WithMessage("Islamic session scheduling requires LocationId, ReferencePrayer, and OffsetMinutes when StartTimeType is RelativeToPrayer.");
95: 
96: 
97: 
98:     }
99: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/ActorKeyStores/Handlers/Commands/CreateActorKeyStoreCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using AutoMapper;
 2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 4: using Explore.Application.DTOs.ActorKeyStore.Validators;
 5: using Explore.Application.Features.ActorKeyStores.Requests.Commands;
 6: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 7: using Explore.Domain;
 8: using FluentValidation;
 9: using MediatR;
10: 
11: namespace Explore.Application.Features.ActorKeyStores.Handlers.Commands;
12: 
13: public class CreateActorKeyStoreCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateActorKeyStoreCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
14: {
15:     private readonly IActorKeyStoreRepository _actorKeyStoreRepository;
16:     private readonly IActorRepository _actorRepository;
17:     private readonly ITenantRepository _tenantRepository;
18:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
19:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
20: 
21:     public CreateActorKeyStoreCommandHandler(
22:         IActorKeyStoreRepository actorKeyStoreRepository,
23:         IActorRepository actorRepository,
24:         ITenantRepository tenantRepository,
25:         ITenantContext tenantContext,
26:         IMapper mapper)
27:     {
28:         _actorKeyStoreRepository = actorKeyStoreRepository;
29:         _actorRepository = actorRepository;
30:         _tenantRepository = tenantRepository;
31:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
32:         _mapper = mapper;
33:     }
34: 
35:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(CreateActorKeyStoreCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
36:     {
37:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
38: 
39:         var validator = new CreateActorKeyStoreDtoValidator(_actorRepository, _tenantRepository);
40:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.ActorKeyStoreDto, cancellationToken);
41: 
42:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
43:         {
44:             response.Success = false;
45:             response.Message = "Actor Key Store creation failed.";
46:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
47:             return response;
48:         }
49: 
50:         var keyStore = _mapper.Map<ActorKeyStore>(request.ActorKeyStoreDto);
51:         keyStore.CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
52: 
53: 
54:         keyStore.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
55: 
56:         keyStore = await _actorKeyStoreRepository.Create(keyStore);
57: 
58:         response.Success = true;
59:         response.Id = keyStore.Id;
60:         response.Message = "Actor Key Store created successfully.";
61: 
62:         return response;
63:     }
64: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Categories/Handlers/Queries/GetCategoryListRequestHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System.Collections.Generic;
 2: using System.Threading;
 3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 4: using AutoMapper;
 5: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 6: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Category;
 7: using Explore.Application.Features.Categories.Requests.Queries;
 8: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 9: using MediatR;
10: using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Hybrid;
11: 
12: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Categories.Handlers.Queries;
13: 
14: public class GetCategoryListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetCategoryListRequest, PaginatedResult<CategoryListDto>>
15: {
16:     private readonly ICategoryRepository _categoryRepository;
17:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
18:     private readonly HybridCache _cache;
19: 
20:     public GetCategoryListRequestHandler(
21:         ICategoryRepository categoryRepository,
22:         IMapper mapper,
23:         HybridCache cache)
24:     {
25:         _categoryRepository = categoryRepository;
26:         _mapper = mapper;
27:         _cache = cache;
28:     }
29: 
30:     public async Task<PaginatedResult<CategoryListDto>> Handle(GetCategoryListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
31:     {
32:         var (pageNumber, pageSize) = PaginatedResult<CategoryListDto>.NormalizeParameters(request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
33:         var cacheKey = $"categories:list:{pageNumber}:{pageSize}";
34: 
35:         return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
36:             cacheKey,
37:             async _ =>
38:             {
39:                 var (categories, totalCount) = await _categoryRepository.GetCategoriesWithDetailsPaged(pageNumber, pageSize);
40:                 var dtos = _mapper.Map<List<CategoryListDto>>(categories);
41:                 return PaginatedResult<CategoryListDto>.Create(dtos, totalCount, pageNumber, pageSize);
42:             },
43:             new HybridCacheEntryOptions
44:             {
45:                 Expiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
46:                 LocalCacheExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
47:             },
48:             cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
49:     }
50: }
````

````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Collections.Generic;
 3: using System.Threading;

13: namespace Explore.Application.Features.EventCategories.Handlers.Queries;
14: 
15: public class GetEventsByCategoryRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetEventsByCategoryRequest, List<EventListDto>>
16: {
17:     private readonly IEventCategoriesRepository _eventCategoriesRepository;
18:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
19:     private readonly IObjectStorageService _objectStorageService;
20:     private readonly ILogger<GetEventsByCategoryRequestHandler> _logger;
21: 
22:     public GetEventsByCategoryRequestHandler(
23:         IEventCategoriesRepository eventCategoriesRepository,
24:         IMapper mapper,
25:         IObjectStorageService objectStorageService,
26:         ILogger<GetEventsByCategoryRequestHandler> logger)
27:     {
28:         _eventCategoriesRepository = eventCategoriesRepository;
29:         _mapper = mapper;
30:         _objectStorageService = objectStorageService;
31:         _logger = logger;
32:     }
33: 
34:     public async Task<List<EventListDto>> Handle(GetEventsByCategoryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
35:     {
36:         var events = await _eventCategoriesRepository.GetEventsByCategory(request.CategoryId);
37:         var eventDtos = _mapper.Map<List<EventListDto>>(events);
38: 
39: 
40:         foreach (var dto in eventDtos)
41:         {
42:             dto.FeaturedImageUri = await ResolveImageUrl(dto.FeaturedImageUri);
43:             dto.ActorProfilePictureUri = await ResolveImageUrl(dto.ActorProfilePictureUri);
44:         }
45: 
46:         return eventDtos;
47:     }
48: 
49: 
50: 
51: 
52: 
53:     private async Task<string?> ResolveImageUrl(string? objectKeyOrUri)
54:     {
55:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(objectKeyOrUri))
56:             return null;
57: 
58:         try
59:         {
60: 
61:             if (objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
62:                 objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
63:             {
64: 
65:                 if (Uri.TryCreate(objectKeyOrUri, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
66:                 {
67:                     var objectKey = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
68:                     return await _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKey, 60);
69:                 }
70:                 return objectKeyOrUri;
71:             }
72: 
73: 
74:             return await _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKeyOrUri, 60);
75:         }
76:         catch (Exception ex)
77:         {
78:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to generate presigned URL for object key: {ObjectKey}", objectKeyOrUri);
79:             return null;
80:         }
81:     }
82: }
````

````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 7: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Event.Validators;

13: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Events.Handlers.Commands;
14: 
15: public class UpdateEventCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateEventCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
16: {
17:     private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
18:     private readonly IAudienceAgeRepository _audienceAgeRepository;
19:     private readonly IAudienceGenderRepository _audienceGenderRepository;
20:     private readonly IEventTypeRepository _eventTypeRepository;
21:     private readonly IActorRepository _actorRepository;
22:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
23:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
24:     private readonly HybridCache _cache;
25: 
26:     public UpdateEventCommandHandler(
27:         IEventRepository eventRepository,
28:         IAudienceAgeRepository audienceAgeRepository,
29:         IAudienceGenderRepository audienceGenderRepository,
30:         IEventTypeRepository eventTypeRepository,
31:         IActorRepository actorRepository,
32:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository,
33:         IMapper mapper,
34:         HybridCache cache)
35:     {
36:         _eventRepository = eventRepository;
37:         _audienceAgeRepository = audienceAgeRepository;
38:         _audienceGenderRepository = audienceGenderRepository;
39:         _eventTypeRepository = eventTypeRepository;
40:         _actorRepository = actorRepository;
41:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
42:         _mapper = mapper;
43:         _cache = cache;
44:     }
45: 
46:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateEventCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
47:     {
48:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
49: 
50:         var validator = new UpdateEventDtoValidator(_audienceAgeRepository, _audienceGenderRepository, _eventTypeRepository, _actorRepository, _storageObjectRepository);
51:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.EventDto, cancellationToken);
52: 
53:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
54:         {
55:             response.Success = false;
56:             response.Message = "Event update failed.";
57:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
58:             return response;
59:         }
60: 
61:         var @event = await _eventRepository.GetById(request.EventDto.Id);
62:         if (@event == null)
63:         {
64:             response.Success = false;
65:             response.Message = "Event not found.";
66:             return response;
67:         }
68: 
69:         _mapper.Map(request.EventDto, @event);
70: 
71:         await _eventRepository.Update(@event);
72: 
73:         response.Success = true;
74:         response.Id = @event.Id;
75:         response.Message = "Event updated successfully.";
76: 
77:         await _cache.RemoveAsync($"event:detail:{@event.Id}", cancellationToken);
78:         await _cache.RemoveAsync("events:list:1:20", cancellationToken);
79: 
80:         return response;
81:     }
82: }
````

````csharp
37:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.EventSessionLanguageDto, cancellationToken);
38: 
39:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
40:         {
41:             response.Success = false;
42:             response.Message = "Event Session Language update failed.";

44:             return response;
45:         }

49:         {
50:             response.Success = false;
51:             response.Message = "Event Session Language not found.";
52:             return response;
53:         }

56:         await _repository.Update(eventSessionLanguage);
57: 
58:         response.Success = true;

60:         response.Message = "Event Session Language updated successfully.";
61: 
62:         return response;
````

````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Collections.Generic;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 7: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 8: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Event;
 9: using Explore.Application.Features.EventTags.Requests.Queries;
10: using MediatR;
11: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
12: 
13: namespace Explore.Application.Features.EventTags.Handlers.Queries;
14: 
15: public class GetEventsByTagRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetEventsByTagRequest, List<EventListDto>>
16: {
17:     private readonly IEventTagsRepository _eventTagsRepository;
18:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
19:     private readonly IObjectStorageService _objectStorageService;
20:     private readonly ILogger<GetEventsByTagRequestHandler> _logger;
21: 
22:     public GetEventsByTagRequestHandler(
23:         IEventTagsRepository eventTagsRepository,
24:         IMapper mapper,
25:         IObjectStorageService objectStorageService,
26:         ILogger<GetEventsByTagRequestHandler> logger)
27:     {
28:         _eventTagsRepository = eventTagsRepository;
29:         _mapper = mapper;
30:         _objectStorageService = objectStorageService;
31:         _logger = logger;
32:     }
33: 
34:     public async Task<List<EventListDto>> Handle(GetEventsByTagRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
35:     {
36:         var events = await _eventTagsRepository.GetEventsByTag(request.TagId);
37:         var eventDtos = _mapper.Map<List<EventListDto>>(events);
38: 
39: 
40:         foreach (var dto in eventDtos)
41:         {
42:             dto.FeaturedImageUri = await ResolveImageUrl(dto.FeaturedImageUri);
43:             dto.ActorProfilePictureUri = await ResolveImageUrl(dto.ActorProfilePictureUri);
44:         }
45: 
46:         return eventDtos;
47:     }
48: 
49: 
50: 
51: 
52: 
53:     private async Task<string?> ResolveImageUrl(string? objectKeyOrUri)
54:     {
55:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(objectKeyOrUri))
56:             return null;
57: 
58:         try
59:         {
60: 
61:             if (objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
62:                 objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
63:             {
64: 
65:                 if (Uri.TryCreate(objectKeyOrUri, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
66:                 {
67:                     var objectKey = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
68:                     return await _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKey, 60);
69:                 }
70:                 return objectKeyOrUri;
71:             }
72: 
73: 
74:             return await _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKeyOrUri, 60);
75:         }
76:         catch (Exception ex)
77:         {
78:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to generate presigned URL for object key: {ObjectKey}", objectKeyOrUri);
79:             return null;
80:         }
81:     }
82: }
````

````csharp

 11: 
 12: namespace Explore.Application.Features.InstanceOnboarding.Handlers.Commands;
 13: 
 14: public class UpdateInstanceGovernanceSettingsCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateInstanceGovernanceSettingsCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
 15: {
 16:     private readonly IAdminContext _adminContext;
 17:     private readonly IInstanceBootstrapStateRepository _instanceBootstrapStateRepository;
 18:     private readonly ITenantRepository _tenantRepository;
 19:     private readonly ITenantSettingsRepository _tenantSettingsRepository;
 20:     private readonly IInstanceGovernanceSettingService _governanceSettingService;
 21: 
 22:     public UpdateInstanceGovernanceSettingsCommandHandler(
 23:         IAdminContext adminContext,
 24:         IInstanceBootstrapStateRepository instanceBootstrapStateRepository,
 25:         ITenantRepository tenantRepository,
 26:         ITenantSettingsRepository tenantSettingsRepository,
 27:         IInstanceGovernanceSettingService governanceSettingService)
 28:     {
 29:         _adminContext = adminContext;
 30:         _instanceBootstrapStateRepository = instanceBootstrapStateRepository;
 31:         _tenantRepository = tenantRepository;
 32:         _tenantSettingsRepository = tenantSettingsRepository;
 33:         _governanceSettingService = governanceSettingService;
 34:     }
 35: 
 36:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateInstanceGovernanceSettingsCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 37:     {
 38:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
 39: 
 40:         var isInstanceAdmin = await _adminContext.IsInstanceAdminAsync(request.UserId, cancellationToken);
 41:         if (!isInstanceAdmin)
 42:         {
 43:             response.Success = false;
 44:             response.Message = "Only instance administrators can update instance governance settings.";
 45:             return response;
 46:         }
 47: 
 48:         var normalizedDeploymentMode = NormalizeDeploymentMode(request.Settings.DeploymentMode);
 49:         if (normalizedDeploymentMode == null)
 50:         {
 51:             response.Success = false;
 52:             response.Message = "Invalid deployment mode.";
 53:             response.Errors = new List<string> { "DeploymentMode must be SingleTenant or MultiTenant." };
 54:             return response;
 55:         }
 56: 
 57:         request.Settings.DeploymentMode = normalizedDeploymentMode;
 58: 
 59:         var defaultTenant = await EnsureDefaultTenantAsync();
 60:         await EnsureDefaultTenantSettingsAsync(defaultTenant.Id);
 61: 
 62:         await _governanceSettingService.ApplySettingsAsync(defaultTenant.Id, request.Settings, request.UserId);
 63: 
 64:         var bootstrap = await _instanceBootstrapStateRepository.GetCurrent();
 65:         if (bootstrap != null)
 66:         {
 67:             bootstrap.SelectedDeploymentMode = request.Settings.DeploymentMode;
 68:             await _instanceBootstrapStateRepository.Update(bootstrap);
 69:             response.Id = bootstrap.Id;
 70:         }
 71:         else
 72:         {
 73:             response.Id = Guid.Empty;
 74:         }
 75: 
 76:         response.Success = true;
 77:         response.Message = "Instance governance settings updated successfully.";
 78:         return response;
 79:     }
 80: 
 81:     private async Task<Tenant> EnsureDefaultTenantAsync()
 82:     {
 83:         var tenant = await _tenantRepository.GetById(PlatformDefaults.DefaultTenantId);
 84:         if (tenant != null)
 85:         {
 86:             return tenant;
 87:         }
 88: 
 89:         return await _tenantRepository.Create(new Tenant
 90:         {
 91:             Id = PlatformDefaults.DefaultTenantId,
 92:             FullName = PlatformDefaults.DefaultTenantName,
 93:             Slug = PlatformDefaults.DefaultTenantSlug,
 94:             TenantStatusId = (int)TenantStatusEnum.Active,
 95:             TenantStatus = new TenantStatus
 96:             {
 97:                 Id = (int)TenantStatusEnum.Active,
 98:                 MasterCode = "ACTIVE",
 99:                 FullName = "Active",
100:                 IsActiveState = true
101:             }
102:         });
103:     }
104: 
105:     private async Task EnsureDefaultTenantSettingsAsync(Guid tenantId)
106:     {
107:         var existing = await _tenantSettingsRepository.GetByTenant(tenantId);
108:         if (existing != null)
109:         {
110:             return;
111:         }
112: 
113:         await _tenantSettingsRepository.Create(new TenantSettingsEntity
114:         {
115:             TenantId = tenantId,
116:             Tenant = null!
117:         });
118:     }
119: 
120:     private static string? NormalizeDeploymentMode(string? deploymentMode)
121:     {
122:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(deploymentMode))
123:         {
124:             return null;
125:         }
126: 
127:         if (deploymentMode.Equals("SingleTenant", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
128:         {
129:             return "SingleTenant";
130:         }
131: 
132:         if (deploymentMode.Equals("MultiTenant", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
133:         {
134:             return "MultiTenant";
135:         }
136: 
137:         return null;
138:     }
139: }
````

````csharp
17: {
18:     private readonly IOrganizationRepository _organizationRepository;
19:     private readonly IOrganizationMemberRepository _organizationMemberRepository;
20:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
21:     private readonly HybridCache _cache;
22: 
23:     public UpdateOrganizationDetailsCommandHandler(
24:         IOrganizationRepository organizationRepository,
25:         IOrganizationMemberRepository organizationMemberRepository,
26:         IMapper mapper,
27:         HybridCache cache)
28:     {
29:         _organizationRepository = organizationRepository;
30:         _organizationMemberRepository = organizationMemberRepository;
31:         _mapper = mapper;
32:         _cache = cache;
33:     }
34: 
35:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateOrganizationDetailsCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
36:     {
37:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
38: 
39: 
40:         var organization = await _organizationRepository.GetById(request.Id);
41: 
42:         if (organization == null)
43:         {
44:             response.Success = false;
45:             response.Message = "Organization not found.";
46:             return response;
47:         }
48: 
49: 
50:         var members = await _organizationMemberRepository.GetMembersByOrganizationId(request.Id);
51:         if (Guid.TryParse(request.UserId, out Guid userGuid))
52:         {
53:             var requesterMember = members.FirstOrDefault(m => m.UserId == userGuid);
54:             if (requesterMember == null || requesterMember.RoleId != (int)RoleEnum.OrgAdmin)
55:             {
56:                 response.Success = false;
57:                 response.Message = "You are not authorized to update this organization.";
58:                 return response;
59:             }
60:         }
61:         else
62:         {
63:             response.Success = false;
64:             response.Message = "Invalid user ID.";
65:             return response;
66:         }
67: 
68: 
69:         organization.FullName = request.OrganizationDto.FullName;
70:         organization.WebsiteUrl = request.OrganizationDto.WebsiteUrl;
71:         organization.Email = request.OrganizationDto.Email;
72:         organization.Country = request.OrganizationDto.Country;
73:         organization.City = request.OrganizationDto.City;
74:         organization.Postcode = request.OrganizationDto.Postcode.ToString();
75:         organization.Address = request.OrganizationDto.Address;
76:         organization.MetadataJson = request.OrganizationDto.MetadataJson;
77: 
78:         await _organizationRepository.Update(organization);
79:         await _cache.RemoveAsync($"organization:detail:{organization.Id}", cancellationToken);
80: 
81:         response.Success = true;
82:         response.Message = "Organization updated successfully.";
83:         response.Id = organization.Id;
84:         return response;
85:     }
86: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/TenantOnboarding/Handlers/Commands/UpdateTenantPolicySettingsCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
  1: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Identity;
  2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
  3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Services;
  5: using Explore.Application.Exceptions;
  6: using Explore.Application.Features.TenantOnboarding.Requests.Commands;
  7: using Explore.Application.Responses;
  8: using FluentValidation.Results;
  9: using MediatR;
 10: 
 11: namespace Explore.Application.Features.TenantOnboarding.Handlers.Commands;
 12: 
 13: public class UpdateTenantPolicySettingsCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateTenantPolicySettingsCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
 14: {
 15:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
 16:     private readonly ITenantOnboardingStateRepository _tenantOnboardingStateRepository;
 17:     private readonly IAdminContext _adminContext;
 18:     private readonly ITenantPolicySettingService _policySettingService;
 19: 
 20:     public UpdateTenantPolicySettingsCommandHandler(
 21:         ITenantContext tenantContext,
 22:         ITenantOnboardingStateRepository tenantOnboardingStateRepository,
 23:         IAdminContext adminContext,
 24:         ITenantPolicySettingService policySettingService)
 25:     {
 26:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
 27:         _tenantOnboardingStateRepository = tenantOnboardingStateRepository;
 28:         _adminContext = adminContext;
 29:         _policySettingService = policySettingService;
 30:     }
 31: 
 32:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateTenantPolicySettingsCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 33:     {
 34:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
 35:         var tenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
 36: 
 37:         if (!await IsUserAuthorizedAsync(tenantId, cancellationToken))
 38:         {
 39:             response.Success = false;
 40:             response.Message = "Only tenant administrators or instance administrators can update tenant settings.";
 41:             return response;
 42:         }
 43: 
 44:         await EnsureLockedSettingsAreNotModifiedAsync(tenantId, request.Settings);
 45: 
 46:         await _policySettingService.ApplyTenantSettingsAsync(tenantId, request.UserId, request.Settings);
 47: 
 48:         var onboardingState = await _tenantOnboardingStateRepository.GetByTenantId(tenantId);
 49:         response.Id = onboardingState?.Id ?? Guid.Empty;
 50:         response.Success = true;
 51:         response.Message = "Tenant settings updated successfully.";
 52:         return response;
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     private async Task<bool> IsUserAuthorizedAsync(Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 56:     {
 57:         if (await _adminContext.IsTenantAdminAsync(tenantId, cancellationToken))
 58:         {
 59:             return true;
 60:         }
 61: 
 62:         return await _adminContext.IsInstanceAdminAsync(cancellationToken);
 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     private async Task EnsureLockedSettingsAreNotModifiedAsync(Guid tenantId, DTOs.Onboarding.TenantPolicySettingsDto requestSettings)
 66:     {
 67:         var effectiveSettings = await _policySettingService.ReadEffectiveTenantSettingsAsync(tenantId);
 68:         var failures = new List<ValidationFailure>();
 69: 
 70:         AddLockedValueChangeFailure(
 71:             failures,
 72:             nameof(requestSettings.RequireOrganizationVerification),
 73:             effectiveSettings.CanTenantOmitVerification,
 74:             effectiveSettings.RequireOrganizationVerification,
 75:             requestSettings.RequireOrganizationVerification,
 76:             "Organization verification requirement is locked by instance policy.");
 77: 
 78:         AddLockedValueChangeFailure(
 79:             failures,
 80:             nameof(requestSettings.PreferredHomePage),
 81:             effectiveSettings.CanOverrideHomePagePreference,
 82:             effectiveSettings.PreferredHomePage,
 83:             requestSettings.PreferredHomePage,
 84:             "Preferred home page is locked by instance policy.");
 85: 
 86:         AddLockedValueChangeFailure(
 87:             failures,
 88:             nameof(requestSettings.Subdomain),
 89:             effectiveSettings.CanOverrideSubdomain,
 90:             effectiveSettings.Subdomain,
 91:             requestSettings.Subdomain,
 92:             "Tenant subdomain is locked by instance policy.");
 93: 
 94:         AddLockedValueChangeFailure(
 95:             failures,
 96:             nameof(requestSettings.CustomDomain),
 97:             effectiveSettings.CanOverrideCustomDomain,
 98:             effectiveSettings.CustomDomain,
 99:             requestSettings.CustomDomain,
100:             "Tenant custom domain is locked by instance policy.");
101: 
102:         AddLockedValueChangeFailure(
103:             failures,
104:             nameof(requestSettings.BrandDisplayName),
105:             effectiveSettings.CanOverrideBrandDisplayName,
106:             effectiveSettings.BrandDisplayName,
107:             requestSettings.BrandDisplayName,
108:             "Tenant brand display name is locked by instance policy.");
109: 
110:         AddLockedValueChangeFailure(
111:             failures,
112:             nameof(requestSettings.BrandLogoUrl),
113:             effectiveSettings.CanOverrideBrandLogoUrl,
114:             effectiveSettings.BrandLogoUrl,
115:             requestSettings.BrandLogoUrl,
116:             "Tenant brand logo URL is locked by instance policy.");
117: 
118:         AddLockedValueChangeFailure(
119:             failures,
120:             nameof(requestSettings.BrandFaviconUrl),
121:             effectiveSettings.CanOverrideBrandFaviconUrl,
122:             effectiveSettings.BrandFaviconUrl,
123:             requestSettings.BrandFaviconUrl,
124:             "Tenant brand favicon URL is locked by instance policy.");
125: 
126:         AddLockedValueChangeFailure(
127:             failures,
128:             nameof(requestSettings.BrandCustomCssUrl),
129:             effectiveSettings.CanOverrideBrandCustomCssUrl,
130:             effectiveSettings.BrandCustomCssUrl,
131:             requestSettings.BrandCustomCssUrl,
132:             "Tenant brand custom CSS URL is locked by instance policy.");
133: 
134:         if (failures.Count > 0)
135:         {
136:             throw new ValidationException(new ValidationResult(failures));
137:         }
138:     }
139: 
140:     private static void AddLockedValueChangeFailure(
141:         List<ValidationFailure> failures,
142:         string propertyName,
143:         bool canOverride,
144:         object? effectiveValue,
145:         object? requestedValue,
146:         string message)
147:     {
148:         if (canOverride)
149:         {
150:             return;
151:         }
152: 
153:         if (ValuesEqual(effectiveValue, requestedValue))
154:         {
155:             return;
156:         }
157: 
158:         failures.Add(new ValidationFailure(propertyName, message));
159:     }
160: 
161:     private static bool ValuesEqual(object? left, object? right)
162:     {
163:         if (left is string leftString && right is string rightString)
164:         {
165:             return string.Equals(leftString.Trim(), rightString.Trim(), StringComparison.Ordinal);
166:         }
167: 
168:         return Equals(left, right);
169:     }
170: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/TenantOnboarding/Handlers/Queries/GetTenantOnboardingStatusQueryHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System.Text.Json;
 2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Identity;
 3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 5: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Onboarding;
 6: using Explore.Application.Features.TenantOnboarding.Requests.Queries;
 7: using MediatR;
 8: 
 9: namespace Explore.Application.Features.TenantOnboarding.Handlers.Queries;
10: 
11: public class GetTenantOnboardingStatusQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetTenantOnboardingStatusQuery, TenantOnboardingStatusDto>
12: {
13:     private readonly ITenantOnboardingStateRepository _tenantOnboardingStateRepository;
14:     private readonly IAdminContext _adminContext;
15:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
16:     private readonly ICurrentUserService _currentUserService;
17: 
18:     public GetTenantOnboardingStatusQueryHandler(
19:         ITenantOnboardingStateRepository tenantOnboardingStateRepository,
20:         IAdminContext adminContext,
21:         ITenantContext tenantContext,
22:         ICurrentUserService currentUserService)
23:     {
24:         _tenantOnboardingStateRepository = tenantOnboardingStateRepository;
25:         _adminContext = adminContext;
26:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
27:         _currentUserService = currentUserService;
28:     }
29: 
30:     public async Task<TenantOnboardingStatusDto> Handle(GetTenantOnboardingStatusQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
31:     {
32:         var tenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
33:         var onboardingState = await _tenantOnboardingStateRepository.GetByTenantId(tenantId);
34:         var completedSteps = ParseCompletedSteps(onboardingState?.CompletedStepsJson);
35:         var totalSteps = onboardingState?.TotalSteps ?? 0;
36:         var currentStep = onboardingState?.CurrentStep ?? 0;
37: 
38:         var response = new TenantOnboardingStatusDto
39:         {
40:             TenantId = tenantId,
41:             IsCompleted = onboardingState?.IsCompleted == true,
42:             IsAuthenticated = _currentUserService.IsAuthenticated,
43:             IsCurrentUserTenantAdministrator = false,
44:             IsCurrentUserPlatformAdministrator = false,
45:             CurrentStep = currentStep,
46:             TotalSteps = totalSteps,
47:             CompletedSteps = completedSteps,
48:             ProgressPercentage = CalculateProgressPercentage(currentStep, totalSteps)
49:         };
50: 
51:         if (!_currentUserService.IsAuthenticated || !_currentUserService.UserId.HasValue)
52:         {
53:             return response;
54:         }
55: 
56:         response.IsCurrentUserTenantAdministrator = await _adminContext.IsTenantAdminAsync(tenantId, cancellationToken);
57:         response.IsCurrentUserPlatformAdministrator = await _adminContext.IsInstanceAdminAsync(cancellationToken);
58: 
59:         return response;
60:     }
61: 
62:     private static string[] ParseCompletedSteps(string? raw)
63:     {
64:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw))
65:         {
66:             return Array.Empty<string>();
67:         }
68: 
69:         try
70:         {
71:             return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<string[]>(raw) ?? Array.Empty<string>();
72:         }
73:         catch
74:         {
75:             return Array.Empty<string>();
76:         }
77:     }
78: 
79:     private static int CalculateProgressPercentage(int currentStep, int totalSteps)
80:     {
81:         if (totalSteps <= 0)
82:         {
83:             return 0;
84:         }
85: 
86:         var percent = (int)Math.Round((double)currentStep / totalSteps * 100, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
87:         return Math.Clamp(percent, 0, 100);
88:     }
89: }
````

````csharp
 8: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Users.Handlers.Queries;
 9: 
10: 
11: 
12: 
13: 
14: public class GetUserOrganizationsRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetUserOrganizationsRequest, List<OrganizationListDto>>
15: {
16:     private readonly IOrganizationMemberRepository _organizationMemberRepository;
17:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
18: 
19:     public GetUserOrganizationsRequestHandler(
20:         IOrganizationMemberRepository organizationMemberRepository,
21:         IMapper mapper)
22:     {
23:         _organizationMemberRepository = organizationMemberRepository;
24:         _mapper = mapper;
25:     }
26: 
27:     public async Task<List<OrganizationListDto>> Handle(GetUserOrganizationsRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
28:     {
29:         Console.WriteLine($"[GET USER ORGS] Getting organizations for user: {request.UserId}");
30: 
31: 
32:         var memberships = await _organizationMemberRepository.GetMembershipsByUser(request.UserId);
33: 
34:         Console.WriteLine($"[GET USER ORGS] Found {memberships.Count} memberships");
35: 
36: 
37:         var dtos = new List<OrganizationListDto>();
38: 
39:         foreach (var membership in memberships)
40:         {
41:             if (membership.Organization == null) continue;
42: 
43:             var dto = _mapper.Map<OrganizationListDto>(membership.Organization);
44:             dto.CurrentUserRole = (RoleEnum)membership.RoleId;
45:             dtos.Add(dto);
46: 
47:             Console.WriteLine($"[GET USER ORGS] Org: {dto.FullName}, Role: {dto.CurrentUserRole}");
48:         }
49: 
50:         return dtos;
51:     }
52: }
````

## File: Explore.Persistence/Repositories/CategoryRepository.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Collections.Generic;
 3: using System.Text;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 5: using Explore.Domain;
 6: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 7: 
 8: namespace Explore.Persistence.Repositories;
 9: 
10: public class CategoryRepository : GenericRepository<Category, Guid>, ICategoryRepository
11: {
12:     private static readonly Func<ExploreDbContext, Guid, Task<Category?>> GetByIdCompiled =
13:         EF.CompileAsyncQuery((ExploreDbContext ctx, Guid id) =>
14:             ctx.Categories
15:                 .AsNoTracking()
16:                 .FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == id));
17: 
18:     private readonly ExploreDbContext _dbContext;
19: 
20:     public CategoryRepository(ExploreDbContext dbContext) : base(dbContext)
21:     {
22:         _dbContext = dbContext;
23:     }
24: 
25:     public new async Task<Category?> GetById(Guid id)
26:     {
27:         return await GetByIdCompiled(_dbContext, id);
28:     }
29: 
30:     public async Task<Category> GetCategoryWithDetails(Guid id)
31:     {
32:         return await _dbContext.Categories
33:             .AsNoTracking()
34:             .Include(c => c.Parent)
35:             .Include(c => c.Tenant)
36:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == id);
37:     }
38: 
39:     public async Task<List<Category>> GetCategoriesWithDetails()
40:     {
41:         return await _dbContext.Categories
42:             .AsNoTracking()
43:             .Include(c => c.Parent)
44:             .Include(c => c.Tenant)
45:             .ToListAsync();
46:     }
47: 
48:     public async Task<(List<Category> Items, int TotalCount)> GetCategoriesWithDetailsPaged(int pageNumber, int pageSize)
49:     {
50:         var query = _dbContext.Categories
51:             .AsNoTracking()
52:             .Include(c => c.Parent)
53:             .OrderBy(c => c.FullName);
54: 
55:         var totalCount = await query.CountAsync();
56:         var items = await query
57:             .Skip((pageNumber - 1) * pageSize)
58:             .Take(pageSize)
59:             .ToListAsync();
60: 
61:         return (items, totalCount);
62:     }
63: }
````

````csharp
29:             .Include(x => x.User)
30:             .Include(x => x.Role)
31:             .Where(x => x.TenantId == tenantId)
32:             .ToListAsync();
33:     }
34: 
35:     public async Task<List<TenantMember>> GetByUserId(Guid userId)
36:     {
37:         return await _dbContext.TenantMembers
38:             .AsNoTracking()
39:             .Include(x => x.Tenant)
40:             .Include(x => x.Role)
41:             .Where(x => x.UserId == userId)
42:             .ToListAsync();
43:     }
44: 
45:     public async Task<bool> IsTenantMember(Guid tenantId, Guid userId)
46:     {
47:         return await _dbContext.TenantMembers
48:             .AsNoTracking()
49:             .AnyAsync(x => x.TenantId == tenantId && x.UserId == userId);
50:     }
51: 
52:     public async Task<bool> IsTenantAdmin(Guid tenantId, Guid userId)
53:     {
54:         return await _dbContext.TenantMembers
55:             .AsNoTracking()
56:             .AnyAsync(x => x.TenantId == tenantId
57:                 && x.UserId == userId
58:                 && (x.RoleId == (int)RoleEnum.TenantOwner || x.RoleId == (int)RoleEnum.TenantAdmin));
59:     }
60: }
````

````csharp
157:         context.Response.Headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = "*";

159:         context.Response.Headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
160:         context.Response.Headers["Pragma"] = "no-cache";
161:

168:                 HealthStatus.Degraded => "Degraded",
169:                 HealthStatus.Unhealthy => "Service Unavailable",
170:                 _ => "Unknown"
171:             },
172:             totalDuration = report.TotalDuration.TotalMilliseconds,
173:             checks = report.Entries.Select(e => new
174:             {
175:                 name = e.Key,
176:                 status = e.Value.Status.ToString(),
177:                 description = e.Value.Description,
178:                 duration = e.Value.Duration.TotalMilliseconds,
179:                 error = e.Value.Exception?.Message,
180:                 data = e.Value.Data.Count > 0 ? e.Value.Data : null
181:             })
182:         };
183: 
184:         var jsonOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions
185:         {
186:             WriteIndented = true,
187:             PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase,
188:             DefaultIgnoreCondition = System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull
189:         };
190: 
191:         await context.Response.WriteAsync(JsonSerializer.Serialize(response, jsonOptions));
192:     }
193: }
````

````markdown
  1: ---

  8: 
  9: > **Project-Agnostic Blazor Component Architecture Agent**

 12: 
 13: # Blazor Component Architect Agent
 14: 
 15: ## Purpose
 16: 
 17: Designs, reviews, and refactors Blazor components for the {Project} platform. Ensures components follow Blazor best practices, MudBlazor patterns, BFF architecture, and Clean Architecture principles.
 18: 
 19: ## When This Agent Activates
 20: 
 21: **Triggered by**:
 22: - Keywords: "blazor", "component", "razor", "mudblazor", "page", "dialog", "layout", "wasm", "server", "bff", "render mode", "component design", "refactoring", "architecture review"
 23: - File patterns: `**/*.razor`, `**/*.razor.cs`, `**/*Blazor/**/*.cs`, `**/*Blazor.Client/**/*.cs`
 24: 
 25: ## {Project} Blazor Architecture
 26: 
 27: For an overview of the {Project} Blazor Hybrid Architecture and its integration with the BFF pattern, refer to [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and the `blazor-bff-patterns` skill.
 28: 
 29: ## Review Checklist
 30: 
 31: This checklist helps ensure components adhere to established patterns and best practices. For detailed guidance on each point, refer to the `blazor-ui-conventions` and `blazor-bff-patterns` skills.
 32: 
 33: ### Component Structure & Lifecycle
 34: 
 35: - [ ] Component has clear single responsibility.
 36: - [ ] Uses the project's routing strategy consistently (`@page` routing or centralized Blazouter `RouteConfig`).
 37: - [ ] Uses `@rendermode` appropriately (InteractiveAuto/Server/WebAssembly). See `blazor-ui-conventions` (render modes).
 38: - [ ] Proper `@using` statements are present.
 39: - [ ] `@code` block is organized (fields → properties → lifecycle → methods).
 40: - [ ] Parameter handling matches the local pattern: standard `[Parameter]` + `EventCallback` for most app components; use `ParameterState<T>` when building custom MudBlazor base/stateful components.
 41: - [ ] EventCallbacks are used for child → parent communication. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design).
 42: - [ ] Implements `IDisposable` for event cleanup. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design, state management).
 43: - [ ] Data loading in `OnInitializedAsync` (not `OnAfterRender`). See `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design).
 44: - [ ] JS interop in `OnAfterRenderAsync(firstRender: true)`. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design).
 45: - [ ] No `StateHasChanged()` in `OnAfterRender` (to prevent infinite loops). See `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design).
 46: - [ ] Null checks before accessing data.
 47: 
 48: ### MudBlazor Usage & Styling
 49: 
 50: - [ ] Uses MudBlazor components over raw HTML. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage).
 51: - [ ] Grid system used correctly (`MudGrid` + `MudItem` with breakpoints). See `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage).
 52: - [ ] Proper component properties (e.g., `Variant`, `Color`, `Size`) are applied. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage).
 53: - [ ] **BEM class names applied via `Class` parameter** (e.g., `Class="event-card event-card--featured"`). See `blazor-css-isolation`.
 54: - [ ] **CSS isolation via `Component.razor.css` file** (placed next to `.razor` file). See `blazor-css-isolation`.
 55: - [ ] **BEM naming in CSS** (`.block`, `.block__element`, `.block--modifier`). See `blazor-css-isolation`.
 56: - [ ] **Child components styled via own `.razor.css` or wrapper pattern** (not ::deep unless necessary). See `blazor-css-isolation`.
 57: - [ ] **::deep selector used only for third-party internals** (sparingly, documented why). See `blazor-css-isolation`.
 58: - [ ] **MudBlazor theme variables used** (not hardcoded colors). See `blazor-ui-conventions` (theming).
 59: - [ ] Dialogs use `[CascadingParameter] MudDialogInstance` for programmatic control. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage, common patterns).
 60: - [ ] Forms use MudBlazor input components. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage, common patterns).
 61: - [ ] Notifications use `ISnackbar`. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage).
 62: - [ ] Icons use `@Icons.Material.*` constants.
 63: 
 64: ### State Management & BFF Pattern Compliance
 65: 
 66: - [ ] State management patterns (component state, parameters, cascading values, services) are applied appropriately. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (state management).
 67: - [ ] Services wrap NSwag API client (not direct API calls). See `blazor-bff-patterns` (service layer patterns).
 68: - [ ] Services handle errors and return safe defaults. See `blazor-bff-patterns` (service layer patterns) and `error-tracking` (Blazor error boundary).
 69: - [ ] Services log operations for debugging. See `error-tracking` (logging).
 70: - [ ] Authentication state via `CascadingAuthenticationState`. See `blazor-bff-patterns` (auth state management) and `auth-patterns`.
 71: - [ ] No direct HttpContext access in WASM components. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (render modes) and `blazor-bff-patterns`.
 72: - [ ] Cookie-based authentication and token forwarding handled by BFF. See `blazor-bff-patterns`.
 73: - [ ] Theme state management (if applicable) follows `blazor-ui-conventions` (theming).
 74: - [ ] Route guards and route params follow the configured routing library conventions (for example Blazouter guards and `RouterStateService.GetParam`).
 75: 
 76: ### Performance & Accessibility
 77: 
 78: - [ ] Virtualization for large lists (`<Virtualize>`).
 79: - [ ] Lazy loading for expensive operations.
 80: - [ ] Skeleton loaders or progress indicators for loading states. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (common patterns).
 81: - [ ] Minimal re-renders (avoid unnecessary `StateHasChanged()`). See `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design).
 82: - [ ] Proper disposal of resources.
 83: - [ ] Semantic HTML structure.
 84: - [ ] ARIA labels where needed.
 85: - [ ] Keyboard navigation support.
 86: - [ ] Color contrast compliance.
 87: - [ ] Screen reader friendly.
 88: 
 89: ## Component Patterns
 90: 
 91: For detailed examples and templates of Page Components, Reusable Components, Dialog Components, and Service Layer implementations, refer to the `blazor-ui-conventions` skill and `blazor-bff-patterns` skill.
 92: 
 93: ## Common Anti-Patterns to Avoid
 94: 
 95: For a comprehensive list of common Blazor anti-patterns, including direct API client usage, data loading in `OnAfterRender`, modifying parameters directly, `async void` event handlers, and `HttpContext` access in WASM, refer to the `blazor-ui-conventions` skill. Also, refer to `blazor-bff-patterns` for BFF-specific anti-patterns.
 96: 
 97: ## Review Process
 98: 
 99: To conduct a thorough review, follow these steps, utilizing the referenced skills for detailed guidance:
100: 
101: 1.  **Analyze Component Structure & Design**: Assess component responsibility, parameter usage, and lifecycle. Refer to `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design).
102: 2.  **Evaluate UI/UX Implementation**: Check MudBlazor usage, layout, and adherence to BEM. Refer to `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage, BEM methodology).
103: 3.  **Verify State & Data Flow**: Review state management patterns, data loading, and authentication state. Refer to `blazor-ui-conventions` (state management) and `blazor-bff-patterns` (auth state management).
````
